raw.excerpt: About Us Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built.
raw.description:
About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking an accomplished UX Designer to join our growing Product org. In this role, you'll define and craft end-to-end experiences that simplify the complex—and make home design and construction more accessible, efficient, and human.

What You'll Do

You’ll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and 3D visualization experts to design tools that serve builders, buyers, and everyone involved in bringing homes to life. Your work will have a lasting, real-world impact and play a critical role in shaping the future of the homebuilding industry. Expect to:

  • Design End-to-End Experiences: Lead the UX and UI design of web-based tools across Higharc’s platform.

  • Simplify the Complex: Translate detailed workflows into clear, human-centered experiences.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product managers and engineers to ensure cohesive product thinking. Partner closely with homebuilders, suppliers, contractors, and buyers to understand their needs and pain points.

  • Own Design Process: Develop user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to articulate design intent.

  • Influence Product Strategy: Bring a strong, user-focused design perspective to product decisions.

  • Validate with Data: Leverage both qualitative and quantitative user insights to inform and iterate on designs.

  • Champion Design Systems:Contribute to and evolve our design system to ensure consistency and scalability.

About You

You’re a product-minded designer who thrives on solving complex problems and crafting user-centered solutions. You’re passionate about improving how people design and live in their homes—and energized by the opportunity to make a meaningful dent in an outdated industry.

You have:

  • 7+ years of experience designing web-based software

  • A track record of shipping high-quality, thoughtful product experiences in complex domains

  • A strong portfolio that showcases your process, thinking, and ability to simplify complexity

  • Deep user empathy and a clear, confident communication style—especially when working with cross-functional teams

  • A systems-thinking mindset with the ability to balance detail with big-picture product vision

  • Experience in defining and delivering net-new experiences, not just iterating on existing patterns

  • Comfort articulating trade-offs, managing ambiguity, and driving toward clarity in fast-moving environments

A major plus if you also bring:

  • A background or passion in architecture, construction tech, or home design

  • Familiarity with 3D tools or environments (e.g., Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, Unity, Three.js)

  • Experience contributing to or evolving a design system

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

You'll work across a fast-moving calendar of product launches, campaigns, and evergreen content, ensuring every asset feels distinctly Topicals while meeting the needs of each channel. The ideal candidate understands how to take an established creative direction and build it into a cohesive, thoughtful system of assets with minimal day-to-day oversight.

raw.description:
About MoneyGeek

MoneyGeek is a fast-growing personal finance and insurance platform that helps millions of people get to their financial happy place. We combine trusted editorial content, proprietary data, and technology-driven product funnels to connect consumers with the right insurance and financial products, while driving measurable performance for our partners.

We’re profitable, growing quickly, and scaling our Insurance partnerships across Auto, Home, SMB/Commercial, Life, Health, and Pet insurance verticals.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of top insurance and marketing partners. Reporting to a co-founder, this person will serve as the executive-level point of contact responsible for revenue retention and expansion, commercial negotiations, and performance optimization across MoneyGeek’s insurance verticals.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role, ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of business development, analytics, client success and growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow the book of business: Lead strategic relationships with top carriers and partners across Auto/P&C, SMB/Commercial, Life, Health, and Pet.
  • Drive revenue and performance: Hit retention and growth targets through active management of pricing, budgets, and conversion performance.
  • Negotiate intelligently: Structure and negotiate CPL/EPL/CPC/CPA deals and program tiers that drive mutual ROI.
  • Launch and optimize programs: Oversee launches of new funnels, landing pages, and state expansions; manage tests to improve EPC, CVR, and CPA.
  • Translate insights into action: Use Power BI, Looker, and client portals/APIs to extract insights and drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead executive-level communication: Deliver clear, data-driven QBRs and performance reviews that deepen trust and unlock more budget.
  • Resolve issues swiftly: Partner with Product, Engineering, SEO/Content and BI to address feed, tracking, or data integrity problems.
  • Systematize success: Build and document repeatable playbooks and best practices for scaling client success operations.
  • Champion our partners: Capture and relay the voice of the customer to influence MoneyGeek’s product and content roadmap.

Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years in Client Success, Account Management, or Partnerships within insurance, insurtech, lead generation, or performance marketing
  • Proven experience owning seven-figure books of business and negotiating pricing/budget increases
  • Strong grasp of performance marketing metrics (EPC, CVR, CTR, CPA) and their drivers
  • Analytical comfort with Power BI, Looker, related tools and client performance dashboards
  • Strong communication and executive-level presence; able to lead high-stakes conversations with carrier partners
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and action-biased in a fast-moving environment
  • Willingness to travel 4–5 times per year for key meetings and conferences

Nice to Haves

  • Direct experience managing relationships with insurance carriers or affiliate networks
  • Familiarity with paid search, landing-page testing, and conversion funnel optimization
  • Knowledge of regulatory and licensing nuances across P&C, SMB/Commercial and Life insurance products

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100,000–$130,000 (DOE)
  • Incentives: Performance-based bonus tied to revenue growth and client success metrics
  • Equity: Stock equity participation
  • Benefits: Generous PTO, paid sabbatical, comprehensive health coverage, and remote-first flexibility

How We Work

At MoneyGeek, we value builders, people who think in systems, communicate clearly, and focus relentlessly on outcomes. You’ll work directly with the senior leadership team and cross functionally, with the autonomy and resources to make an outsized impact.

More About MoneyGeek

We are a startup with the mission to educate our users and help them make smarter personal finance decisions by providing best-in-class content and tools that connect them to the right financial products and services. Making money decisions is tough. It’s complicated. It’s emotional. We are here to help. Personal finance education has been overlooked for too long, MoneyGeek is here to help consumers be smarter about their finances.

About the Opportunity

At Jobsity, we're looking for a results-driven Account Executive to accelerate new business growth within our Nearshore BPO & Contact Center business.

We're searching for a true hunter and closer—someone who knows how to build relationships, identify business opportunities, develop a strong sales pipeline, and turn conversations into long-term client partnerships.

Whether you bring direct experience selling Contact Center and BPO solutions or an exceptional track record selling complex B2B services, we want to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the full sales cycle, influence business growth, and help U.S. companies scale through high-quality nearshore outsourcing solutions.

What You'll Do

Drive New Business & Revenue Growth

  • Independently generate, develop, and manage a strong pipeline of new business opportunities.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to proposal development, negotiation, and closing.

  • Execute outbound prospecting strategies through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, and other channels.

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers within prospective client organizations.

  • Consistently work toward revenue targets and new client acquisition goals.

Deliver Consultative Sales Solutions

  • Understand prospective clients' operational challenges, business objectives, and outsourcing needs.

  • Position Jobsity's Nearshore Contact Center and BPO solutions as strategic business solutions.

  • Conduct compelling discovery calls, presentations, and solution discussions.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers.

  • Develop tailored commercial proposals that demonstrate measurable business value.

Own Sales Performance & Execution

  • Maintain accurate pipeline records, sales forecasts, and customer interactions in the CRM.

  • Monitor opportunities, identify potential obstacles, and proactively drive deals toward closure.

  • Stay informed about Contact Center, outsourcing, and BPO market trends.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, and Leadership to support successful sales execution.

  • Represent Jobsity at industry events, conferences, and client meetings when required.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Proven B2B sales experience with direct responsibility for closing new business.

  • Experience aligned with at least one of the following:

    • Contact Center Sales Specialist: 3–5+ years of relevant sales experience, including selling Contact Center solutions.

    • Experienced B2B Solution Seller: 5–10+ years of Account Executive experience selling complex B2B business solutions or services.

  • Demonstrated success generating pipeline and independently managing sales opportunities through closure.

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, relationship-building, and objection-handling skills.

  • Ability to engage and influence business decision-makers.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, commercially driven, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

  • Ability and willingness to travel to the United States occasionally for business-related activities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling nearshore outsourcing, BPO, customer support, or omnichannel Contact Center solutions.

  • Established relationships within the U.S. business market.

  • Experience selling to mid-market or enterprise organizations.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and outbound sales prospecting tools.

  • Experience selling complex, long-cycle business services.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be joining a growing business unit with an existing pipeline and significant opportunities for new client acquisition.

During your first 90 days, the expectation is to develop strong relationships, actively advance qualified opportunities, and demonstrate the ability to close new business.

The role follows an approximately six-month sales ramp-up period, with a strong emphasis on early commercial impact, pipeline development, and consistent sales execution.

Location & Working Arrangement

This is a primarily remote opportunity.

Candidates based in the United States are preferred, although exceptional candidates across Latin America will also be considered.

Occasional travel to the United States for client meetings, trade shows, and industry events is required.

Compensation and employment arrangements will be discussed based on the candidate's experience, location, and applicable hiring structure.

Why Join Jobsity?

At Jobsity, you'll have the opportunity to play a key role in expanding our Nearshore BPO & Contact Center business, work closely with leadership, and directly influence new business growth.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just manage opportunities but knows how to turn them into results.

Ready to build relationships, win new business, and make an impact? We'd love to meet you.

Apply today!

raw.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:
As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.

What you’ll do:
  • Success Planning & Value: Drive business success planning by partnering with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to align on requirements, goals, and challenges. Provide thought leadership on change management for large, scaled rollouts. Support the full Business Value Realization cycle to ensure customers can demonstrate and prove value internally.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams. This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influence them to act toward customer needs.
  • Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.
  • Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.

About TXOne:

TXOne Networks is a global Industrial and critical infrastructure cybersecurity expert. We offer cybersecurity solutions to protect industrial control systems to ensure reliability and safety from cyberattacks. Given the ICS environments are layered and composed of a variety of equipment in different operating systems, TXOne Networks offers both network-based and endpoint-based products to secure the OT network and mission critical devices in a real-time defence-in-depth manner. Both IT and OT can have comprehensive visibility regarding the ICS assets, protocols, control commands, risks, and threats. The goal is not only to maximize the protection of ICS, but also to keep the business and operation running even when security is being breached in some way. TXOne Networks’ mission is to provide pragmatic and practical cybersecurity solutions to accelerate the progress of automation and data exchange in the industrial world.

Job Description:

Customer Support Engineer role is to improve customer experience of using TXOne Networks products by providing outstanding technical support services.

The Customer Support Engineer is responsible for resolving challenging, potentially high impacting customer situations with a high level of tact and understanding. The role is a customer/partner facing. The Customer Support Engineer will also take ownership of the technical support relationship to drive customer satisfaction by proactively managing and resolving technical issues for our customers.

Main responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Provide exceptional customer service while responding to phone, email and online requests for technical support
  • Represent the customer to ensure serviceability and product quality issues are being tracked, prioritized, resolved, and incorporated
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment under minimum supervision to support deployment, integration and maintenance of TXOne Networks products
  • Will provide first call case resolution, networking and endpoint product troubleshooting and proactive support services
  • Manage a diverse and complex scope of support issues directly related to the use, support, and implementation of TXOne networking and endpoint products and solutions
  • Effectively interact with the Product Management and R&D team teams to provide solutions to complex technical issues
  • Share best practices with other Customer Support Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of support

Candidate Requirements:

Successful candidate will demonstrate a strong aptitude for learning new technologies, evidenced by their ability to expand upon core knowledge quickly. They should be highly analytical with the ability to derive facts quickly, methodically, and accurately.

This is a customer-facing role therefore they will work to solve product, system, and network problems of low to high complexity and act as a focal point for problem resolution.

As the Customer Support Engineer, they must be able to effectively setup and configure complex lab environments to replicate and resolve customer reported issues.

Demonstrated proficiency with the following:

  • Security (including anti-malware) tools, technologies, and processes.
  • Strong networking domain knowledge and network security experiences.
  • Network troubleshooting, including defect analysis and feedback.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows platform and experience of Windows administration/troubleshooting.

Experience and personality:

  • A minimum of 5+ years of networking product related experience.
  • A minimum of 5+ years of MS Windows administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Familiar with TCP/IP, Network Protocols and troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledge of OT protocols is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and ability to work through complex problems and isolate core issues, combined with superb troubleshooting logic.
  • Knowledge of networking and endpoint security principles and types of solutions.
  • Knowledge of OT operations and processes is a plus.
  • Able to debug problems and deliver solutions with a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Self-motivated, self-starter, sense of urgency, personable, extroverted personality, well organized, attention to detail.

The Opportunity:

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, National Portfolio Field Excellence, the Associate Director, National Portfolio Field Excellence leads the team responsible for Revolution Medicines’ U.S. commercial regional congress, sponsorship, peer-to-peer speaker program, and speaker contracting operations across the portfolio. This leader drives the operating model that underpins these programs- intake, governance, vendor management, budget stewardship, and compliance- enabling brand and field teams to execute with speed, consistency, and confidence in preparation for anticipated launches and in line brands.

This is a portfolio-level position rather than an asset-specific one. The role also supports planning and execution of national, area, and regional field meetings, including launch and plan-of-action meetings. This includes coordinating timelines, logistics, vendors, budgets, and follow-through, and supporting portfolio-level connectivity across field teams.

The Associate Director serves as a strategic and operational partner to Marketing, Sales Leadership, Medical Affairs, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, and external agencies, establishing consistent ways of working and advancing continuous improvement across the U.S. National Portfolio Field Excellence organization.

  • Lead U.S. promotional speaker bureau operations across portfolio brands, including speaker nomination, vetting, fair market value review coordination, contracting, onboarding, training logistics, recertification, and utilization monitoring.

  • Plan and execute commercial regional congresses and sponsorships with Marketing, Sales Leadership, and Medical Affairs, including annual calendars, engagement plans, exhibits, field staffing, logistics, on-site operations, and follow-up.

  • Manage national, area, and regional field meetings, including launch and plan-of-action meetings; coordinate timelines, logistics, and follow-through.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required with at least 8 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology sales, commercial operations, including speaker bureau and congress or event operations in partnership with brand marketing.

  • Experience leading and developing program or operations professionals, with clear accountability for team priorities, execution, and performance.

  • Experience managing agencies and suppliers, including RFPs, scopes of work, budgets, forecasting, accruals, and reconciliation.

  • Working knowledge of speaker program and event management systems, or speaker bureau vendor platforms, and related CRM workflows and data flows.

  • Strong understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical requirements and company controls governing promotional programs, HCP engagement, and commercial sponsorships.

  • Demonstrated ability to improve cross-functional processes from design through implementation, stakeholder adoption, and measurement of results.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and use operational data to recommend action.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate complex requirements into practical guidance.

  • Collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable building processes and managing ambiguity in a growing commercial organization.

Preferred Skills:

  • Oncology experience, including product launch or portfolio expansion.

  • Experience planning and executing national, area, or regional sales meetings, including launch or plan-of-action meetings.

  • Experience building commercial program processes and infrastructure from pre-launch through launch in a smaller, growing biotechnology company.

  • Experience transitioning speaker bureau or congress operations between externally supported and internally managed models.

  • Advanced degree or relevant process improvement or meeting management certification, such as Lean Six Sigma or Certified Meeting Professional (CMP).

description: Role Overview The Director, Sales – Walmart & Strategic Accounts is the primary commercial leader for Walmart and select strategic customers, accountable for growing sales, market share, distribution and profitability across branded and private-label products.

raw.title: Director, Sales - Walmart & Strategic Accounts
raw.excerpt: Role Overview The Director, Sales – Walmart & Strategic Accounts is the primary commercial leader for Walmart and select strategic customers, accountable for growing sales, market share, distribution and profitability across branded and private-label products.
raw.description:
Role Overview The Director, Sales – Walmart & Strategic Accounts is the primary commercial leader for Walmart and select strategic customers, accountable for growing sales, market share, distribution and profitability across branded and private-label products. The Director builds strong relationships across their merchandising organizations and partners cross-functionally to turn customer and consumer insights into sustainable growth. Remote opportunity: Local to the Bentonville, AR area Key Responsibilities Account Leadership

Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to improving gross profit through pricing, trade-spend efficiency, product mix, reduced customer fees and other long-term value levers. Own the customer strategy, annual business plan and execution for Walmart and key accounts across branded and private label, serving as primary commercial contact for merchants, buyers and key stakeholders. Lead customer meetings, line reviews, new-item presentations and annual planning using fact-based selling stories. Negotiate pricing, promotions, assortment and commercial terms to expand distribution, shelf presence and category participation.

Financial and Business Management

Deliver annual sales, volume, gross profit and contribution objectives, balancing growth with margin. Own customer-level forecasting, budgeting and business planning. Manage trade spending and customer investments to maximize return. Track performance against plan, flag risks and opportunities, and partner with Finance on pricing, promotional investments and new business opportunities.

Strategic Growth and Omnichannel Business Development

Develop a multi-year Walmart growth roadmap spanning existing products, innovation and new categories for national brands and private label, identifying whitespace through distribution-gap, assortment and competitive analysis. Drive commercialization and sell-in of new products, packaging formats and customer-specific solutions with Marketing and Product Management and anticipate changes in Walmart strategy and shopper expectations. Lead an integrated omnichannel strategy across stores and Walmart.com, partnering with eCommerce on digital assortment, content, search and online sales.

Analytics and Execution

Use syndicated, Walmart and internal data to track sales, share, distribution, pricing, promotions, in-stock and competitive activity, and turn it into recommendations and customer presentations with Category Management and Sales Analytics. Partner with Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Customer Service and Operations to provide high-quality forecasts, maintain service levels and proactively resolve in-stock and replenishment issues. Establish scorecards and KPIs to monitor annual and strategic account objectives.

Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

Manage and develop the Senior Sales Analyst to execute sales plans and achieve objectives at strategic accounts, in alignment with Oil-Dri’s WE CARE core values and Lessons Learned. Act as the internal voice of the customer, communicating Walmart priorities, risks and opportunities to Marketing, Finance, Product Management, Category Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Regulatory and Quality. Focus internal resources on the highest-value customer opportunities and support broader sales planning as needed.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing or a related field required; MBA preferred. 10+ years of progressive CPG sales, customer development or commercial experience. Demonstrated success managing a large, complex national retail customer; significant direct Walmart experience strongly preferred. Experience in branded and private-label CPG, ideally in non-foods, pet, household or consumables, and with category-management teams and sales analysts (preferred). Ability to travel as required.

Measures of Success

Net sales, volume and market-share growth Gross profit, contribution and trade-spend effectiveness Distribution and assortment expansion; successful commercialization of innovation Forecast accuracy and in-stock and service performance Walmart relationship strength and delivery of annual customer plans and strategic initiatives

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive pay ($158,000 - $220,000) + annual bonus 401(k) with 6% company match Paid parental leave, generous PTO, & paid holidays Work-life balance Career growth with exposure to senior leadership. Annual merit increase opportunity Fitness & Gym Reimbursement Employer Contribution - Health, Dental

About Us Oil-Dri Corporation of America is a leading manufacturer and supplier of specialty sorbent products for consumer and business-to-business markets that has been voted as a Top 100 workplaces in the Chicago Tribune. Oil-Dri’s products are sold in the pet care, animal health, fluids purification, agricultural, sports field, industrial and automotive markets. Oil-Dri controls millions of tons of specialty mineral reserves, including calcium bentonite, attapulgite, and diatomaceous shale. The company’s mines and manufacturing facilities are located in Georgia, Mississippi, Illinois, and California. Oil-Dri is a family-controlled and operated organization that emphasizes honesty, integrity, and accountability. The company is dedicated to fulfilling its mission to Create Value From Sorbent Minerals. raw.title: Technical Support Engineer 2
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Support Engineer 2

About the job

This position is needed to support our customers’ use of Twilio’s Programmable Messaging product. This role will function as the voice of Twilio to our customers and partners and operate as a subject matter expert for Twilio’s Programmable Messaging API.

In addition, focus on providing friendly, professional customer service, while problem-solving and demonstrating a high competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone, email, and chat mediums. Advanced time management skills are able to work well under pressure, and are proficient at developing workflows to remain efficient at tasks while still following standard processes and procedures.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Work on messaging email cases submitted by both individual developers and major brands.
  • Assist customers with troubleshooting message deliverability issues and debug customer code.
  • Speak with a customer on the phone and chat in order to guide them through the development of their SMS application.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack. File Jira’s to report reproducible bugs and review our internal knowledge base to stay up to speed with industry shifts and standards.
  • Work with your manager to surface customer problems to assist in process betterment.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing technical role, preferably in supporting REST API or enterprise software
  • A firm understanding of the technology stacks common to the Web ecosystem.
  • Functional knowledge of general-purpose programming languages.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to professionally and diplomatically address customer concerns and provide concise feedback.
  • Ability to de-escalate tense/tough customer situations in a live environment.
  • Excellent reading comprehension, listening, and writing skills.

Desired:

  • Previous exposure or knowledge of Twilio products.
  • Coding experience in any language. (reading and debugging)
  • Previous experience with JIRA or a similar ticketing system.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Civil/Structural CAD Specialist
description: AECOM has a position available as a Civil/Structural CAD Specialist to support our growing Energy Practice.

raw.title: Civil/Structural CAD Specialist
raw.excerpt: AECOM has a position available as a Civil/Structural CAD Specialist to support our growing Energy Practice.
raw.description:
AECOM has a position available as a Civil/Structural CAD Specialist to support our growing Energy Practice. AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

Our team works on high and medium voltage projects for municipal, utility, commercial and industrial clients. This position will perform technical tasks on a variety of projects including substation retrofits and new builds, overhead and underground transmission, distributed generation, renewable energy and energy master planning. Qualified candidates will have a familiarity with the civil and structural design aspects for power utility and industrial clients.

The successful candidate will have an understanding and experience in structural Revit design and principles along with basic AutoCAD, Advanced Steel, and Civil 3D skills. She/he will be expected to work successfully within a team environment and be able to communicate effectively with other project team members. He/she will have a high level of initiative, motivation, and displays drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with excellent attention to detail.

The job responsibilities of this position will include but are not limited to:

  • Works independently with limited direct supervision performing moderately complex technical work to create and maintain complete structural design sets by interpreting and incorporating engineering red lines, markups, and instructions into CAD drawings and 3D models.
  • Accountable for larger portions of a project or process with the ability to analyze issues, identify solutions and coordinate with engineering staff.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with company/client drafting/BIM standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and industry best practices.
  • Maintain version control and proper file management of all CAD and 3D model files throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Assist in quality control by performing self and/or model health checks and peer reviews to ensure accuracy, completeness, and constructability of drawings and models.
  • Revise drawings efficiently based on engineering feedback, RFI’s, change orders, and construction site markups.
  • Develop and maintain civil engineering drawings using AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
  • Prepare site layouts, grading plans, drainage plans, utility layouts, roadways, and infrastructure drawings as applicable to project scope.
  • Develop plan views, profiles, sections, details, and construction documentation.
  • Interpret survey data, engineering sketches, design markups, and technical specifications.
  • Assist with earthwork calculations, material quantities, and design exhibits.
  • Develop detailed structural drawings and 3D models for steel, concrete, and other structural systems.
  • Prepare foundation plans, structural framing plans, sections, elevations, and connection details.
  • Create structural models and drawing packages using Revit and other applicable BIM/CAD platforms, including AutoCAD and Advanced Steel.
  • Assist with structural detailing, equipment foundations, support structures, platforms, and miscellaneous steel.
  • Develop and manage 3D models for structural systems, including substation equipment supports, concrete and steel structures, bus supports, and related elements.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • BA/BS in Engineering or related field + 4 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
  • Experience in structural design

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Masters Degree in Engineering or related field
  • Demonstrated experience in participating complex, multi-discipline programs/projects and CAD teams for civil and/or structural designs
  • Demonstrated experience developing civil and/or structural engineering drawings
  • Working knowledge of civil and structural construction methods, materials, and design practices
  • Experience in Revit 3D modeling environments, specifically for structural substation designs
  • Confidence utilizing Autodesk 2D and/or Civil 3D
  • Utilize Advanced Steel for structural steel modeling, detailing, connection design support, and fabrication-level documentation as required
  • Experience working in collaborative model environments (e.g. Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Experience in the management of Common Data Environments including ProjectWise and ACC/Forma (Autodesk Construction Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of Bluebeam Revu for PDF markups, reviews, and collaboration
  • Understanding of vendor documentation and it’s use as a reference for assigned tasks
  • Exposure to substation facilities, including equipment, layouts and designs
  • Preference will be given to candidates who also can support both structural and site/civil designs
  • Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
  • Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

raw.description:
Account Executive TLH FL

The ideal candidate takes initiative, writes clearly, and communicates with confidence. As client priorities shift, you’ll adapt quickly and work with colleagues across Sachs Media to keep projects on track and meet each client’s communications goals.

Our clients work on issues that affect people’s lives. We’ve helped them secure funding for cancer research and prevention, elevate mental health as a policy priority, bring clean energy to communities, advance civil rights, and fight hunger. We value the people who do this work and welcome candidates who bring sound judgment and fresh ideas to complex assignments.

The Account Executive will typically report to a Director or Vice President.

Qualifications:

Candidates must have a four-year degree in public relations, communications, political science, or a related field AND at least two years of relevant experience in a related role; agency experience preferred. In addition, the ideal candidate:

  • Communicates effectively, writes persuasively, and clearly presents strategies and ideas
    Understands political dynamics, demands, and consumes relevant news
  • Embraces high-stakes challenges on a wide range of issues that make a meaningful impact on people’s lives
  • Demonstrates an ability to execute communications plans and manage multiple issues or clients
  • Has an eye for design and an ability to provide creative teams with direction
    Recognizes the importance of staying organized and remaining on top of pressing priorities
  • Takes individual initiative while being part of a strong team that works collaboratively

Responsibilities:

  • Remains current on trends in public relations, state government, and communications
  • Writes and edits op-eds, fact sheets, news releases, media advisories, backgrounders, and other collateral materials in order to advance client issues
  • Follows legislative and regulatory developments on issues in multiple states
  • Assists with the planning, scripting, and execution of special events on behalf of clients
  • Attends client meetings, providing strategic counsel and communications support
  • Assists in the development of communications and advertising plans for assigned clients
  • Researches issues and writes accurate and effective media materials and pitches
  • Ensures a high standard of excellence for all work produced
  • Creates compelling and visually appealing presentation decks
  • Works with vendors for estimates based on the client's needs and helps plan media and other events, as necessary
  • Works with a high degree of autonomy with clients to develop and implement communication strategies that meet their needs and achieve their goals
  • Manages relationships with co-workers with a high degree of professionalism and collaboration
  • Works to advance the goals of the firm by supporting internal promotional and communications efforts

Benefits:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Health, Dental, and Vision - Single Coverage
  • Healthcare Reimbursement Account, such as FSA
  • 401K Plan - after 90 days of employment and company match
  • Life Insurance in the amount of one time your annual salary
  • Paid Time Off
  • Parental Leave
  • 10 Paid Holidays, plus the week between Dec. 24 and Jan. 1
  • Two Paid Personal Days
  • Eligible for annual performance bonus
  • Up to $1000 per year in professional certifications
  • Annual work-from-home stipend
  • Remote Work/Flexible schedules
  • Family Work Culture

Job Details:

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Tallahassee, Florida (Preferred)

Travel: 10% (Required)

Sachs Media is an equal-opportunity employer. Successful candidates must possess valid authorization to work in the United States and not require future sponsorship for employment.

As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Support Engineer 2

About the job

This position is needed to support our customers’ use of Twilio’s Programmable Messaging product. This role will function as the voice of Twilio to our customers and partners and operate as a subject matter expert for Twilio’s Programmable Messaging API.

In addition, focus on providing friendly, professional customer service, while problem-solving and demonstrating a high competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone, email, and chat mediums. Advanced time management skills are able to work well under pressure, and are proficient at developing workflows to remain efficient at tasks while still following standard processes and procedures.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Work on messaging email cases submitted by both individual developers and major brands.
  • Assist customers with troubleshooting message deliverability issues and debug customer code.
  • Speak with a customer on the phone and chat in order to guide them through the development of their SMS application.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack. File Jira’s to report reproducible bugs and review our internal knowledge base to stay up to speed with industry shifts and standards.
  • Work with your manager to surface customer problems to assist in process betterment.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing technical role, preferably in supporting REST API or enterprise software
  • A firm understanding of the technology stacks common to the Web ecosystem.

  • Strong problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to professionally and diplomatically address customer concerns and provide concise feedback.
  • Ability to de-escalate tense/tough customer situations in a live environment.
  • Excellent reading comprehension, listening, and writing skills.

Desired:

  • Previous exposure or knowledge of Twilio products.
  • Coding experience in any language. (reading and debugging)
  • Previous experience with JIRA or a similar ticketing system.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

raw.title: Civil/Structural CAD Specialist
raw.excerpt: AECOM has a position available as a Civil/Structural CAD Specialist to support our growing Energy Practice.
raw.description:
AECOM has a position available as a Civil/Structural CAD Specialist to support our growing Energy Practice. AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

Our team works on high and medium voltage projects for municipal, utility, commercial and industrial clients. This position will perform technical tasks on a variety of projects including substation retrofits and new builds, overhead and underground transmission, distributed generation, renewable energy and energy master planning. Qualified candidates will have a familiarity with the civil and structural design aspects for power utility and industrial clients.

The successful candidate will have an understanding and experience in structural Revit design and principles along with basic AutoCAD, Advanced Steel, and Civil 3D skills. She/he will be expected to work successfully within a team environment and be able to communicate effectively with other project team members. He/she will have a high level of initiative, motivation, and displays drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with excellent attention to detail.

The job responsibilities of this position will include but are not limited to:

  • Works independently with limited direct supervision performing moderately complex technical work to create and maintain complete structural design sets by interpreting and incorporating engineering red lines, markups, and instructions into CAD drawings and 3D models.
  • Accountable for larger portions of a project or process with the ability to analyze issues, identify solutions and coordinate with engineering staff.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with company/client drafting/BIM standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and industry best practices.
  • Maintain version control and proper file management of all CAD and 3D model files throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Assist in quality control by performing self and/or model health checks and peer reviews to ensure accuracy, completeness, and constructability of drawings and models.
  • Revise drawings efficiently based on engineering feedback, RFI’s, change orders, and construction site markups.
  • Develop and maintain civil engineering drawings using AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
  • Prepare site layouts, grading plans, drainage plans, utility layouts, roadways, and infrastructure drawings as applicable to project scope.
  • Develop plan views, profiles, sections, details, and construction documentation.
  • Interpret survey data, engineering sketches, design markups, and technical specifications.
  • Assist with earthwork calculations, material quantities, and design exhibits.
  • Develop detailed structural drawings and 3D models for steel, concrete, and other structural systems.
  • Prepare foundation plans, structural framing plans, sections, elevations, and connection details.
  • Create structural models and drawing packages using Revit and other applicable BIM/CAD platforms, including AutoCAD and Advanced Steel.
  • Assist with structural detailing, equipment foundations, support structures, platforms, and miscellaneous steel.
  • Develop and manage 3D models for structural systems, including substation equipment supports, concrete and steel structures, bus supports, and related elements.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • BA/BS in Engineering or related field + 4 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
  • Experience in structural design

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Masters Degree in Engineering or related field
  • Demonstrated experience in participating complex, multi-discipline programs/projects and CAD teams for civil and/or structural designs
  • Demonstrated experience developing civil and/or structural engineering drawings
  • Working knowledge of civil and structural construction methods, materials, and design practices
  • Experience in Revit 3D modeling environments, specifically for structural substation designs
  • Confidence utilizing Autodesk 2D and/or Civil 3D
  • Utilize Advanced Steel for structural steel modeling, detailing, connection design support, and fabrication-level documentation as required
  • Experience working in collaborative model environments (e.g. Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Experience in the management of Common Data Environments including ProjectWise and ACC/Forma (Autodesk Construction Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of Bluebeam Revu for PDF markups, reviews, and collaboration
  • Understanding of vendor documentation and it’s use as a reference for assigned tasks
  • Exposure to substation facilities, including equipment, layouts and designs
  • Preference will be given to candidates who also can support both structural and site/civil designs
  • Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
  • Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

raw.description:
Kevel is a remote-first company that values collaboration, innovation, and transparency. We are the leading API-first ad serving platform powering the next generation of retail media and commerce media networks. We enable retailers, marketplaces, and commerce platforms to build, operate, and scale their own advertising businesses - unlocking new revenue streams while maintaining full control over data, user experience, and monetization strategy. As commerce media continues to transform the advertising landscape, Kevel sits at the center - providing the infrastructure and expertise to help customers launch and scale high-growth media networks.

JOB OVERVIEW: As a Commerce Media Client Partner, you will own and grow a portfolio of retail and commerce media customers, serving as their primary day-to-day commercial and operational partner. This role co-owns account commercials and expansion targets alongside Retail Media Strategy Leads, ensuring that growth strategies translate into execution, adoption, and measurable revenue outcomes. You will partner directly with retailer media teams, operational leaders, and monetization stakeholders to scale their retail media businesses while driving retention and expansion for Kevel.

While commercially accountable, this role remains deeply hands-on - operating as the primary customer success lead across many day-to-day interactions, including cadence calls, troubleshooting, onboarding, product adoption, demos, and implementation support. This is a hybrid commercial and customer success role requiring deep retail media expertise, executive communication skills, and the ability to operationalize complex growth initiatives.

LOCATION: REMOTE - UNITED STATES. This position is 100% remote. Applicants located anywhere within the United States (Eastern or Central Time Zones preferred) are encouraged to apply. Applicants must be legally eligible to work within the United States.

PAY TRANSPARENCY:Kevel uses external, third-party market data to determine compensation for all open positions. Our compensation philosophy is based on the candidate’s specific working location and experience level. This means that we will take a no negotiationapproach in our recruitment and offer processes. We believe this is an important step in living our value of embracing diversity while underlining our commitment to fair, equitable and inclusive pay practices.

The pay range for this position is between $170,000 - 195,000 OTE (combination of base + commission). An exact offer for this position will be determined based on the candidate's working location and experience level, in relation to our existing team. In regards to candidate location in the US specifically, Kevel currently uses validated external data sources to determine which US locations are considered higher cost of living metropolitan areas compared to others. Candidates are welcome to reference the following chart to get a general sense of where they may fall within the pay range based on US location.

Our recruitment team can share more about this with you in an initial phone interview and will be happy to answer any questions you have related to compensation at Kevel!

WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH:

  • Own retention, customer health, and expansion opportunities across a portfolio of commerce media accounts, proactively identifying opportunities to drive growth and partnering with internal teams on commercial strategy and execution.
  • Operationalize commerce media strategies across onsite, offsite, and data monetization programs to drive advertiser adoption and revenue growth
  • Lead business reviews, maturity assessments, and monetization planning sessions with senior retail media stakeholders
  • Translate growth strategy into platform adoption, product utilization, and measurable performance outcomes
  • Leverage AI, automation, and emerging tools to improve efficiency, streamline customer workflows, and create more opportunities for proactive customer engagement.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day client operator - managing cadence calls, troubleshooting issues, supporting onboarding and implementations, driving product adoption, and delivering demos as needed
  • Take ownership of day-to-day account priorities, proactively identifying risks, removing blockers, and driving initiatives forward.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Strategy, Solutions Architects, and Product to execute expansion initiatives and deliver customer value.

SKILLS YOU'LL BRING WITH YOU:

  • 4 – 6+ years of experience in retail media, ad tech, or commerce platforms, with a strong preference for hands-on onsite retail media experience.
  • Experience working directly with retailers or marketplaces
  • Strong commercial acumen with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset and the ability to independently manage customer relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive results.
  • Comfortable co-owning expansion targets
  • Curious and adaptable, with an interest in leveraging AI, automation, and new technologies to continuously improve how customers are supported.
  • Executive presence and communication skills
  • Deep understanding of retail media monetization models

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US:

  • Fully Remote Team: We are a 100% remote work environment with employees located around the world. You are welcome to work from home, one of our offices, a WeWork office, or an equivalent co-working space.
  • Flexible Working Hours: We understand our employees have their own lives, responsibilities and working preferences. We trust our employees to communicate with their managers, and work when they work best.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - Kevel provides 100% employer paid medical benefits for our employees and their children, plus comprehensive, affordable coverage for all other dependents.
  • Savings opportunity for the Future: Kevel offers retirement savings plans with employer contributions so employees can save toward future financial objectives.
  • Rest and Relaxation: Unlimited personal time off - and we mean it! We trust our employees to take the time they need, whenever they need it. We also offer Paid Holidays + a Kevel Holiday Break (from 12/24 - 1/1 every year!
  • Kevelfest: Our annual corporate retreat! The entire Kevel team gets together once a year for a four - day in - person event filled with collaboration, team building, celebration and fun!
  • Home Office Stipend: You’ll receive a new windows or mac machine (your choice) + a $500 home office allowance to purchase what you need to set up your work space properly!
  • Parental Leave Support: We support all parents with salary continuation and benefits when our employees are growing their families.
  • Free press benefits: Kevel believes all employees should have access to legitimate news sources. You’ll receive a $300 annual allowance to subscribe to the news source of your choice.

raw.title: Platform SRE
raw.excerpt: About Nexcess Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist.
raw.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

The Platform SRE is a member of the Platform SRE team, the group responsible for the operational health, resiliency, and modernization of our hosting and cloud infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, site reliability engineering, and automation : combining hands-on technical debt remediation with large-scale automation and reliability practice.

The Platform SRE team owns three core mandates:

1. Technical debt reduction : systematically identifying and remediating aging firmware, kernels, operating systems, and software across the managed hosting fleet and managed application environments.

2. Automation of critical operational workflows : provisioning, patching, remediation, and release processes across both managed apps and managed hosting fleets, with automated release planning and execution under human supervision (not “automation for automation’s sake,” but automation with a human checkpoint before production impact).

3. Reliability and incident support : defining, instrumenting, and tracking SLIs/SLOs for platform engineering and operations, visualized through dashboards and reporting tools, and providing fast, expert frontline response and remediation during service-impacting events (incident command and process ownership sit with the Incident Management team; this team is the technical responder, not the incident owner).

This position serves as a senior technical point of contact for platform engineering, driving initiatives around scalability, fault tolerance, automation, and operational excellence across production infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Debt & Platform Modernization

  • Own the lifecycle of firmware, kernel, OS, and software patching across the managed hosting fleet and managed application environments
  • Build a standing inventory and risk model of technical debt (end-of-life OS versions, unpatched firmware, deprecated software) and drive prioritized remediation plans
  • Evaluate and implement infrastructure modernization initiatives, replacing manual or legacy processes with supportable, automated alternatives

Automation & Release Engineering

  • Design and build automation for provisioning, deployment, patching, remediation, and configuration management across managed apps and managed hosting fleets
  • Own the design of automated release pipelines : planning, staging, and executing releases with defined human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Develop self-healing and auto-remediation capability for common failure modes to reduce manual operational load
  • Support and extend CI/CD workflows and infrastructure-as-code practices across the platform

Reliability Engineering, SLIs/SLOs & Observability

  • Define SLIs and SLOs for platform engineering and operations in partnership with engineering and product stakeholders
  • Instrument systems to measure SLIs accurately and build SLO tracking into standard reporting
  • Build and maintain dashboards (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent visualization tooling) to make SLI/SLO performance, error budgets, and platform health visible to engineering and leadership
  • Continuously improve platform observability : monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing : across distributed and containerized environments

Incident Response & Remediation (Support Role)

  • Serve as the frontline technical responder: acknowledge pages quickly, diagnose, and remediate platform-level issues
  • Partner with the Incident Management team, who own incident command, severity classification, and customer communication : this role provides the technical hands and expertise, not incident ownership
  • Contribute technical findings to blameless root cause analysis (RCA) and own follow-through on corrective actions for platform systems
  • Maintain runbooks and on-call readiness for platform and infrastructure systems
  • Track incident trends on platform systems and feed them back into the technical debt and automation roadmap

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with software engineering teams on platform architecture, operational readiness reviews, and scalability initiatives
  • Support platform security, compliance, and operational governance requirements
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership and knowledge-sharing across the team
  • Maintain clear operational documentation and contribute to team standards and process improvement

● Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in platform engineering, systems engineering, SRE, or infrastructure operations (level based on experience and scope)
  • Advanced Linux systems administration and troubleshooting expertise, including kernel and firmware-level familiarity
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration/distributed systems
  • Hands-on automation and infrastructure-as-code experience (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, or equivalent)
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD and automated release/deployment pipelines
  • Experience defining and tracking SLIs/SLOs and working with observability/visualization tools (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent)
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale, high-concurrency, or customer-impacting production environments
  • Demonstrated experience as a technical responder in production incidents, including root cause analysis and corrective action follow-through
  • Strong scripting ability (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation and tooling
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across compute, network, storage, and application layers
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted, managed hosting, or hybrid infrastructure environments
  • Ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor others, and communicate clearly across teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning fleet-wide firmware/OS patch management programs at scale
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop release automation or progressive delivery systems (canary, blue/green)
  • Familiarity with error budgets and SLO-driven prioritization frameworks
  • Experience with configuration/patch management at scale across heterogeneous hardware fleets
