raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager
raw.excerpt: Who We Are Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

You know how it feels when you walk into your favorite coffee shop and they know your name and start prepping your usual? Imprint makes it possible for the largest brands to create that experience at scale.

We bring payments, loyalty, and customer intelligence together in one platform, so brands can recognize and reward customers as individuals and keep them coming back. With the power of our technology and data, brands create financial products that their customers’ use everyday, earning more of their spend and increasing loyalty. Customers are rewarded with money and time saved, and surprised and delighted with a more unique, tailored experience.

We first proved our business in co-brand credit cards. For decades, the same few banks dominated the industry, building brands’ programs on mainframes older than the internet. We took a different approach, rebuilding the technology from the ground up. Today, Imprint has more than two million members, with partners like Shell, Kroger, H-E-B, and representing half a trillion dollars in total US consumer spend. Now, we’re growing our partnerships, bringing on more members, and expanding beyond credit cards so that brands offer more ways to pay and be rewarded to recognize their customers as individuals no matter their income or preferences.

Better yet, we’re doing it differently with a lean team of the most talented people on earth. Historically, companies scaled by adding people. Imprint is taking on our opportunity with a small team of exceptional people, with the best AI and technology dramatically amplifying what each person can accomplish. That means you’ll learn faster here than you could anywhere else. You’ll be one of the few people building an entirely new technology with the ownership and trust to shape what Imprint becomes. You’ll work alongside people who make you sharper everyday, armed with tools that turn your best ideas into reality faster than you thought possible. This is a rare chance to do the most important work of your career and to help prove that a small team can build what’s never been done before, inside industries that haven’t changed in decades.

Engineering leadership is the lever for this next stage. As Imprint expands into new financial products, launches new brand partnerships, and scales the infrastructure underneath all of it, the quality of our engineering teams determines the quality of everything we ship. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to how teams are built, how they make decisions, and how they're managed, is what Senior Engineering Managers own.

The Opportunity

  • Bring structure to complex, ambiguous domains: Imprint's products sit at the intersection of payments, credit, compliance, and brand strategy. You'll lead a team through problems that aren't fully scoped, where the right answer requires synthesizing technical constraints with product, legal, and financial realities.

  • Operate as a true cross-functional partner: Not just "align with product." You'll work directly with product, compliance, legal, capital markets, and solutions engineering on decisions where the lanes overlap significantly. You will help represent Engineering in the room when strategy is set.

  • Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI: AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need real technical judgment and the modern tools to exercise it.

  • Build and develop a team as a craft: You have a real philosophy on how to hire, develop, and retain strong engineers. You have opinions on how work is scoped and delivered, how to balance short and long-term priorities, and how to give feedback that actually changes outcomes. Clear communication, written and verbal, is key.

  • Operate in the details: This is not a role where technical context and project management are abstracted to other roles or organizational layers. You define the roadmap, scope the work, and manage individuals to outcomes. Even if you've led multiple teams before, the question is: can you take a new team and run it end-to-end?

  • Own outcomes at a company in a defining growth moment: Imprint is growing rapidly, launching new products, and deepening our platform. You'll have the scope and autonomy to shape how your team builds, and your work will be visible in the trajectory of the business.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of building, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams

  • You've managed through periods of rapid growth, ambiguity, or significant technical change, and your teams came out stronger

  • A strong technical foundation: you were a strong engineer before moving into management, and you've maintained technical credibility through hands-on engagement or modern AI tools

  • You've managed Staff-level ICs and helped senior engineers grow into bigger roles

  • Experience in domains with real complexity: financial systems, distributed infrastructure, regulated environments, or similarly demanding technical areas

  • You communicate with clarity and directness in writing, in 1:1s, in rooms with executives, and in rooms with engineers

  • You drive delivery through your team, not around them. You know how to scope work, set priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work

  • Experience using AI tools to stay close to technical work (investigating codebases, assessing feasibility, bringing clarity to asks), or genuine enthusiasm to adopt them

Some of our teams are full-stack (frontend, backend, and mobile); others are backend-focused. We're looking for strong engineering leaders regardless of your specific technical background.

We don't expect every candidate to match every bullet. If you're excited about what we're building and confident you can contribute, we'd love to talk.

Stack

Our backend runs on Go, MySQL, DynamoDB, Temporal, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS.

Read more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Medical plan options fully paid by Imprint, including coverage for your dependents

  • 100% company-paid dental and vision plan options

  • Mental health support through Spring Health, plus a confidential Employee Assistance Program

  • Healthcare navigation through Rightway, plus HSA, FSA and commuter benefits

  • Flexible paid time off

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • The latest tools and technology, including AI, so you can do your best work

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $220K - $235K

Standard Job Description

Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

What happens the moment a critical national security satellite reaches orbit? That’s where you come in!

We are looking for driven engineers to join our Flight Operations Support Team supporting the Space Based Infrared System (SBIRS) and Next Gen GEO (NGG) satellite constellations. As a Systems Engineer Associate on the Flight Operations Support Team, you will step directly into the fast-paced world of real-time spacecraft operations. Our team is the engineering backbone behind the launch, initialization, on-orbit tuning, and continuous maintenance of these vital Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) systems. You will gain rare, first-hand experience troubleshooting complex space systems, optimizing on-orbit performance, and ensuring 24/7 mission readiness alongside the engineers who keep our nation’s "eyes in the sky" flying strong.

Because spacecraft operations require a complete view of the vehicle, our team is truly multi-disciplinary, merging Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and Software Engineering into one collaborative environment.Beyond day-to-day flight support, you will help shape the future of how we operate in space. We are looking for fresh perspectives to help us innovate and modernize our workflows through Digital Engineering, Model-Based Development, and AI integration, giving you the chance to build next-generation tools and solutions that directly impact live orbital missions.

This position requires special access to support the program and requires the selected candidate to be a U.S. Citizen.

  • Experience working with system requirements, technical procedures, diagrams, and engineering documentation

• Demonstrated ability to work in a collaborative and team-based environment

Established in 2005 and owned by the Paskenta Band of Nomlaki Indians, The Tepa Companies deliver comprehensive and sustainable solutions to federal, state, local, and private-sector clients throughout the United States. The tribally owned companies work independently and collaboratively to provide wide-ranging construction, engineering, environmental, industrial, staffing, and technology services.


When you join Tepa Companies, you have the opportunity to expand your entrepreneurial skill set while growing professionally alongside the best in the industry. You will have the opportunity to impact your team, the organization as a whole, and subsequently, our Tribe.


We seek out top talent to provide the best services for our clients. We focus on being a responsible company for our employees and their families by creating a culture that reflects our core values and offering competitive pay and benefits package. Our benefits package includes comprehensive medical, dental, vision, generous paid time off and holidays, 401(k) plan with company match, life insurance, flexible spending and health savings account, mental health support and resources, short and long-term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

PAY RANGE: $160,000.00 - $200,000.00

ABOUT THE JOB


The Tepa Companies are seeking a Vice-President, Operations to ensure regional/business unit adherence to policies and procedures for reporting, project controls, financial controls, and employee relations. This role oversees the daily operations of the region/business unit including human resources and staffing, tracking workloads, project execution, project management, contract administration, safety, and quality control. raw.description:
Senior Support Solutions Consultant

Colombia, Remote · Full-Time

About Snowplow

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow’s event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.

More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.

How we work
  • High agency. When you see a problem or an opportunity we’re missing, you act on it. Managers build alongside their teams.
  • Make it count. Every piece of work points at a goal that matters, with a number that shows whether it’s working.
  • Move fast. We work at the pace AI makes possible and improve as we go, except where customers trust us with their data, service, security and contracts. Those we get right the first time.
  • Challenge, and be open to challenge. Say what you think, with evidence, to the person who can act on it, and expect the same back.
This Opportunity

Snowplow’s customers run event pipelines inside their own AWS, GCP, and Azure accounts, and products like Snowplow Signals are pulling them into AI and personalization work, which only works as well as the behavioral data underneath it. More of them now need more than a fast answer to a ticket. They need someone who understands their setup and their data, spots problems before they become cases, and helps them get more out of what they’ve bought.

That’s the Support Solutions Consultant. It’s one of two specialist tracks we’re building inside Support, and this is one of its first senior seats. Everyone on the team keeps our 24x7 service running, so roughly 75-80% of your time is core support: first response against our SLAs, complex technical cases, and incident management. The other 20-25% is your focus, which is going above and beyond the normal scope of support to help customers achieve their end goals with the product and the behavioral data it creates.

You’ll be a calm, trusted technical voice for customers in the Americas during their working day, with real autonomy and a direct say in how we support them.

What you will own

Core support (roughly 75-80% of your time)

  • Complex technical escalations. Investigate and resolve the hardest cases: pipeline failures, failed events, enrichment and schema issues, loader and warehouse problems, and cloud infrastructure faults across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • The customer relationship during an incident. Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates when their data is at stake, and work with Engineering to restore service and recover data.
  • Root cause, not just resolution. Go past the immediate fix and turn what you learn into bug reports and enhancement requests Engineering can act on.
  • AI in your everyday toolkit. Use AI assistants and agents to investigate issues, analyze logs and data, and draft responses, while keeping your own judgment on accuracy and customer impact.

Consultative focus (roughly 20-25% of your time)

  • Support beyond the ticket. Give customers deeper, proactive time, not just a reply to the case in front of you. Learn their setup, their data, their goals, and what they’re building next.
  • Tracking and data design. Review customers’ tracking plans, schemas, and implementation, and help them design behavioral data that answers the questions they actually have.
  • Proactive data health checks. Run consult-and-activate check-ins on the quality of their behavioral data: failed events, schema drift, enrichment configuration, and gaps in what they track. Find real issues and real opportunities, not box-ticking reviews.
  • Getting more from their data. Understand what a customer is building, whether that’s AI agents, personalization, or real-time analytics, and show them how to get there with the data they already collect, from modeling it in the warehouse to new capabilities like Signals.
  • Knowing where the line sits. Work alongside Customer Success and the wider customer team. Recognize when an account needs more than light-touch help and hand it over cleanly.
  • Sharing what you know. Answer in our community channels, write knowledge base articles and runbooks on tracking and data quality that serve both people and the AI tools that draw on them, and mentor colleagues on consultative work.
We would love to hear from you if you have
  • A track record in technical support. Several years in technical support, support engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role, ideally for a B2B SaaS or data infrastructure product.
  • Consultative instincts. You’ve worked with customers beyond the ticket, in an education, solutions engineering, customer success, onboarding, or similar customer-facing role. You ask what the customer is trying to achieve before you answer what they asked.
  • Credibility with customers. You can run a call with a senior technical stakeholder, explain complex issues clearly and empathetically, and follow through on what you said you’d do.
  • Commercial awareness without the sales hat. You can tell when a customer’s needs go beyond support and bring in the right colleague.
  • Technical depth to back it up. Hands-on with AWS or GCP (Azure is a plus), strong troubleshooting instincts, and comfort reading JavaScript.
  • Data and tracking fluency. You understand how behavioral data gets created, from tracker implementation and schema design to enrichment and warehouse modeling. You write SQL against large datasets, and you can tell when the data isn’t telling the truth.
  • Real fluency with AI tools. You use LLMs and agent tools every day, and you know where they work well, where they get things wrong, and how to check the difference.
  • Calm under pressure. You can prioritize when several things are urgent, stay steady during incidents, and know when to escalate.
  • A share-by-default attitude. You document, demo, and teach.
  • Availability for our coverage window. Monday to Friday, approximately 8am–5pm Colombia time (UTC-5).
Bonus points for
  • Experience as a solutions engineer or consultant for a data or SaaS product
  • Experience with event tracking, tracking plans, or data modeling, such as analytics engineering
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or dbt
  • Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or MCP-style tool integrations
  • Spanish, which will help with some of our Latin American customers
Where this role can take you

The Support Solutions Consultant track grows toward wider customer-facing and solutions roles at Snowplow. Moving between our two tracks later stays open as an internal move.

We know some of you will read this and think you need to tick every box before applying. You don’t. We value diversity and hire for potential as much as for experience. If you think you can help solve our challenges, we’d love to hear from you.


Benefits

•Meaningful equity stake

•Competitive Base Salary

•Flexible working

•Generous PTO

•Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

•401k

  • MacBook and home office equipment allowance

•Enhanced Family leave

raw.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

As a Product Manager on our Wealth Products Solutions team, you will help clients securely and confidently access and protect their financial accounts. You will own the customer journeys and product funnels that support login, authentication, account recovery, and client protection across our retirement and personal wealth businesses.

You will focus on making these experiences intuitive, reliable, and secure, reducing unnecessary friction while maintaining the protections that build client trust. Working closely with engineering, design, cybersecurity, fraud, and other cross-functional partners, you will turn complex customer and business needs into clear priorities and well-executed product experiences.

We are looking for a motivated, hands-on Product Manager who takes initiative, follows through, and cares deeply about the details. You bring strong product judgment, analytical curiosity, and practical experience using AI in your day-to-day work to improve effectiveness, accelerate learning, and strengthen the quality of your deliverables.

What You Will Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for login, authentication, and client protection funnels, including multifactor authentication, identity verification, account recovery, and security-related notifications and actions

  • Improve end-to-end customer funnels by identifying friction, abandonment, and points where clients need assistance, prioritizing improvements that simplify account access and protective actions while supporting security and fraud-prevention goals

  • Translate complex customer, business, and technical problems into clear user stories and acceptance criteria that address successful paths, error states, recovery options, accessibility, and edge cases

  • Partner with design and research to understand client needs, test assumptions, and simplify experiences such as account lockouts and additional identity verification

  • Define and monitor outcomes including login success, authentication completion, enrollment and recovery completion, abandonment, support contacts, and relevant security and fraud indicators to guide prioritization and evaluate results

  • Lead cross-functional execution with engineering, design, cybersecurity, identity, fraud, compliance, legal, and client service partners, managing dependencies, communicating tradeoffs, securing approvals, and driving work through key milestones

  • Use customer feedback, funnel analysis, usability testing, and controlled experiments where appropriate to validate and iterate on experiences while maintaining required security and fraud protections

  • Maintain a high bar for execution from discovery through launch and post-launch monitoring, validating that customer experiences, analytics, and exception handling work as intended

  • Use AI in daily product workflows to support research synthesis, data exploration, requirements development, prototyping, and test-scenario identification while validating outputs and following company policies for confidential information and client data

  • Proactively surface problems, bring structure to ambiguity, communicate clear recommendations, and drive improvements with urgency, sound judgment, and limited oversight

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of product management experience with consumer-facing digital products, working collaboratively with engineering, design, and research teams

  • Experience improving multistep customer journeys using funnel analytics, customer insights, and testing to identify problems and measure the impact of changes

  • Demonstrated practical experience using AI in day-to-day work to improve the effectiveness, speed, or quality of deliverables while applying appropriate validation and judgment

  • Strong personal ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify opportunities, move work forward independently, and follow through on decisions and commitments

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, anticipate edge cases, ask precise questions, and translate findings into clear requirements and improved customer experiences

  • Strong prioritization and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate competing customer, business, technical, security, and risk considerations

  • Excellent communication and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data and complex issues into clear insights, explain tradeoffs, and build alignment across technical and nontechnical partners

What Will Set You Apart

  • Direct product experience with login, multifactor authentication, passkeys, identity verification, account recovery, security settings, or other client protection journeys

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment, including close collaboration with cybersecurity, fraud, compliance, or legal teams

  • A track record of delivering measurable improvements in account access, authentication completion, customer effort, or protection outcomes while balancing usability, security, and fraud-prevention objectives

  • Experience developing repeatable AI-supported workflows that improve the speed or quality of product work, paired with sound judgment about when human review and validation are essential

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$96,100.00 - $135,700.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

***For remote and hybrid positions you will be required to provide reliable high-speed internet with a wired connection as well as a place in your home to work with limited disruption. raw.description:
Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.


🚀 Our Story

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly.

Note: This position is remote-based in the Philippines.

🖍️ This role

As an Auto Parts Data Specialist at Partly, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of vehicle data across our organisation. Your primary responsibility will be to conduct comprehensive research, manage our automotive parts data standard, and correct any errors or inconsistencies. This role reports to the Data Quality Lead and offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to maintaining the highest standards of automotive data quality in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

💻 What will you do

  • Become an expert at understanding, interpreting, and standardising automotive manufacturer parts catalog information.

  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, and inaccuracies in vehicle and parts data, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality and integrity.

  • Conduct thorough data validation and verification processes to ensure compliance with established standards, resolving any discrepancies or issues promptly.

  • Collaborate with engineering and development teams to define and implement data quality assurance procedures and workflows, incorporating feedback from internal and external sources.

  • Continuously monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of data management processes, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

  • Work alongside other team members and stakeholders on data management best practices, ensuring a consistent understanding and application of data standards and quality control procedures.

🥷 Your skills

  • Strong knowledge of automotive systems, components, and specifications, with a focus on auto parts data research and management.

  • Proven experience in a similar role within the automotive industry, with a track record of successfully managing parts data and ensuring data quality.

  • Attention to detail and a systematic approach to data research and validation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data inconsistencies, diagnose root causes, and propose effective solutions.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, enabling effective engagement with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • A passion for data accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement, with a commitment to maintaining high standards of parts data quality.

Please note: if you don't have all the skills or experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many people count themselves out. We'd love the chance to learn more about you and why you're exceptional.

🎡 Benefits

  • Healthy, Catered Lunches - Enjoy fresh, healthy lunches every workday in our Auckland, Christchurch, London, and Austin offices. With no meal prep needed, you can eat, connect, and refuel with your team. (And yes, snacks and drinks are always on hand.)

  • Healthy Body, Healthy Mind - We care about performing at our peak. Every team member gets a $1,500 annual wellness allowance (or local equivalent) on a Partly-branded card. Use it on things such as gym memberships, rock climbing, physical therapy, massage, doctor visits, prescriptions—anything that you or your family need!

  • Family Comes First - Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work plan (four days a week at full pay for your first three months back).

  • Getting Here Is On Us - If you commute to a Partly office or coworking space, choose from a paid 24/7 parking spot or a commuting allowance. One less thing to think about!

  • Workspaces That Inspire - Our brand-new, architecturally designed offices are built for collaboration and creativity, with great coffee, social spaces, and some of the best cafes just a few steps away.

  • Office-First with Flexibility - In cities where we have an office (Christchurch, Auckland, London, and San Francisco), we default to working from the office every day. This lets us move faster, make better decisions, and build strong relationships. We also operate with a high-trust environment, so you can manage your time around your life and flex your schedule to do your best work.

  • We Celebrate Together - From weekly happy hours and monthly lunches to quarterly season openers and an annual global offsite, we make time to connect, celebrate, and have fun as one team.

In this role, you will work as part of a highly technical team responsible for maintaining and continuously improving CSG's public cloud security framework across multiple cloud providers. You will also serve as a technical resource, providing guidance and expertise to teams across the organization to help address cloud security challenges. Additionally, you will support security operations by participating in the organization's incident response activities and responding to security events as needed.

We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer who will:

  • Identify and define security system requirements to support CSG's public cloud security framework.
  • Analyze security systems and identify opportunities for improvement through automation and other technical solutions.
  • Develop, document, and maintain security standards, technical documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Tune, filter, and customize security systems in collaboration with Information Security Analysts.
  • Participate in audit, compliance, and regulatory activities, including, but not limited to, Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), state and federal privacy laws, and general security audits.
  • Participate in the organization's incident response plan, including reviewing, analyzing, and responding to security events and incidents as needed.
  • Organize and coordinate small to medium-sized security projects, develop basic project plans based on requirements analysis, and communicate project status to leadership and management, including accomplishments, challenges, impediments, and key metrics.
  • Stay current on cloud security trends and best practices to support the ongoing improvement of CSG's public cloud security framework.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in public cloud security, consulting with team members and stakeholders across the organization to provide guidance and help resolve basic to moderately complex cloud security challenges.
  • Analyze, assess, develop, implement, troubleshoot, and maintain basic to moderately complex commercial, cloud-native, and open-source security solutions.
  • Work outside normal business hours as needed to diagnose issues and implement product releases or changes without disrupting normal business operations.

Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience working extensively in information security or highly technical IT fields.
  • Experience with one or more of the following programming or scripting languages: C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, PowerShell, or Ruby. Python experience preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of AWS and Azure public cloud environments.
  • Ability to configure, deploy, and maintain a cloud security posture management (CSPM) solution.
  • Strong knowledge of public cloud infrastructure, security architectures, and industry standards.
  • Ability to evaluate cloud architectures and identify applicable security requirements and best practices.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and debug source code to achieve desired code execution.
  • Understanding of current threats to cloud and IT infrastructure, with the ability to communicate security risks at both technical and management levels.
  • Experience across the incident response lifecycle, including security system engineering, alert monitoring, triage, incident analysis (host and network forensics, malware analysis, etc.), and incident management.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP and the ability to demonstrate a technical understanding of all layers of the TCP/IP stack. Familiarity with major application-layer protocols, including HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, FTPS, SMTP, and DNS. Ability to read and understand packet traces and interpret network access control lists.
  • Understanding of network and application attacks, including DoS/DDoS, buffer overflows, SQL injection, reconnaissance scanning, and techniques attackers use to evade detection. Familiarity with well-known vulnerabilities and exploits.
  • Working knowledge of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, such as Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and state and federal privacy laws.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English in a business environment.

Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

 

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. 
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

What You’ll Do

The Associate Director, Patient Advocacy,Skeletal Dysplasia will develop and execute patient advocacy activities that support BridgeBio’s work in skeletal dysplasia, primarily focusing on Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, and requires fluency in both Portuguese and Spanish. The role has responsibility for the development and execution of the skeletal dysplasia patient advocacy activities in support of clinical development and commercialisation, while safeguarding long-term patient trust and community relationships in support to the Global and International Patient Advocacy strategy

Reporting to the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy, this role drives engagement across the skeletal dysplasia community in Latin America, Europe and supports other relevant international and local markets as needed, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making. The Associate Director supports the development of external international partnerships and advocacy and educational initiatives, strengthening meaningful outreach across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison to patient advocacy organizations in Latin America, Europe and other international markets as needed, establishing and strengthening compliant, long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and alignment
  • Support the development of the patient advocacy strategy and implement an international patient advocacy plan for skeletal dysplasia, aligned with the international plan and local priorities
  • Represent BridgeBio at patient advocacy and community meetings across Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, building and strengthening relationships with patient organizations and local communities
  • Bring patient and caregiver perspectives into clinical development, medical affairs, regulatory, market access, and commercial planning, as appropriate to the stage of each program
  • Plan and deliver appropriate engagement activities, such as advisory boards, patient organization meetings, educational initiatives, community surveys, patient videos and opportunities to provide input on patient-facing materials
  • Adapt engagement and communications for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking and other international communities, ensuring materials and interactions are culturally relevant and accessible
  • Support the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy in strategic planning and oversight of advocacy-related budgets, including grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and educational initiatives
  • Work with local and international teams to understand differences in care pathways, access barriers, community priorities, and advocacy environments across international markets
  • Coordinate international grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and program budgets in line with applicable policies and local requirements
  • Share clear, actionable community insights with internal partners while protecting individual privacy, preserving patient trust, and maintaining appropriate boundaries
  • Monitor and report changes in relevant policies and industry requirements for patient organization engagement and ensure external activities meet company standards and local laws
  • Promote a patient-first culture by communicating patient and caregiver perspectives, unmet needs, and appropriately consented stories and imagery through internal activities and company materials
  • Strengthen BridgeBio’s role as a trusted partner in the skeletal dysplasia advocacy community through presentations and participation in relevant external forums

Where You Will Work

  • This role is based in Europe
  • Frequent travel across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies is required; travel will vary with community and business needs

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a scientific field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of patient advocacy or community engagement experience, including 3+ years within biotech/pharma.
  • Experience working with rare disease communities; experience with skeletal dysplasia or other genetic rare conditions is preferred.
  • Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is required to engage effectively with patient communities and partners in both languages. Strong professional English is also essential for international collaboration. Knowledge of German and French is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with patient organizations across countries and cultures, ideally including Latin America.
  • Understanding of patient engagement requirements, healthcare systems, and access considerations across international markets; familiarity with Europe and Latin American markets is preferred.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a matrixed organization.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies.

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible

We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

  • Market-leading compensation.
  • Remote/Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community.
  • We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs.
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location. We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles:

Financial & Rewards

  • Market-leading compensation
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit and parking)
  • Referral bonus for hired candidates
  • Subsidized lunch and parking on in-office days

Health & Well-Being

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Fertility & family-forming benefits
  • Expanded mental health support (therapy and coaching resources)
  • Hybrid work model with flexibility
  • Flexible, “take-what-you-need” paid time off and company-paid holidays
  • Comprehensive paid medical and parental leave to care for yourself and your family

Skill Development & Career Paths:

  • People are part of our growth and success story - from discovery to active drug trials and FDA pipelines, there are endless opportunities for skill development and internal mobility
  • We provide career pathing through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs via LinkedIn Learning, LifeLabs, & BetterUp Coaching

raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍London/UK Remote | 💰 £56,100 - 75,900 (depending on your experience) + Incentive Award tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Finance team

We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Treasury product control analyst to join our Financial operations & control team. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant looking for a first-time move from practice to industry and/or who has an understanding of Treasury products in the context of a banking environment. This understanding includes but is not exhaustive to Treasury investment securities, derivative instruments (interest rate swaps and FX forwards), hedge accounting and financial reporting.

We have some really exciting challenges coming up like continued expansion into the European Union, growing our customer base, keep growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. This all leads to exciting Treasury activity to support this growth whilst managing risk. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Head of Treasury Product Control.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

  • Working very closely with our Treasury front office, treasury operations and financial control teams as we continue to build our treasury product control capabilities in Finance.
  • Taking ownership of the end-to-end control processes on Treasury products. This includes:
    • Independent trade confirmation for all Treasury deals booked in our Treasury Management System (TMS)
    • Daily collateral management for our derivative and REPO portfolios
    • Daily profit and loss reporting on Treasury income to CFO/Treasuer
    • Valuation controls around Treasury financial instrument pricing
  • Managing Treasury month-end processes, including derivatives and hedge accounting.
  • Maintaining existing and developing new treasury related internal controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process, working with 2LoD and 3LoD along the way.
  • Supporting our year end processes, preparing Treasury related disclosures, dealing with external audit queries and ad hoc assistance on non-Treasury related aspects of the cycle.
  • Understanding the Treasury business and their products to write insightful management commentary on results.
  • Reviewing new Treasury products, assessing and determining the accounting treatment before implementing the GL configuration mapping in our TMS.
  • Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of this role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.
  • Learning SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
  • Ad hoc support on non-Treasury related initiatives.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you..

  • You’re a qualified accountant and have knowledge and/or understanding of Treasury products in a banking context.
  • You have a great eye for detail and a thirst to learn, which sees you develop into the subject matter for all things Treasury.
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key internal controls.
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s confirming trade accuracy or pulling together complex disclosures in a simplified way for derivatives in our annual report.
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.
  • You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus).
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

raw.excerpt: Lead Product Designer Full-time · Remote-friendly (Amsterdam, Cape Town) ABOUT CAPCADE Capcade is building the collaboration infrastructure for private markets.
raw.description:
Lead Product Designer

Full-time · Remote-friendly (Amsterdam, Cape Town)

ABOUT CAPCADE

Capcade is building the collaboration infrastructure for private markets. Fund managers, investors, and the service providers around them run their most important work across scattered tools and email threads. That work covers fundraising, due diligence, investor onboarding, post-close reporting, and structured-product programmes. We replace all of it with one secure, structured environment where people, documents, data, and tasks live in the same place.

We run the operational side of private funds: the entities, documents, workflows and reporting that sit between a fund manager, their administrator and their investors. The people using Capcade aren’t there to enjoy software. They are there to close something, prove something or answer to someone. Design here is about making consequential work clear, fast and hard to get wrong.

Many of the best names in global finance already use the platform, including hundreds of the Fortune 500. We are a team of around 50 people across seven jurisdictions. That’s small enough that your work shows up the week you ship it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are turning investor (LP) reporting into a product of its own, and we’re building a set of fund management products around it. We want a lead designer to own that area.

You will lead design for LP reporting from start to finish. You will shape what the product is together with product management, not only how it looks. As new fund management products arrive, such as fundraising and investor onboarding, you will make sure they work as one experience rather than as separate tools.

You will report to our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with our product designer, who leads design on our other products.

This is a hands-on lead role. You will be in the work every day: prototyping, testing and shipping. You will also help shape how design works as the team grows.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own LP reporting design from start to finish. Run discovery, prototyping and testing with fund managers and investors, and stay involved through to what ships.
  • Connect the fund management products. Bring the same approach to fundraising, investor onboarding and the products that follow, so users experience them as one product.
  • Prototype in code. We build proposed changes as working prototypes behind feature flags rather than static mock-ups, and we test them with real users before they’re built. You’ll use AI tools like Claude Code daily to do this.
  • Run your own research. Plan and moderate usability sessions with internal users, clients and design partners. Write up what you find as evidence the team can act on.
  • Get design in early. Work alongside product and engineering from the start of scoping, and make the case for the user before the work is decided.
  • Write it down. Turn decisions into design-system patterns and specs so the next team doesn’t have to make them again.
  • Help build the team. Mentor designers, run critique sessions, and help shape how design works as we grow.

HOW WE WILL MEASURE SUCCESS

This is what good looks like in your first 90 days:

  • An LP reporting prototype tested with at least three fund managers.
  • The main user flows in your area mapped and walked through, with the friction in each one recorded.
  • Design involved in scoping LP reporting from the start.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 7+ years designing complex, data-heavy B2B products, ideally reporting, dashboards or analytics.
  • Experience owning a product’s design from start to finish, including shaping what gets built, not only the interface.
  • Comfort prototyping in code (for example React, Next.js or Tailwind), or a clear track record of picking up tools like these quickly.
  • Hands-on research experience: you’ve planned, run and synthesised your own usability testing.
  • Confidence holding a design position with product and engineering, backed by evidence.
  • Clear writing. You document your decisions as a matter of course.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in fund administration, private markets, fintech, or another regulated, document-heavy area. You can learn the domain here.
  • Design-system experience, such as tokens, component libraries or Storybook.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other designers.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A base salary benchmarked to your location and in line with the market for this level of seniority.
  • An annual equity grant that vests over four years. This is real ownership in a company still small enough for your work to move its value.
  • Ownership of a product area that is being built now, with a real say in what it becomes.
  • 25 days of paid holiday, remote-friendly working, and the latest modern tools.
  • Honest, regular feedback, and great colleagues who are good at their jobs.

The product is growing quickly, the AI landscape moves even faster, and our users expect a lot. You will need to enjoy working in that kind of environment.

We are not offering relocation or visa sponsorship, so you will need the existing right to work where you are based.

HOW TO APPLY

Send us your CV and a link to your portfolio. We especially want to see work on data-heavy products, reporting or dashboards, and any coded prototypes or experiments.

By submitting your application and CV, you consent to the processing of your personal data in accordance with the Law on Personal Data Protection (you can find our Recruiting Privacy Policy here).

Specialisation: Workplace Transformation / EUC

Engagement: 6-Month Contract / Fixed-Term Contract (FTC)

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Microsoft 365 Architect to lead the end-to-end technical architecture and delivery assurance of a large-scale enterprise Workplace Transformation programme.

The role will focus on End User Computing (EUC), Microsoft 365, tenant-to-tenant migration, Active Directory consolidation, hybrid identity and endpoint migration.

This is a hands-on technical architecture role requiring strong expertise in solution design, migration strategy, technical governance, configuration validation and complex troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture for the EUC workstream.
  • Design and oversee Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant and Active Directory migrations.
  • Lead architecture across Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive.
  • Design hybrid identity, authentication, coexistence, cutover and rollback strategies.
  • Oversee Windows endpoint and device migration using Intune, Autopilot and Hybrid Entra Join.
  • Review technical designs, configurations, scripts, migration plans and implementation runbooks.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and resolution of complex migration issues.
  • Establish architecture governance, technical standards and migration readiness controls.
  • Manage technical dependencies across network, security, applications, cloud and infrastructure teams.
  • Provide technical direction to engineering teams and third-party migration vendors.

Mandatory Technical Skills

  • Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams and OneDrive.
  • Microsoft Entra ID: Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, hybrid identity, MFA and Conditional Access.
  • Active Directory: Forest/domain migrations, trusts, DNS, Group Policy, Kerberos, LDAP/LDAPS, replication and SIDHistory.
  • Endpoint Management: Microsoft Intune, Windows 10/11, Autopilot and Hybrid Entra Join.
  • Migration Expertise: Tenant-to-tenant, cross-forest/domain and large-scale endpoint migrations.
  • Automation: Advanced PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and scripting.
  • Migration Tools: AvePoint Fly – configuration, mappings, permissions and migration validation.
  • Strong troubleshooting across identity, endpoint, Microsoft 365 and migration environments.

Experience Required

  • 10+ years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure and workplace technologies.
  • Minimum 5+ years designing Microsoft 365 and modern workplace solutions.
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise migrations involving thousands of users and devices.
  • Strong experience in complex hybrid Microsoft environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve cross-platform technical issues.
  • Experience providing technical leadership to engineering teams and external migration vendors.

Desirable Skills

  • Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert.
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Identity and Access Administrator Associate.
  • Endpoint Administrator Associate.
  • Experience in M&A, divestment and regulated environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be a hands-on technical architect with strong end-to-end migration ownership, excellent problem-solving capabilities and the ability to challenge technical designs, validate implementations and ensure successful enterprise workplace transformation.

Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume along with current location, Australian work rights, notice period and availability.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101656

Position Overview

Design and manufacturing is being rewritten right now. AI is moving from a feature bullet to the way work actually gets done, and the companies that make things (job shops, contract manufacturers, OEMs, product teams) are deciding what to believe about it. We're looking for a Director of Product & Technical Marketing to own that story for our D&M portfolio. This is a builder's role. You'll lead a small, high-leverage team responsible for positioning, technical narrative, launch across the D&M portfolio. You'll also be expected to change how product marketing gets done here: faster cycles, fewer artifacts nobody reads, AI in the workflow rather than just in the messaging, and a much tighter loop between what Product teams build and what the market hears.

Responsibilities

  • Own positioning and messaging for the D&M portfolio, from the top-level narrative down to feature-level proof points that stand up in front of a manufacturing engineer
  • Lead product and technical launches end to end: narrative, packaging inputs, launch tiering, assets, enablement, and post-launch measurement against pipeline and adoption
  • Build the technical layer of marketing that this audience demands. Demos, benchmarks, workflow walkthroughs, competitive teardowns, and content that earns credibility with people who evaluate software by running their own parts through it
  • Translate AI capability into customer value. Cut through the noise with concrete, defensible claims about what our AI does for a shop's throughput, a designer's iteration speed, and an engineering team's cost of change
  • Rebuild how the function operates. Bring AI into the team's own workflow (research, competitive monitoring, content production, message testing) so a small team ships at the volume of a large one
  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, Digital, and Demand Gen to connect the story to the motion, across self-serve, e-commerce, and sales-assisted paths Partner with competitive intelligence for the category and turn it into displacement messaging and battlecards for sellers
  • Hire, coach, and raise the bar on a team of product and technical marketers

Minimum Qualifications

  • Deep manufacturing industry knowledge. You understand how parts get designed, quoted, programmed, and made. You can hold a credible conversation about CAD/CAM workflows, machining, production planning, or the realities of a small shop floor, and you know why that credibility is non-negotiable with this audience
  • An AI-forward approach to the craft. You've shipped AI-powered products and, just as importantly, you've rebuilt your own team's workflow around AI tooling. You're skeptical of hype and fluent in substance
  • A track record with scrappy teams. You've operated with more ambition than headcount, and you've changed how product marketing is done somewhere: new operating model, new content engine, new relationship with Product or Sales. You can point to what you dismantled, not just what you added
  • Strong technical storytelling. You can go from an exec keynote narrative to a demo script without handing either to someone else
  • Comfort with data. You define success in pipeline, conversion, and adoption terms, and you can defend the numbers
  • Excellent executive communication and the judgment to know when to push back


Preferred Qualifications

  • Go-to-market experience beyond core PMM: pricing and packaging, segmentation, channel or e-commerce motions, or owning a launch P&L
  • Experience marketing to both individual practitioners and enterprise buyers in the same portfolio
  • Hands-on familiarity with design and manufacturing software as a user

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting


Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $159,000 and $284,350. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.


Belonging

raw.description:
Are you obsessed with owning marketing outcomes, not just marketing tasks?

What if your campaigns didn't just hit a KPI, but shaped how millions of people grow, learn, and act on their potential?

This isn't a "manage an agency and report up" marketing job.

We're not looking for someone who orchestrates other people's execution. We're looking for someone who runs the campaigns themselves, leveraging AI to operate at the scale of a full marketing team.

And you deserve it because you are…

  • 🛠️ You're not "a marketing manager who briefs agencies." You're a builder. You see an opportunity and your hands itch to write the campaign, launch it, and read the results yourself.

  • 🤖 You don't fear AI, you leverage it. Claude Code, prompt pipelines, and automation tools are core to how you work, you treat AI as a team of interns that lets you run what used to require five hires.

  • ⚡️ You'd rather launch a scrappy campaign this week than a perfect plan next quarter. Bias to action is your default setting.

  • 📊 You make decisions with data. You can read performance across channels, kill what doesn't work fast, and double down on what does.

3–5 years under your belt, ready to own marketing outcomes end to end in a startup.

Full-time, remote or Dubai office. French and English fluency required.

About Paradox

WHAT WE DO

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Own marketing performance across channels, not as a coordinator, but as an operator. You set the strategy, but you also execute it, using AI leverage to punch well above the size of your team.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Own channel strategy & execution : You set priorities across paid, organic, and lifecycle marketing, and you execute the core of it yourself rather than fully delegating.

  2. Run campaigns hands-on : Briefs, copy, targeting, launch, analysis. You touch the full loop, not just the strategy slide.

  3. AI leverage : You leverage Claude Code daily to build campaign assets, automate reporting, generate creative variations, and run processes that would otherwise require a full team. This is expected, not optional.

  4. Read the data & reallocate fast : You live in GA4, ad platforms, and Looker Studio. You reallocate budget/effort toward what compounds within days, not months.

  5. Coordinate the extended team : You brief and align Growth, Social, and Content Factory efforts so channels reinforce each other instead of working in silos.

  6. Report outcomes, not activity : You bring data-backed recommendations to leadership, not just a status update.

You'll own KPIs: CAC/LTV by channel, pipeline/revenue attributable to marketing, campaign velocity (launches per month).

Desired outcomes: A marketing engine that runs lean, compounds over time, and doesn't require headcount growth to scale output.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?

Experience

  • 3–5 years in marketing, ideally with both strategic and hands-on execution experience (not pure agency-management background).

  • You can show us what you've built and shipped : tests, landing pages, automations, audiences. Portfolio > pedigree. A scrappy before/after beats a polished CV.

  • You already use AI daily to create leverage and solve complex issues.

Personality

  • Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data.

  • Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief.

  • Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results.

  • Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  1. You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind.

  2. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place.

  3. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I started my company.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Impact & Meaning

->Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people

->Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

-> ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers

But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

-> 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

-> 🗽Flexible working hours

-> 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

-> 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :)

HIRING PROCESS 📃

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey.

💻 A 15-30 minutes video call, to assess the fit between the position, the company, and your own career path.
💻 A video-call focused on your career to review your background & see how we can match your desires with our needs.
💻 Aculture-fit video call to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture.
💼 Reference calls to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players.
🤗 Welcome aboard!

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.
If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

The Staff Hybrid Cloud Engineer serves as a senior technical authority within the Hybrid Cloud Engineering team, providing technical ownership across multiple cloud platforms, engineering domains, and infrastructure capabilities. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing secure, scalable, automated, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions while establishing engineering standards and architectural practices across the organization. The Staff Hybrid Cloud Engineer leads complex, cross-functional initiatives, drives the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and platform engineering practices, and ensures hybrid-cloud technologies align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and operational requirements. This position provides technical direction across engineering teams, influences architectural decisions, and promotes consistency, automation, reliability, and continuous improvement throughout the infrastructure environment

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
