Design and support virtualization, containerized, and cloud-native environments. Establish and improve CI/CD, source-control, release-management, and deployment practices using GitHub Actions and Spacelift, or comparable platforms. Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, APIs, and other appropriate scripting or programming technologies. Establish and improve monitoring, logging, and observability practices using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or comparable technologies. Lead technical initiatives involving cloud migrations, modernization, platform upgrades, infrastructure automation, architectural improvements, and integration across multiple infrastructure environments. Partner with Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, Security, Networking, Development, Application, and other technology teams to ensure platforms and services meet organizational requirements. Identify and address systemic technical debt, architectural gaps, security risks, reliability concerns, performance limitations, and operational inefficiencies across multiple engineering domains. Participate in cloud financial management, cost optimization, capacity planning, resource utilization, and lifecycle management to promote efficient and sustainable infrastructure operations. Provide technical leadership, design reviews, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to Engineers, Senior Engineers, Lead Engineers, and other technical resources. Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues spanning multiple platforms or engineering domains, including critical incidents, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption, modernization, standardization, or retirement based on technical suitability, business value, security, reliability, and operational requirements. Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical standards, design documents, architectural decision records, runbooks, operating procedures, and other engineering documentation.

NONESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Participate in technology evaluations, proofs of concept, vendor assessments, and strategic infrastructure planning initiatives. Assist with long-term capacity planning, technology roadmaps, financial optimization, and platform lifecycle management. Represent Hybrid Cloud Engineering in cross-functional architecture, governance, security, and technology initiatives. Participate in engineering knowledge-sharing activities and contribute to organizational technical standards and continuous improvement. Perform other duties and participate in technology initiatives as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Advanced technical expertise across multiple hybrid-cloud engineering domains, including architecture, virtualization, networking, security, identity, automation, containers, observability, and reliability. Ability to establish technical direction, architectural standards, and engineering practices across multiple platforms, infrastructure capabilities, or technical focus areas. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, microservices, high availability, disaster recovery, resiliency, and failure-domain planning. Advanced ability to design, implement, troubleshoot, and govern Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable technologies. Ability to design and troubleshoot complex hybrid-cloud networking, connectivity, routing, DNS, network segmentation, and security configurations. Strong understanding of security principles, including IAM, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, key management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-design practices. Ability to design and support virtualization, container orchestration, cloud-native applications, and platform services. Ability to establish and improve CI/CD, source-control, release-management, and automated deployment practices. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Go. Ability to establish monitoring, observability, alerting, and operational reliability practices across platforms and services. Ability to identify and resolve complex architectural, security, reliability, scalability, and operational problems spanning multiple technical domains. Ability to lead complex cross-functional technical initiatives and provide technical direction without relying on direct management authority. Ability to review technical designs, evaluate tradeoffs, establish standards, and influence architectural decisions across engineering teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, documentation, mentoring, and technical leadership skills. Ability to manage competing technical priorities and work effectively in Agile, Kanban, or product-oriented engineering environments. Ability to independently design and troubleshoot hybrid-cloud networking, DNS, routing, and security configurations. Strong knowledge of IAM, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, vulnerability management, and secure-by-design practices. Experience with virtualization, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and related platform technologies. Strong understanding of CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and release-management practices. Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or comparable scripting and programming languages. Ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues using monitoring, logs, metrics, and technical diagnostics. Ability to independently own technical delivery while exercising sound escalation judgment. Strong analytical, documentation, communication, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE, AND/OR EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical discipline, including demonstrated technical ownership across multiple platforms, engineering domains, or technical focus areas. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent professional work experience, technical training, certifications, or a combination thereof may be considered in lieu of formal education. Minimum of 6 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, automating, and supporting production cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps engineering practices. Extensive experience with one or more major public-cloud platforms, preferably AWS. Experience with private-cloud and virtualization technologies. Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable solutions. Experience designing and supporting hybrid-cloud networking, connectivity, identity and access management, security, high availability, disaster recovery, and resilient infrastructure architectures. Experience implementing CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions and Spacelift, or comparable technologies. Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or comparable solutions. Experience developing infrastructure automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or comparable scripting and programming languages. Demonstrated experience establishing technical architecture, engineering standards, automation strategies, and technical direction across multiple engineering domains. Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical decisions across engineering teams. Experience working in regulated, audited, healthcare, financial services, benefits administration, or comparable environments is preferred. Professional certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or comparable cloud, DevOps, security, networking, or SRE certifications are preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why we’re hiring:

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.

As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This program exists to close that gap. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a remote role based in Germany, reporting to the Sales Engineering Manager in the Solutions Consulting department. In this role, you will serve as the technical pivot point for our sales process, presenting the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers and translating their business goals into enticing, high-impact recommendations. Job description:

The Guestbook is the world's largest and fastest-growing loyalty program for independent and boutique brand hotels. To grow our hotel partner network across Asia-Pacific (APAC), we are in search of a Regional Development Manager who will be the consistent face of The Guestbook for hotels across APAC, from first conversation to long-term partnership.

This role will focus on developing and growing hotel partnerships across APAC, from first conversation to long-term success. You will engage hotel leads supplied by our lead generation team through outreach campaigns, book demos, and hand qualified opportunities to our Partnerships Team. As hotels join the program, you will onboard and train them, run regular performance reviews, and help them grow their direct booking revenue.

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Southeast Asia, such as Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, or the Philippines. Candidates must have the right to work in their country of residence and be able to travel within APAC for business. This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Partner & Member Experience.

What you'll do:

·Build a strong APAC pipeline by running multi-touch outreach campaigns to hotel leads, using email, phone, LinkedIn, and campaign-specific messaging

·Follow up consistently with leads provided by our Lead Generation Team to build interest in the program

·Tailor outreach to local markets, languages, and hotel segments across APAC

·Qualify hotels on fit, needs, and decision-making process

·Schedule demos and prepare the Partnerships Team with clear context on each opportunity

·Deliver introductory product overviews and early-stage demos where appropriate

·Hand off qualified opportunities to the Partnerships Team smoothly, with complete notes in our CRM

·Track campaign performance, including response, meeting, and conversion rates, and continuously improve messaging and targeting

·Serve as the primary contact for onboarding new APAC hotel partners, training platform end users, and providing post go-live support

·Work with our Product and Development Teams to configure the platform to each partner’s requirements and resolve technical issues

·Build credibility and partner confidence through regular communication, virtual and in-person visits, and performance reviews

·Implement direct booking strategies and share data-driven insights that help partners maximize revenue and get the most from the platform

·Increase retention of accounts, and collaborate with the Partnerships Team to support renewals and expansion opportunities

·Recommend revenue strategies and best practices as each partnership matures, drawing on deep product and industry knowledge

·Gather feedback and represent the voice of APAC hotel partners in decisions across the Product, Marketing, and Partnerships Teams

·Identify partners who can act as Guestbook advocates through testimonials, case studies, and referrals

·Travel from time to time for regional tradeshows, conferences, hotel association events, partner visits, and Team meetings

What you'll bring:

·3+ years of experience in sales development, customer success, account management, business development, or another client-facing role

·Proven experience running outreach campaigns, following up on leads, and booking meetings or demos

·Experience managing a portfolio of accounts, including onboarding, training, and performance reviews

·Experience working with customers across multiple countries in APAC

·Fluent business English, plus fluency in at least one additional Asian language such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Malay, Thai, Korean, Vietnamese, or Japanese

·Excellent written and verbal communication, with confidence presenting to hotel owners, general managers, revenue teams, and marketing teams

·Comfort with a CRM and outreach tools, and the discipline to keep records accurate and up to date

·Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear, visually appealing recommendations

·Self-starter with an owner mentality who thrives in an entrepreneurial, remote environment

·Empathetic, positive attitude with a genuine desire to help partners reach their goals

·Hotel operations background or experience in hospitality technology, such as PMS, booking engines, or revenue management tools, is a plus

·Familiarity with direct booking, loyalty, or guest marketing strategies for independent hotels is a plus

·An existing network among APAC hotel owners, management companies, or hotel associations is a plus

·Additional Asian languages beyond the one required are a plus

raw.description:
🌎 About Us

TeamSnap is made up of innovators, technologists, builders, and problem-solvers shaping the future of youth sports. We’ve been setting the standard in youth sports technology since we were founded in 2009.

We hire for big ideas and tiny egos — which is part of how we landed on Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work, Built In's 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work and, for several years running, Sports Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in Sports.

TeamSnap is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) interested in working across the stack to join our fully distributed engineering team to help us continue our impressive growth from 2+ million daily active users to beyond! Our stack primarily includes Node.js, TypeScript, Elixir and SQL.

As an engineering team, we design and build scalable systems using a service-oriented and event-driven architecture that serve millions of daily users and some of the largest youth and amateur sports organizations in the world. Our team values collaboration in a remote culture, so we regularly participate in pair sessions and virtual team swarms to stay connected and improve the team and company.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop engaging experiences for our millions of users across our mobile and web applications.

  • Design and implement scalable apps and services, integrating these into an evolving unified product and system architecture.

  • Brainstorm and evaluate new product features in collaboration with the product and UX team.

  • Collaborate and pair with other developers to develop solutions and teach technical skills.

  • Contribute to our development standards within the team and across engineering to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Champion and implement automated testing practices to uphold the dependability and stability of backend systems, while also taking ownership of the overall reliability of the team's services.

  • Actively engage in on-call responsibilities and contribute to incident management efforts.

  • Evaluate and test new technologies to help TeamSnap move faster or serve our users more effectively.

  • Help teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work tasks.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, leading large projects on high-scale, distributed software systems as a software engineer

  • Proficient in backend development with Node, Python, Golang, Ruby or similar.

  • Experience with direct usage of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL / GCP Cloud SQL along with migrations, profiling, and optimization of such databases.

  • Hands-on experience developing APIs, services for mobile applications and web clients at scale.

  • Successfully delivered complex projects including debugging problems that may span a number of systems.

  • Experience working with and architecting APIs, event streams, webhooks, etc.

  • Experience working within and towards a distributed system.

  • Extra points if you’ve built services for livestreaming, advertising, or subscriptions.

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $150,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

🖥 Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you'll need to be comfortable working with people in other time zones.

We're always expanding, but we can't currently hire in Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Utah. We can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow

We work hard on a culture built on trust, accountability, and inclusion — one where you can take on more, make a lasting impact, and have some fun doing it.

🎩 Total Rewards

  • Remote-first since 2009
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • 100% premium coverage of medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • 401(k) to invest in your future
  • $1,500 annual learning and development reimbursement
  • Travel to all-company meetings and team events
  • Generous home office allowance
  • TeamSnap swag when you start, plus a $50 store credit on every work anniversary
  • Monthly health and wellness reimbursement, and more
  • TeamSnap Total Rewards
🏆 Award-winning Culture

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit – you're a culture add. Read our Culture Playbook to see how we play, what we ask of each other, and what drives us.

🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation don't come from cookie-cutter teams. We hold ourselves accountable for building a culture where everyone is valued.

Need any accommodations during the interview process? Just ask. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

AI Notice

We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and resumes or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team; they don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people. Contact us if you'd like more information about how your data is processed.

raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Handles incoming leads for large groups (e.g.,0-50 room nights) and catering leads for hotels supported by the Canada Sales Office, in an assigned geographic area. Works with customers to align customer preferences with brand needs and actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenues and drive customer loyalty. Verifies that business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for quality service delivery. Drives customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred:

  • Experience selling large group business experience, either at a property or in a sales office.
  • Knowledge of the group sales process for all brands and how to close a sale.

• Team-based selling experience.

• Hospitality Management Degree.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

  • Responds in a timely manner to incoming large group/catering opportunities that are within the parameters of the Group Sales team within the Sales Office.
  • Refers opportunities to appropriate sales associate if business is outside the Group Sales parameters.
  • Understands the overall market (e.g., competitors’ strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand) and how to sell against them.
  • Verifies that business booked is within hotel parameters.
  • Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
  • Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
  • Transfers accurate, complete, and timely information to property in accordance with brand standards.
  • Up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue for individual properties.
  • Understands and utilizes company marketing initiative/incentives to close on business.
  • Follows up on opportunities uncovered by sales executives.
  • Implements process improvements and best practices.
  • Leverages other Group Sales resources and administrative/support staff to achieve related revenue goals.
  • Works with customers to align customer preferences with brand needs and actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenues and drive customer loyalty.
  • Verifies that business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for quality service delivery.
  • Handles incoming leads for groups (e.g.,0-50 room nights).
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Works collaboratively with other sales channels (e.g., Market Sales, on-property resources) to establish coordinated sales efforts that are complementary and not duplicative.
  • Drives customer loyalty through excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
  • Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending appropriate features and services that best meet their needs.
  • Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
  • Builds and maintains strong working relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Creates clear expectations for customers and properties throughout the sales process.
  • Resolves guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process.
  • Brings issues to the attention of Property and Group Sales leadership teams as appropriate.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. raw.description:
What makes Gartner for Finance Leaders a GREAT fit for you?

When you join Gartner for Finance Leaders, you’ll set your career on track for outstanding achievement with a company that knows no limits. We’re the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Gartner Executive Finance Partners serve as trusted advisors to our members (clients) who are CFOs from Global 1000 organizations and government agencies.

Our Associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional career development as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team, Gartner is where you want to be.

About this role:

We are specifically looking for a current or prior Federal Government CFO to join the team and provide their expertise and guidance to a portfolio of members operating in the same space.

The Executive Finance Partner’s (EFP) role is to engage each member-client, and to help them identify key initiatives to achieve specific enterprise goals.

Partnering with the member can include activities such as: defining, developing, coaching and/or critiquing strategies; helping develop and/or transform their organizations; assisting/advising with the development and execution of vision & strategy; aggregating and delivering Gartner research insights on key initiatives, priorities, and implementations; and in general, becoming a trusted advisor for the client CFO. With the support of their Executive Partner, our clients are able to achieve their goals quicker and more cost effectively and with a higher assurance of success.

What you’ll do:

Relationship Management

The Executive Partner manages a portfolio of senior executive member relationships and participates in account planning with Senior Client Managers and Senior Account Executives. These three roles collectively and individually have responsibility for each assigned account.

The Executive Partner participates in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal.

The Executive Partner conducts monthly consultations with the CFO client, brings the power of Gartner’s service, research and advisory to each client, conducts workshops for the client member, leads CFO activities at the annual Gartner Finance Executive Conference and leads CFO breakout sessions during annual Finance Forums.

Program Delivery

  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Gartner Sales strategy and Gartner Finance product deliverables.

  • Work with members across the Federal Government to further their levels of Finance maturity through delivery of research, peer networking, and coaching.

  • Critique client strategies, guide clients in building their organizations, and assist in developing Finance strategies, establishing priorities, and planning for implementation around key Finance initiatives.

  • Establish and maintain working relationships with various internal groups to create a comprehensive, well designed sustainable set of key deliverables for clients (including targeted research, personal coaching sessions, scripted analyst sessions, involvement with appropriate events, etc.)

  • Direct and facilitate member peer group calls and/or meetings

Service, Sales and Marketing Support

The Executive Partner is responsible for member retention and for contributing toward growth in the region through direct support of Gartner Finance in prospect cultivation, account plan development and value demonstration activities

Virtual and in- person interactions

The Executive Partner is responsible for hosting and /or participating in periodic virtual or in-person member activities, including workshops, research analyst engagements (where appropriate), round-tables and webinars (in collaboration with Gartner Research)

Research Support

The Executive Partner supports research activities, such as facilitating member participation in research studies or case panels. The Executive Partner will be aligned with and leverage Gartner research positions and initiatives as well as provide feedback from the member base to the research organization. The Executive Partner works with research analysts to develop and deliver CFO relevant research.

Content Development and Management

  • Participate in presentations, panels and workshops

  • Participate in relevant research communities to keep topic area knowledge current and share member experiences with analysts

  • Facilitate member interaction and collaboration through the Sales community portal and assisted member connections

  • Lead and participate in local events and roundtables

What you’ll need:

Subject Matter Expertise

The Executive MUST be a Federal Government CFO (current or former) with demonstrated topic knowledge in developing and delivering overall Financial strategy, execution and performance improvement. You will have a broad base of expertise and will have operated at a executive leadership level and driven change at all levels. Must have a solid understanding of accounting and finance. Prior consulting experience is a plus.

The Executive Partner is responsible to retain clients in accordance with established Gartner Retention Metrics. In addition, to work closely with Sales to vet and close “new’ CFO business.

Key areas of coverage:

  • CFO Personal Impact and Effectiveness

  • Finance Org Structure and Finance Talent

  • ERP and Finance Technology / Digitization

  • Financial Data & Analytics

  • Cost and Capital Management

  • Solid understanding of Audit and the impact to the CFO’s company

Other requirements

  • A university graduate in Finance or Accounting; MBA is a plus

  • MUST have held the title of CFO at a Federal agency

  • d

  • Prior consulting experience is a plus

  • An in-depth understanding of the Finance Function and the role of the CFO

  • In depth understanding of the business value of Finance and Accounting and the alignment of Business and Finance strategies

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to assess member situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business advice & guidance

  • Ability to lead and manage ambiguous situations

  • Candidates must have excellent interpersonal skills; with a healthy dose of humility and experience working with C level executives. This individual should have strong reflective listening skills and the ability to adjust to client cues and needs

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills and strong facilitation and presentation skills

  • Sales savvy

  • Collaboration and ability to influence

  • Sales and / or business development experience or ability with CXO level executives

  • Strong time / project management skills / must be detail oriented

  • Initial Travel restricted to US and Canada; virtual first with potential for up to 25% travel

What we offer:

In addition to an outstanding work environment with excellent growth potential, Gartner for Finance Leaders provides exceptional compensation and benefits, including:

  • Competitive base salary

  • Annual bonus potential

  • Excellent benefits package

About Gartner:

Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading research and advisory company. We help business leaders across all major functions in every industry and enterprise size with the objective insights they need to make the right decisions.

Our comprehensive suite of services delivers strategic advice and proven best practices to help clients succeed in their mission-critical priorities. Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, USA, and has more than 13,000 associates serving clients in 11,000 enterprises in 100 countries.

For more information, visit gartner.com.

LI-Remote

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE UNITED STATES.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 188,000 USD - 225,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


What you'll be doing:

  • Manage a new segment of AI Modular Datacenter Partners by tracking metrics, results, coordinating timelines, and maintaining clear documentation that keeps internal teams and external customers aligned.
  • Closely work with AI Modular Datacenter Partners , OEM System Partners as well as cross-functional teams such as engineering, sales, and solutions architecture teams to align on Modular Datacenter requirements as well as Go-To-Market plans.
  • Analyzing AI Datacenter integration requirements, qualification and programs health metrics to identify risks, surface trends, and recommend improvements.
  • Preparing executive-ready status reports, meeting materials, and customer-facing communications that clearly convey program progress and next steps.
  • Contributing to process improvements and playbook development that scale how the team manages a new segment of AI Modular Datacenter Partners across NVIDIA's product portfolio.

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years relevant work experience required.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical or quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
  • Demonstrated experience around AI Datacenter Infrastructure, build, and deployment requirements, coordinating, or leading technical projects.
  • Proven deep customer savvy born Technical Program Manager with strong experience of performing complex programs, especially with strategic customers related to AI Datacenter infrastructure requirements, qualification, and deployment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with data, build structured summaries, and draw actionable conclusions.
  • Clear and effective written communication skills, including experience writing technical or professional documents for a non-specialist audience.
  • Familiarity with AI Tools that can help support some of the aspects of the technical project execution.
  • Interested in AI Datacenter infrastructure, or GPU/CPU computing, Networking products and eager to learn how these technologies are deployed at Enterprise scale.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Passionate about the customer experience and motivated to help organizations successfully adopt complex technical platforms.
  • Experience working external customers and across multiple teams on a shared deliverable.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, adapting priorities, and handling multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Creative problem-solver who brings a proactive and collaborative approach to challenges.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

  • Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

  • Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

  • Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

  • Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

  • Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

  • Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

  • Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

  • Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

  • High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

  • Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Design Tools

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

  • Obsesses over clarity, consistency and usability.

  • Designs interfaces that reduce friction and build user trust.

  • Works closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Moves quickly while maintaining a high standard of visual quality.

  • Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who focus only on aesthetics without considering usability.

  • People who copy trends without understanding user problems.

  • Designers who struggle to collaborate with product and engineering teams.

  • Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

  • Candidates who cannot clearly explain the rationale behind their design choices or their individual contributions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

Meet Instinct 👋

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). A Sneak Peek of Your Role 🔭

This job, and the team at Instinct, is remote.

As a QA Lead, you will play a key role in testing modern veterinary software that serves thousands of users in animal hospitals across the globe. Those in this role often take ownership of test plan creation and execution, and have the ability to provide feedback on software quality and product development. You will work closely and provide leadership to a small, cross-functional, highly-collaborative team to deliver quality software that solves real problems for our customers. Our teams have a deep understanding of their domains and work to deliver value with minimal overhead. We prize excellence, creativity, and accountability and in return provide autonomy and an environment to do your best work.

What You'll Do 🛠️

  • Own the QA lifecycle of software projects from scoping to release

  • Collaborate with your team to understand requirements and ensure quality is built into every stage of the development lifecycle
  • Identify, document, and track bugs and defects using tracking tools, providing clear and actionable feedback to the development team
  • Conduct manual testing as necessary, focusing on critical paths and edge cases to ensure software meets high-quality standards
  • Develop and maintain test plans to support regression, functional, and integration testing
  • Analyze testing outcomes and generate reports to communicate results to stakeholders, recommending process improvements where applicable
  • Research reported customer issues
  • Stay current with QA best practices and tools to continuously enhance the testing process and product quality.

Who You Are 🐱‍💻

  • Must Haves:
    • 5+ Experience testing modern SaaS applications
    • Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira or equivalent.
    • Familiarity with APIs and tools like Postman for API testing.
    • Ability to think critically and test edge cases, ensuring software works seamlessly in all scenarios
    • Strong analytical skills to identify root causes of defects
    • Team-first attitude, including a strong desire to collaborate with your teammates and strive for excellence in software delivery
    • Strong communication skills in a remote work environment
    • Commitment to quality driven by empathy for our customers and their patients
    • Detail-oriented and organized in your work
  • Nice-to-Haves:
    • Basic knowledge of programming languages to write and troubleshoot test scripts
    • Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis and database navigation
    • Experience using AWS to build, deploy and troubleshoot applications

How Instinct will Care about YOU 🌞

  • We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
  • We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
  • We pay our team well.
  • We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
  • We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
  • We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.

Overview:
The Solution Consultant – Identity & Security partners with Sales to help customers address complex identity, access, and security challenges. This role reports to the Solution Consulting Manager within the Identity & Security team and serves as a trusted technical and business advisor, translating requirements into differentiated, outcome-driven solutions that reduce risk, improve governance, and enable secure business operations. The ideal candidate combines deep domain knowledge in identity and security with a consultative mindset and can communicate effectively with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders. This is a fast-paced, growth-stage team that values ownership, initiative, and adaptability. SCs who thrive with autonomy and are energized by building something new will be well positioned to succeed.

This role sits at the forefront of building ServiceNow’s Identity & Security GTM, offering Solution Consultants the opportunity to drive impact, establish best practices, and help define what “great” looks like as the business scales.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Engagement & Solution Design:
    Partner with Sales to lead discovery, solution design, and technical validation for Identity & Security use cases. Engage with customer security, identity, IT, and risk stakeholders to understand requirements, challenges, and success criteria. Design and position solutions that address identity governance, access control, risk reduction, and security automation.
  • Demonstrations & Technical Leadership:
    Deliver compelling, value-based demonstrations tailored to customer security and identity priorities. Articulate how identity and security capabilities integrate into broader enterprise workflows and platforms. Serve as a technical authority during evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and competitive situations.
  • Value & Outcome Positioning:
    Translate identity and security capabilities into business outcomes such as reduced risk, improved compliance, and operational efficiency. Support executive-level conversations by framing security and identity initiatives in terms of business impact and resilience. Partner with Sales to develop solution narratives that align to customer priorities and buying personas.
  • Deal Support & Execution:
    Support complex sales cycles from early discovery through close, ensuring technical accuracy and customer alignment. Identify and mitigate technical or solution-related risks during the sales process. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned to product capabilities.
  • Continuous Learning & Collaboration:
    Stay current on identity, security, and regulatory trends to inform customer conversations. Share field insights and best practices with peers and leadership. Partner with Product, Enablement, and Marketing teams to provide feedback from the field. Participate in a sales-driven, high-accountability culture centered on continuous skill development in a rapidly evolving security market.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales, or a related technical role
  • Track record of strong performance in prior SC roles — expect to demonstrate consistent contribution to technical wins and deal outcomes.
  • Genuinely curious and proactive in adopting AI and emerging sales support technologies to enhance customer engagements, solution design, and deal execution.
  • Strong understanding of identity and security concepts, including identity governance, access management, and risk
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, demonstrate their capabilities, and connect them to impactful customer business challenges.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-level complex sales cycles
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills — able to paint the art of the possible and align solutions to customer priorities.
  • Willingness to travel as required (typically 25–50%)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), or Security Operations platforms
  • Background in enterprise SaaS or platform-based solutions
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory considerations impacting identity and security programs

What Success Looks Like:

  • Become productive quickly and add immediate value to active pursuits
  • Deliver high-quality POCs and demos that advance pipeline and build customer confidence
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with Sales partners and customers through technical expertise
  • Demonstrate strong technical credibility and consistent execution across opportunities
  • Contribute to measurable improvement in win rates and deal quality

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $134,250 - $221,550, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

raw.description:
The Role: We are looking for an engineer who builds real solutions to real business problems. You will sit with teams across YA Group, learn how their work gets done, find where AI and automation can make it faster, more accurate or less manual, and then build those solutions yourself. This is an internal, hands-on role. You are not selling products or running demos for customers. You will design, build and ship working tools that our people use every day, using modern AI development tools such as Claude Code alongside solid engineering practice. You will be the first dedicated AI and automation hire on the team, reporting directly to the Head of Technology & Transformation. You will help shape how YA Group uses AI from the ground up. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.

In This Role, You Will:

Understand the business

Spend time with the business to map how work flows today, including the manual steps, handoffs and workarounds. Identify and size opportunities for AI and automation, and help prioritize them by business value and effort. Translate business needs into clear, practical solution designs that non-technical stakeholders can understand and approve.

Build and ship

Design, build, test and deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations and integrations. Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code and similar) to move fast, while owning the quality, security and maintainability of what ships. Integrate with our core business systems, including Microsoft 365, Salesforce, NetSuite and Dayforce, through APIs and connectors. Work with our data platform and data owners to get the data your solutions need, in a governed way.

Architecture and enablement

Contribute to reference architectures and reusable patterns for AI solutions: approved tools, connectors, environments, and how solutions access data. Support builders outside IT, including AI specialists in other departments, with standards, code review and guidance so their work is secure and maintainable. Maintain an inventory of AI solutions across the company: what exists, who owns it and what data it uses.

Run and improve

Support what you build after launch: monitoring, fixes, documentation and handoff where appropriate. Measure outcomes such as hours saved, error reduction and cycle time, and report them in plain terms. Help triage and manage the queue of AI requests from across the business. Partner with Information Security to put our AI governance framework into practice: tool and vendor evaluation, data access controls, review before production, and lifecycle ownership.

What You Bring:

Required

Hands-on development experience: 3+ years building and shipping software that real users depended on, not only prototypes or personal projects. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, with experience in REST APIs, JSON and SQL. Integration experience: connecting business systems through APIs, webhooks or integration platforms. Engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing, deployment, logging and error handling. Security awareness: sound handling of credentials, access permissions and sensitive data. Practical AI experience: has built real solutions with large language models (prompting, tool use, retrieval or agents) and uses AI coding tools in daily work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when to step in. Solution design: experience designing the architecture of the solutions you build, not only building to someone else's design. AI risk awareness: working knowledge of risks such as data leakage, prompt injection and model limitations, and the governance practices that address them. Business process skills: able to sit with business users, ask good questions, map a workflow and explain technical options in plain language. Ownership: comfortable working independently, managing your own priorities and seeing work through to adoption.

Preferred

Experience with Microsoft 365 / Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, NetSuite or Dayforce. Experience with the Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks. Cloud experience (Azure preferred) and familiarity with data warehouses and pipelines. Background in professional services, engineering or another field-based business. Experience working in a SOC 2 or similarly controlled environment.

Why Join:

Build a new capability at a company that is serious about using AI to improve how work gets done. Direct access to leadership and a wide view across the business. Visible impact: your work will be used across the company, not shelved. Remote role with a modern toolset.

Who We Are:

YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation.

What We Offer:

Employee-focused culture Strong commitment to work-life balance Remote work Flexible vacation & Paid holidays Paid family care and sick leave Parental leave Comprehensive benefits 401k with company match

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:

Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information, such as bank account numbers or identification numbers, via social media or chat-based apps. YA also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist, or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding applications will come from or directly from a member of YA’s talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If fraudulent activity is suspected, please contact .

Disclosures:

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist, rather than replace, human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Manage 8-10 mid level clients
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.
  • Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

About the Client
Our client is a physician-founded, science-backed wellness brand in the health and nutrition space, known for a premium, clinically-informed product line and a highly engaged, loyal customer base with tens of thousands of five-star reviews. They operate as a fast-moving, high-growth DTC company where product launches, promotions, and customer touchpoints move quickly and content needs to keep pace. Trust, credibility, and precision matter deeply to their brand — every word customers read reflects the same rigor they apply to their product.
Why does this role exist?
As the brand scales, support and self-service content can't be an afterthought — it has to be as sharp, current, and on-brand as the marketing customers see before they buy. This role exists because someone needs to own that consistency: catching outdated templates, contradictory FAQs, or missing coverage before they become escalations, and building the systems (templates, style guides, AI-assisted workflows) that let the support and content functions scale without sacrificing voice or accuracy. This is a builder's role, not a maintenance role — the person who takes it will be expected to grow the scope of what "copy infrastructure" means for this team over time.

The Impact you’ll make

Support Copy Template Library
  • Write, edit, and maintain the library of standardized responses across email, live chat, and social channels.
  • Audit the library on a recurring cadence to retire duplicates, fix contradictions, and update details tied to changed policies, pricing, or products.
  • Draft new response templates for product launches, promotions, expansions, and recurring customer inquiry themes.
  • Version and organize content so support agents can locate the correct response efficiently.

Help Center Self-Service Content
  • Write and update help-center and FAQ articles, including coverage for new products and channels.
  • Identify content gaps where repeat inquiry volume signals a missing or unclear article.
  • Maintain consistent formatting, structure, and internal linking across the knowledge base.

Lifecycle Transactional Copy
  • Draft and revise transactional and service email copy, including order updates, account changes, delays, and resolutions.
  • Partner with marketing teams on tone alignment across shared customer touchpoints.

Brand Voice Quality
  • Serve as the day-to-day guardian of brand tone and voice — warm, credible, plain-spoken, and clear.
  • Review agent-drafted responses for voice, clarity, and accuracy, providing specific, constructive feedback.
  • Maintain the content style guide and usage guidelines.

Innovative Builder
  • Develop and test generative AI prompts to scale content production without sacrificing brand voice.
  • Design standardized copy templates, messaging frameworks, and style guides to streamline team workflows.
  • Create dynamic content experiments and multivariate copy testing frameworks to optimize conversion rates.
  • Build centralized campaign messaging repositories and asset libraries to improve cross-functional collaboration.

Enablement Support
  • Translate approved policy and process changes into clear internal reference docs and summary guides.
  • Support content rollouts by drafting announcement materials and quick-reference guides.
  • Coordinate with graphic design teams when written material requires visual support.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • 2+ years of experience writing customer-facing copy in a content, support, or messaging role (DTC or e-commerce strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to write independently and originally — not solely under the direct guidance/editing of another writer or manager
  • A portfolio or work samples that can be reviewed and discussed in detail
  • Strong written English capabilities with the ability to write consistently in a defined brand voice across hundreds of pieces
    Comfort working in a fast-moving remote environment with asynchronous review cycles and shifting schedules
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical:
    • Hands-on experience with help desk or knowledge-base platforms (Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Help Scout — nice to have)
    • Familiarity with AI writing tools as a drafting accelerant, paired with strong independent editing judgment
    • High attention to detail regarding formatting, links, dates, and product nomenclature
    • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace)
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong self-direction — able to manage an ongoing content backlog independently, without heavy oversight
    • A builder's mindset: proactively spots gaps and creates systems, rather than waiting to be told what to fix
    • Flexible and fast-moving, comfortable with shifting schedules and priorities
    • Clear, plain-spoken communicator who can translate policy/process changes into simple guidance for others
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
  • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
You should apply if...
  • You take pride in owning your work end-to-end — you don't just write copy, you notice when something's outdated or inconsistent and fix it before anyone has to ask.
  • You think like a builder: given a messy or nonexistent system, your instinct is to create the framework, not just patch the immediate problem.
  • You're comfortable being early in a role that will grow and change shape as you prove yourself, and you move quickly without needing every detail handed to you.
  • Precision matters to you — you'd rather double-check a date or product name than let something slip through.
What to expect...
Work Setup:
  • Remote position
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system
Working Hours:
  • 40 hours per week
  • Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm EST (note: this schedule is expected to change as the role evolves — flexibility required)
Compensation:
  • $7 per hour
  • No benefits package included

Benefits

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
