raw.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


The Brokerage Trading Associate provides trading assistance and customer service support to new and existing Empower retirement and investing customers. This role serves as a primary point of contact for inbound customer inquiries involving trade execution, brokerage account servicing, and investment products, including equities, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), mutual funds, options, and fixed income securities. The associate applies knowledge of financial markets, retirement account operations, and investment concepts to deliver accurate, timely, and customer-focused service while helping customers navigate Empower's brokerage products and financial tools.


The expected start date for this role is January 18th, 2027.


Schedule will vary by time zone.Candidates must be available to work the following Monday - Friday schedule for their location:


Eastern Time (ET): 11:30 a.m. - 8:00 p.m.

Central Time (CT): 10:30 a.m. - 7:00 p.m.

Mountain Time (MT): 9:30 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.

What you will do


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers seeking assistance with trading equities, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), mutual funds, options, and fixed income securities in an inbound contact center environment
  • Facilitate customer-directed securities transactions, including trade execution and order entry, in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and company procedures
  • Explain investment concepts, financial products, and brokerage processes clearly and accurately to customers with varying levels of investment knowledge.
  • Provide exceptional customer service and brokerage support to new and existing Empower retail investing and retirement customers
  • Manage customer servicing requests, including brokerage account opening, asset transfers, account maintenance, and transaction-related inquiries
  • Educate customers on Empower's available financial solutions, investment products, educational resources, and self-service tools
  • Resolve customer inquiries and service issues through independent problem-solving, accurate communication, and collaboration with internal business partners when needed
  • Navigate multiple technology platforms, trading systems, internal communication tools, and servicing resources while actively assisting customers
  • Maintain accurate customer information and transaction documentation while following established operational procedures

What you will bring


  • Minimum of 2 years of customer service experience in the financial services industry
  • Minimum of 1 year of direct securities trading experience involving trade execution and order entry
  • Active FINRA Series 7 and Series 63 registrations required
  • FINRA Fingerprinting required
  • Experience handling fixed income securities, corporate actions, and options transactions
  • Understanding of current financial markets, investment products, securities trading, and retirement account operations
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to explain investment concepts and brokerage procedures clearly to customers
  • Ability to independently research, troubleshoot, and resolve customer inquiries while maintaining accuracy and professionalism
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and customer interactions in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment
  • Proficiency with PC applications, digital communication tools, and multiple technology platforms
  • Ability to learn and navigate brokerage trading systems, customer servicing applications, and internal operational procedures
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to navigate multiple applications simultaneously during customer interactions
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively to deliver accurate, responsive, and customer-focused service

What will set you apart


  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in business, finance, or a related field
  • Previous experience in a financial services call center or contact center
  • Experience supporting retail brokerage accounts, Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs), or 401(k) retirement accounts
  • Experience using Pershing NetX360 or comparable brokerage custody and clearing platforms
  • Experience supporting customers with complex securities transactions involving multiple investment products
  • Familiarity with brokerage account operations, asset transfers, and securities settlement processes
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software or financial services recordkeeping platforms


***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$55,300.00 - $76,075.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

***For remote and hybrid positions you will be required to provide reliable high-speed internet with a wired connection as well as a place in your home to work with limited disruption. You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health provides integrated, cloud-based EHR and practice management solutions to medical practices. We help healthcare providers streamline operations and improve patient care through innovative technology and services.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly technical, strategic, and results-driven Marketing Lead to turn business objectives into actionable initiatives and measurable results.

The ideal candidate combines strong marketing expertise, business acumen, critical thinking, and technical knowledge. This individual should be able to identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, lead initiatives, and develop innovative solutions independently.

Beyond traditional marketing, this role requires a strong understanding of AI, automation, CRM platforms, and analytics to improve marketing performance and business operations. The successful candidate should be equally comfortable developing strategies, managing teams, and getting directly involved in execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute marketing strategies that support business growth, lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue goals.
  • Analyze competitors, and translate business objectives into actionable marketing initiatives.
  • Manage and optimize HubSpot or similar CRM platforms, marketing tools, and automation workflows.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve content creation, research, campaign management, lead generation, analytics, and reporting.
  • Lead strategic projects, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities to improve existing processes.
  • Manage and develop team members while collaborating with Sales and Product teams to drive results.
  • Monitor campaign and business performance, using data and insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Business Management, or a related field. Advanced education is a plus.
  • Significant experience in marketing, business strategy, growth, or a related leadership role.
  • Experience managing projects, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to understand complex business challenges and independently develop solutions.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and executional levels.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).

  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.

Work Schedule

raw.title: Product Manager
raw.excerpt: At Vena, we’re reimagining how businesses plan and grow: powered by data, collaboration, and innovation.
raw.description:
At Vena, we’re reimagining how businesses plan and grow: powered by data, collaboration, and innovation. Our platform helps finance-led organizations bring structure, visibility, and confidence to complex business processes.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap for Vena’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) product, the connectivity layer that enables external AI tools and agents to securely access and interact with Vena’s platform. Working closely with software engineers, architects, designers, and business stakeholders, you’ll define how Vena extends its capabilities across the growing enterprise AI ecosystem through APIs, integrations, AI tools, and agent-driven workflows.
As a Product Manager, your goal is to help build an experiment-friendly culture that empowers teams to build great products and own their code all the way into production. You will also gather feedback and investigate performance of the product features you build. You will be an essential part of the team as we scale our teams and push ourselves to become the next great Canadian software company.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Align Vena’s product roadmap with business strategies and establish a shared vision across stakeholders
  • Write requirements for your scrum team and PM the software development lifecycle
  • Assess opportunities and develop prototypes in order to determine the best solutions from user experience and business outcome perspectives

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

About Chainlink Labs

Chainlink Labs is one of the primary contributing developers of Chainlink, the standard for onchain finance enabling high-quality data, secure cross-chain interoperability, and compliant connectivity across global markets. Chainlink powers leading tokenized assets, financial institutions, market infrastructures, and decentralized applications by providing secure access to real-world data, cross-chain messaging, and blockchain connectivity across any network. The Chainlink standard has enabled tens of trillions of dollars in transaction value and is helping unify global markets onchain. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, Aave, Polymarket, Lido, and many others.

Chainlink Labs is a world-class team of developers, researchers, and capital markets experts, and has ranked among Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology, Fortune's Best Medium Workplace, and the Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. Learn more at or.

About the Role

The Manager, Insider Trust will lead Chainlink Labs’ Insider Trust function while remaining directly involved in technical investigations and detection development. This player-coach role is responsible for protecting sensitive data, investigating potential insider risk, and strengthening our ability to identify and address concerning activity.

Your Impact

  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Insider Trust team.

  • Direct and conduct investigations involving sensitive data, systems, and workforce activity.

  • Build and improve detections, monitoring, and escalation workflows for insider risk.

  • Ensure investigations are timely, proportionate, well documented, and supported by defensible evidence.

  • Partner with Legal, People, IT, and Security throughout the investigation and response lifecycle.

  • Identify control gaps and translate investigative findings into lasting technical and process improvements.

  • Establish metrics that demonstrate program effectiveness, investigative quality, and detection coverage.

  • Communicate sensitive findings clearly to both executive and working-level stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in insider risk, detection engineering, security operations, incident response, digital forensics, data protection, threat hunting, or a related security field.

  • 2+ years leading an insider risk, investigations, or closely related security team.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead a team while remaining hands-on in technical investigations and detection development.

  • Experience managing the full investigation lifecycle, including scoping, evidence collection, timeline development, analysis, documentation, escalation, and lessons learned.

  • Strong knowledge of digital forensics, evidence preservation, chain of custody, incident-response coordination, and case management.

  • Experience partnering with Legal and People teams on sensitive workforce investigations.

  • Sound understanding of the legal, privacy, confidentiality, and employee-relations considerations associated with workforce investigations.

  • Experience working in software, financial services, or another industry that handles highly sensitive data.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to operate discreetly in high-trust situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a remote-first and globally distributed company.

  • Experience investigating data movement across email, cloud storage, collaboration platforms, source-code repositories, build systems, artifact stores, browsers, AI tools, removable media, and unmanaged or partially managed devices.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, DLP, or endpoint telemetry

  • Experience developing queries, analytics, or automation to identify and investigate suspicious behavior.

  • Experience establishing investigation playbooks, escalation criteria, program metrics, and detection coverage.

  • Experience leading projects, reviewing technical designs, and mentoring engineers or investigators.

  • Working knowledge of blockchain technology, including hardware wallets and signing operations.

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

The Role

We’re looking for a sourcer who lives in LinkedIn Recruiter and isn’t afraid to go find talent that isn’t looking. This role is built around two things: sourcing passive sales talent for our AE and SDR roles, and coordinating interviews.

You won’t own the full recruiting cycle. You’ll build and warm the pipeline, bring qualified candidates to the Talent team and hiring managers, and keep the interview process running smoothly. LinkedIn Recruiter is your primary tool, and we expect you to know it inside and out. Agency experience is a big plus.

What You’ll Do

Sourcing in LinkedIn Recruiter

  • Use LinkedIn Recruiter daily as your primary sourcing tool: advanced filters (title, company, industry, seniority, skills, geography, Open to Work), saved searches, and search alerts.

  • Build and refine boolean strings and run X-ray searches that surface passive candidates others miss.

  • Create and manage Projects and pipelines in Recruiter, organized by role and stage and kept current.

  • Build talent maps of target companies and competitors for AE and SDR roles so pipelines are full before roles open.

  • Write personalized InMail and multi-touch outreach sequences, and test subject lines and messaging to lift response rates.

  • Use Recruiter outreach analytics (InMail acceptance and response rates) to refine your approach and manage InMail credits wisely.

  • Supplement LinkedIn with social media, communities, and job boards.

  • Run brief initial screens to confirm interest, background, and compensation alignment before handing candidates to the Talent team and hiring managers.

  • Keep candidate information in sync between LinkedIn Recruiter and our ATS (Ashby).

  • Track and report sourcing KPIs weekly: InMail response rate, pipeline conversion, and candidates passed to hiring managers.

  • Stay current on LinkedIn Recruiter features and sourcing trends.

Interview coordination

  • Schedule interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and the Talent team, including multi-round and panel interviews.

  • Send clear communications and reminders so candidates know what to expect at each stage.

  • Keep candidate statuses and interview details up to date in the ATS.

  • Follow up with candidates promptly and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define ideal candidate profiles and search criteria.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 2+ years of sourcing experience (or recruiting with a heavy sourcing focus), ideally in agency or high-volume environments.

  • Extensive, hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter. You should be a power user of advanced search filters, boolean strings, Projects, pipeline management, InMail, saved searches, and outreach analytics.

  • Advanced boolean and X-ray search skills.

  • Proven track record of building talent pipelines from scratch and winning over passive candidates.

  • Experience sourcing for AEs, SDRs, or other sales roles in SaaS or tech.

  • Experience scheduling and coordinating interviews across multiple stakeholders.

  • Comfort with cold outreach and persistence, with no fear of picking up the phone or sending the 5th follow-up.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple searches and schedules at once.

Preferred:

  • LinkedIn Recruiter certification.

  • Agency recruiting background.

  • Experience with an ATS (such as Ashby), job boards, and social media sourcing.

  • Familiarity with sourcing and automation tools (e.g., contact-finding and outreach platforms).

  • Critical thinker, problem solver, and team player with a strong sense of ownership.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $60,000 – $70,000, based on experience

Our Interview Process

We keep it straightforward and respectful of your time:

  1. First Round: Conversation with our Director of Talent, focused on your background, sourcing approach, and LinkedIn Recruiter expertise.

  2. Second Round: Meet the Talent Acquisition team, where you’ll get a feel for how we work together and show us how you think.

With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Identity Management Engineer to architect, build, and run the identity, secrets, and privileged access systems that secure our global workforce, engineering infrastructure, cloud services, and autonomous AI agents. As part of the Operations Security (OpSec) team, you will replace static credentials, over-scoped tokens, and manual ticket queues with automated, self-service paths, partnering with IT, DevInfra, Cloud, and Software Engineering. This is a hands-on role for an identity engineer who also writes software.

This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • Equal parts enterprise identity architect and software builder, comfortable administering Entra ID, Active Directory, and Vault and writing the CLIs, APIs, and IaC that automate them.
  • AI-native: you use coding agents to build internal tools, MCP servers, and audit reports.
  • A pragmatic partner who replaces manual gatekeeping with self-service and light-touch approval workflows.
  • Ownership-minded and analytical, able to anticipate cross-team impact and respond decisively to identity threats.

What We Need

  • Deep experience running Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including SAML/OIDC, SCIM, Conditional Access, and phishing-resistant MFA.
  • Production experience with HashiCorp Vault (or equivalent), including workload federation, dynamic short-lived credentials, and removing static secrets from CI/CD.
  • Experience rolling out privileged access management and just-in-time elevation across cloud admin roles and Linux SSH/sudo.
  • Programming skills (Python, TypeScript, Go, or Rust, plus Terraform and Docker) with a track record of building working tools instead of manual ClickOps.
  • Experience with access reviews, identity threat detection and response (such as CrowdStrike Falcon Identity Protection), and auditing service accounts and tokens.

What You Will Learn

  • How to build an agentic identity platform that governs credentials and lifecycle for autonomous AI agents.
  • How to design host-level Linux PAM and just-in-time access across workstations, cloud, and high-performance EDA clusters.
  • How to run code-backed, AI-assisted access audits that produce SOC 2 Type 2 evidence.
  • How to publish security skills so engineering AI agents adopt Vault, OIDC, and least-privilege standards by default.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape intuitive, high-quality product experiences across BJAK's financial products.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving product problems through thoughtful interface design. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex financial workflows into experiences that feel fast, intuitive and trustworthy.

What You'll Own

  • Design end-to-end product experiences from concept to production.

  • Transform product requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.

  • Design intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial products.

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable UI components.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Improve usability through rapid iteration using product data and user feedback.

  • Maintain consistency across mobile and web experiences.

  • Continuously refine interactions, accessibility and overall product quality.


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and excellent visual design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Strong understanding of design systems, component libraries and responsive design.

  • Strong understanding of information architecture and user flows.

  • Excellent visual design skills including typography, spacing, layout and interaction design.

  • Ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout

  • Component Libraries


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks about solving customer problems, not just designing screens.

  • Balances business goals with user experience.

  • Obsesses over clarity, simplicity and consistency.

  • Works collaboratively with engineers and product teams.

  • Takes ownership from idea through launch.

  • Continuously improves products using real user insights.


This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who only focus on visuals without considering usability.

  • People who require fully detailed specifications before contributing.

  • Designers who struggle to explain design decisions.

  • Individuals who don't enjoy fast-moving startup environments.

  • Candidates who exaggerate ownership or cannot explain what they personally designed.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Australia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Australia.


Language

English is our primary working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process

  1. Portfolio Review

  2. Practical Design Task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific Interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within one week.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Yoga Alliance is the largest nonprofit membership association of yoga professionals, practitioners, and advocates around the globe. We believe if more people practice yoga, the better the world will be. We’re here to amplify the power of yoga and to make it accessible to anyone wherever they are, under whatever circumstances by:

  • Uplifting the transformative power of yoga,
  • Surfacing and reducing barriers to the practice, and
  • Building, engaging, and supporting the yoga community.

Our member-driven community is a diverse collective of wisdom holders, yoga educators, and teachers expanding their expertise; a welcoming space for those newly exploring yoga; a place for seasoned practitioners to deepen their practice; and a supportive hub where community leaders, organizations, and businesses can leverage yoga for social good.

At the core of Yoga Alliance lies a profound commitment to our people. Here, every team member is empowered to lead, innovate, dream, create, and grow. Diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility and belonging guide our way of being in work and in working with each other. We champion a culture of collaboration, where learning from failures is as valued as achieving success. Together, we challenge the status quo and push the boundaries of what is possible.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Head of Strategy, Yoga Alliance is seeking a Director, Research & Analysis to join our team.

In close partnership with the Head of Strategy and other functional heads, the Director leads and oversees the design, build, and execution of how Yoga Alliance collects data, leverages research, and measures whether its programs and initiatives are working. This role will combine external research (such as journal articles, reports, briefs, papers) with the organization’s data to provide recommendations and solutions toward Yoga Alliance’s strategic plan. The Director will collaborate and support team members with how to analyze and apply research and evidence to make and validate decisions – further moving Yoga Alliance toward a data informed framework.

What You Will Do:

Portfolio Research & Evaluation

  • Lead the design and build of research framework at Yoga Alliance; ensure execution of the framework
  • Be the in house subject matter expert on research and metrics; teach and coach others on application
  • Stay abreast of yoga and wellness space and inject innovation and evolutions along the way
  • Track key performance indicators for project and team work plans and overall portfolio performance
  • Prepare executive-level reports and presentations on portfolio status, risks, and recommendations
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and inform continuous improvement
  • Drive and maintain research and analysis functions that ensure data-driven insights inform portfolio decisions
  • Lead the design of and conduct research that may include focus groups, stakeholder interviews, listening sessions, member panels, needs assessments, and feasibility analyses in support of strategic initiatives
  • Evaluate program and initiative effectiveness, tracking outcomes against organizational goals
  • Support the development and maintenance of the Balanced Scorecard and other performance frameworks
  • Monitor market trends, sector developments, and peer organization activity relevant to yoga, wellness, and credentialing
  • Curate and synthesize scholarly research to inform organizational strategy and thought leadership
  • Maintain an organized knowledge management system for research assets and data sources
  • Nurture and steward relationships with yoga and wellness researchers

Data Analysis & Visualization

  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data from surveys, member data, and external sources
  • Translate findings into clear, compelling reports and visualizations for varied audiences (staff, board, members)
  • Support data storytelling across organizational communications
  • Partner with teams across the organization to identify information needs and design research approaches
  • Oversee and contribute to white papers, impact reports, and other knowledge products
  • Support grant-related research and evaluation requirements as needed
  • Lead the collection, synthesis, and interpretation of member, stakeholder, and community feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and strategic recommendations.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Other projects and initiatives as necessary

What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelors degree in relevant course of studies
  • 10+ years of full time professional work experience in research, evaluation, data analysis or related role that includes 5+ years' experience in the following:
    • Designing and executing research studies or program evaluations
    • Survey design and administration (e.g., Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey)
    • Translating complex data into accessible reports or presentations for non-technical audiences
    • Working with both quantitative and qualitative data
    • Thought partnership
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in remote, distributed team environments
  • Demonstrated experience with software across a variety of data analysis tools and platforms (e.g. Excel, SPSS, R, or similar; Google Analytics, Tableau); as well as technology skills: Microsoft Office Suite, CRM (e.g. Salesforce for Nonprofits), and project management platforms (e.g. Monday.com), LMSs (e.g. Absorb, Learn Upon), Canva
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-enabled tools and large language models (LLMs) to support research, analysis, knowledge management, and organizational decision-making.
  • Demonstrated experience writing white papers, reports, and thought leadership pieces
  • Entrepreneurial, with high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity, and an ability to navigate problem solving in an efficient and collaborative manner
  • Strength in the following core competencies and skills:
    • Collaboration: Builds strong relationships across teams; creates conditions for cross-functional teamwork and trust.
    • Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across levels; provides insight and context that builds understanding.
    • Judgment and Confidentiality: Exercises discretion and sound decision-making; operates with integrity and diplomacy
    • Operational Execution: Designs systems that support clarity, accountability, and follow-through across multiple teams and priorities.
    • Project and Change Management: Leads teams through complex, evolving projects with care, consistency, and attention to outcomes.
    • Strategic and Systems Thinking: Connects operational details to broader goals; identifies leverage points to improve performance or outcomes.
  • Demonstrated commitment to and experience advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging in workplace or community settings.
  • Curious and proactively scans the horizon to stay abreast of technology, creative approaches, and novel ideas to experiment, test, and apply.
  • Ability to travel as needed to Yoga Alliance’s Arlington, VA office to participate in organizational meetings, training, and retreats.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD, EdD, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with the yoga, wellness, or complementary health fields
  • Understanding of strategic planning frameworks and performance indicators

We encourage individuals to apply even if they do not have any of the desired qualifications.

What We Offer:

Yoga Alliance provides robust employee benefits including comprehensive health insurance plan offerings that are 100% employer paid for employees and 65% paid for dependents, a matching 401K plan, a generous paid-leave program including parental leave and sabbatical leave, and reimbursement for professional development opportunities. Employees enjoy a casual dress code so they can arrive to work as their most authentic selves. Our organizational culture is supportive and collaborative with conscious attention to body and mind health.

Location:

This position may be remote, locally based is preferred, and will require the individual to be able to travel, as needed, to Yoga Alliance’s office. Yoga Alliance is based in Arlington, Virginia within sight of the historic northwest region of Washington, DC.

Salary Range:

$121,500 to $136,000 (commensurate to experience). This position is a full-time, exempt position.

Application and Timeline:
Interested applicants are encouraged to apply by December 3 to ensure priority consideration of your application. We will continue to review applications on a rolling basis after this priority deadline until the position is filled.

A cover letter is required and all cover letters will be read during the application review process.

Please, no phone calls or walk-ins.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace:
At Yoga Alliance, we value a diverse team and a culture of inclusivity and belonging. We encourage applications from all individuals without regard to an individuals' race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

While traditional brick-and-mortar clinics are at a breaking point, forcing patients to endure dangerous 4-6 month wait times, Neura is scaling the nation’s largest virtual practice to deliver immediate access to the 145 million Americans in need. Through strategic partnerships with leading health systems, pharmaceutical innovators, and large clinics, as well as a direct-to-patient model, we are fundamentally transforming the referral landscape and reducing average wait time from 276 days to 5 days.

Our tech-enabled model provides a comprehensive, end-to-end experience that goes far beyond a standard consultation. We offer patients seamless access to personalized care plans and expert care navigation, ensuring no one has to manage their journey alone. This mission is powered by our multidisciplinary specialized care teams, which include world-class physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and dedicated care coaches. We leverage AI-powered workflow optimization and continuous monitoring for everything from chronic headaches and epilepsy to complex memory disorders. Backed by $22M in funding from world-class investors, we are not just improving neurology; we are revolutionizing it. We are looking for purpose-driven innovators to join us in making high-quality brain health a reality for everyone.

At Neura Health, we are constantly looking for clinicians who want to work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and some of the hardest problems in healthcare. Currently, we are looking for providers who are well-versed in the evidence-based treatment of sleep disorders, and who are empathetic, compassionate, mission-driven, collaborative, and results-oriented.

Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate and examine patients with any sleep related complaints, provide them with a diagnosis and care plan that will help guide them toward their health goals
  • Discuss sleep study results, labs, imaging with patients
  • Provide follow-up appointments with patients on a regular basis to adjust medications and device settings
  • Provide chat-based support to patients going through difficult journeys
  • Generate educational content in support of our online blogs and content library

Requirements:

  • NP or PA specializing in sleep medicine
  • Interest in the diagnosis and treatment of sleep disorders
  • Soft skills: listening, negotiating, decision-making, and leadership.
  • Culture fit: empathic, mission-driven, collaborative, precise, transparent, compassionate, and results-oriented.

Compensation:

  • This is a contract 1099 position for 2-4 hours per month with the possibility to increase over time.
  • $60 per initial visit
  • $30 per follow up visit

Culture: About Being a “Neuron” Neura is building a category-defining neurology company, and we’re doing it with a team that’s all-in. We move with urgency, we take ownership end-to-end, and we hold an extremely high bar because the work is real and the impact is personal. We’re here to raise the standard of care and deliver a patient experience that is world-class.

You’ll thrive here if you have an unwavering curiosity to do right by the patient and you’re energized by delivering a radically better patient experience, not incremental improvement. If you’re the kind of person who sees what could be better and can’t let it go, who learns fast, executes with precision, and follows through to outcomes, you’ll fit right in. You’ll be surrounded by a highly committed, humble, and inspiring team that challenges each other directly, supports each other deeply, and gets better every week. If you want real responsibility, real velocity, and the chance to build something transformative from the ground up, this is the place for you.

About the Founders:

  • Liz Burstein is the CEO and was previously Head of Product at Maven Clinic, Director of Product at Zocdoc and Senior Product Lead at LinkedIn. She has fifteen years of experience in the tech industry, and a wealth of knowledge in the health tech domain.

raw.description:
Sobre Creai

En Creai, nos especializamos en aprovechar el poder de la inteligencia artificial y el aprendizaje automático para transformar negocios. Nuestra misión es ayudar a los clientes a reducir costos, aumentar la eficiencia y desbloquear nuevas oportunidades mediante soluciones de IA de vanguardia.

Descripción del Puesto

Como Data Engineer, serás un líder técnico clave, responsable de diseñar, construir y operar arquitecturas y pipelines de datos de alta complejidad, escalabilidad y rendimiento. Liderarás la integración de fuentes de datos diversas y la transformación de grandes volúmenes de información para soportar soluciones de analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial. Tendrás un impacto significativo en la dirección técnica de nuestra plataforma de datos, mentorizando a otros y resolviendo los desafíos más difíciles relacionados con la calidad, gobernanza y eficiencia de los datos.

Este Puesto Exige

  • Liderazgo en el Desarrollo de Pipelines de Datos: Diseñar y construir código optimizado y escalable para pipelines de datos complejos y distribuidos (batch y streaming), aplicando patrones de diseño de datos avanzados y promoviendo las mejores prácticas.

  • Diseño de Estrategias de Calidad y Pruebas para Datos: Diseñar e implementar estrategias de prueba robustas para pipelines y conjuntos de datos (incluyendo pruebas de calidad de datos), y guiar a otros en la escritura de pruebas de alta calidad.

  • Depuración Avanzada y Observabilidad: Depurar problemas complejos en sistemas de datos distribuidos, identificando rápidamente la causa raíz de fallos de datos o pipelines. Diseñar y optimizar sistemas de monitoreo y logging para garantizar la observabilidad completa de la plataforma de datos.

  • Modelado y Arquitectura de Datos: Diseñar modelos de datos complejos para data warehouses, data lakes o lake houses, y definir estrategias de modelado de datos.

  • Gestión y Optimización de Infraestructura de Datos: Administrar y optimizar bases de datos y sistemas de almacenamiento de datos, y participar en la selección e implementación de tecnologías de infraestructura de datos (ej. Hadoop, Snowflake, Databricks, MS Fabric).

  • Seguridad y Gobernanza de Datos: Implementar medidas de seguridad robustas en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos y comprender y contribuir a los conceptos de gobernanza de datos.

  • Pensamiento Económico y Optimización: Proponer soluciones de datos que optimizan el valor y la eficiencia económica (ej. costo de almacenamiento, rendimiento de consultas, optimización de recursos).

  • Mentoría y Liderazgo Técnico: Mentorizar activamente a Data Engineers junior y medianos en el equipo, compartiendo conocimientos avanzados y fomentando el crecimiento profesional.

  • Comunicación e Influencia: Comunicar ideas técnicas complejas de datos de manera clara a audiencias diversas (técnicas y no técnicas), y dar retroalimentación constructiva y accionable sobre enfoques y soluciones de ingeniería de datos.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia Técnica Avanzada en Datos: Dominio experto de Python y SQL. Experiencia profunda en el diseño, desarrollo y optimización de pipelines ETL/ELT complejos utilizando frameworks y herramientas de procesamiento de datos distribuidos (ej. Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Flink).

  • Modelado y Arquitectura de Datos: Capacidad probada para diseñar modelos de datos complejos para data warehouses, data lakes y lake houses, y experiencia en el diseño de arquitecturas de datos escalables y resilientes.

  • Dominio de Plataformas en la Nube: Experiencia avanzada con plataformas en la nube (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) y sus servicios de datos para Big Data y analítica avanzada.

  • Calidad y Gobernanza de Datos: Fuerte entendimiento y experiencia en la implementación de rutinas de calidad de datos y conceptos de gobernanza de datos.

  • Habilidades Analíticas Superiores y Resolución de Problemas Complejos de Datos: Capacidad experta para resolver problemas complejos relacionados con el rendimiento de pipelines, la calidad de los datos, el volumen y la complejidad de las fuentes de datos.

  • Liderazgo y Mentoría: Experiencia comprobada en liderar proyectos técnicos de datos, guiar equipos y mentorizar a otros Data Engineers.

  • Habilidades de Comunicación y Presentación: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita, con la capacidad de presentar resultados técnicos complejos y discusiones de diseño de datos a audiencias técnicas y no técnicas.

  • Comunicación en Español e Inglés: Capacidad para comunicarse de manera efectiva en ambos idiomas.

Beneficios

  • 💻 Trabajo 100% Home Office con horario alineado a CST.

  • 🏖️ PTO ilimitado: Confiamos en que gestionarás tu tiempo de manera efectiva.

  • 🎓 Presupuesto anual para desarrollo: Acceso a cursos, certificaciones y conferencias.

  • 🛠️ Presupuesto para equipamiento: Configura tu espacio de trabajo remoto ideal.

  • 🩺 Beneficio de salud: Acceso a cobertura médica privada o subsidios para seguro médico.

  • 🚀 Oportunidades de crecimiento: Plan de carrera y mentoría con expertos en IA y tecnología.

  • 🚀 Ambiente de startup dinámico y flexible: Autonomía para tomar decisiones y proponer ideas, con un enfoque en resultados en lugar de horas trabajadas.

  • ⚖️ Balance vida-trabajo: Cultura que prioriza la flexibilidad y el bienestar, permitiéndote gestionar tu tiempo sin sacrificar tu vida personal.

¡Te invitamos a postularte!

Incluso si no cumples con todos los requisitos, valoramos experiencias y perspectivas diversas. ¡nos encantaría conocerte!

Description

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance Applications Administrator to take sole ownership of our financial systems ecosystem. As the dedicated expert and sole administrator, you will be fully responsible for the stability, performance, governance, and evolution of these platforms. Your primary day-to-day focus will be driving NetSuite ERP operations, while also owning the configuration and business process alignment for the Planful platform and SAP Concur.

This role requires a unique blend of financial systems expertise and technical capability to act as a strategic partner to the Finance team. You will collaborate daily with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Finance leadership to ensure our technology stack perfectly supports their financial operations. Additionally, you will partner with our internal BI developers to maximize Planful's utility and identify opportunities for automation across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Ownership & Administration: Act as the sole administrator and ultimate technical owner for NetSuite ERP, Planful, SAP Concur, and ADRA, managing security, user roles, business rules, and system access.
  • Finance Team Partnership: Serve as a dedicated technology partner to the Finance department, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable system enhancements and improved workflows.
  • Technical Configuration: Develop, test, deploy, and maintain custom scripts, workflows, and integrations, ensuring optimal NetSuite performance and leveraging best practices.
  • Planful & BI Collaboration: Own the configuration, functional support, and business process alignment of the Planful platform, partnering with internal BI developers for reporting and advanced system utilization.
  • Process Improvement: Identify automation opportunities and translate business needs into scalable system enhancements for planning, forecasting, reporting, expense management, and consolidations.
  • Data & Integrations: Own financial data integrity across applications, monitor system health, and resolve integration and data quality issues.
  • Reporting & Support: Build custom reports and dashboards, lead user training initiatives, and maintain comprehensive system documentation.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Active NetSuite Administrator certification is Required.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience administering financial systems in a corporate environment, including extensive NetSuite ERP administration.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as the sole owner, independently managing and prioritizing the change backlog for enterprise financial applications.
  • Experience configuring and administering SAP Concur, ADRA, and Planful (Consolidations & Planning modules).
  • Strong understanding of finance processes, including billing, A/R, expense management, general ledger, revenue recognition, FP&A, and close processes.
  • Experience developing solutions based on business requirements and utilizing agile methodologies.
  • Detail-oriented, self-sufficient, resourceful, and proficient in written and spoken English.

Advantageous Skills

  • Working knowledge of SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteBundler, SuiteTalk, and SuiteBuilder.
  • Experience with middleware, API connections, SQL, Salesforce, and Mesh Payments.
  • Planful certifications.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science or accounting.

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

Data Analyst – Business Intelligence

Location: Remote

Position Summary:

OpenX Technologies, Inc. is looking for a Data Analyst to join our dynamic and high-performing Business Intelligence team within the Finance organization. Our organization’s mission is to steer the financial growth of OpenX through the delivery of world-class financial intelligence, guidance and services. In this mission we value reliability, integrity and fearless stewardship of OpenX’s business. We strive to operate with objectivity, rigor and strategic insight.
The ideal candidate will be a highly engaged and intellectually curious data analyst with one to three years of experience in an analytic role. You will be responsible for developing in-depth business analyses, providing ad hoc analytic support to the entire business, and driving the scaling and automation of reporting processes. Build performance and revenue reporting tools for internal customers
Help build and automate data and reporting processes for the Finance organization
Ad-hoc analysis and reporting, serving teams across the company
Execute deep dive quantitative analyses that translates data into actionable insights
Provide analytical and decision-making support for key company initiatives
Present analysis and share findings with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

1-3 years of analytical work experience, preferably within a business intelligence, corporate finance or strategic planning role. Experience working with large data sets is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (such as Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Physics), Master’s degree in a quantitative field is preferred.
Strong analytical abilities and the ability to form key, succinct insights and recommendations from analyses involving large amounts of complex data.
Curiosity to identify and ability to solve difficult problems.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to interface with and effectively present to multiple levels of management.
Extremely proactive with a strong bias for action; naturally inquisitive; desire to continuously improve current business practices/processes.
Organized, detail-oriented, and ability to multi-task.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build

  • Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

  • Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

  • Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

  • Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For

  • Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

  • Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

  • Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

  • Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

  • Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

  • Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Summary:

The Project Manager I (PMI) is responsible for the successful delivery of customer-facing technical projects from initiation through closure. The PMI manages project scope, schedule, financials, resources, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication while ensuring a high-quality customer experience. The PMI also serves as a mentor to Project Coordinators and contributes to the continued improvement of PMO standards and practices.

About our PMO:

At Logically, Project Management is a profession, not simply a job title. Our Project Managers own the full project lifecycle, including scope, schedules, financials, risks, resources, deliverables, and the customer experience. We're looking for someone who wants Project Management to be their career, not simply their current job. Someone who takes pride in the craft, continually develops their skills, shares what they know, and helps make the team around them better.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

Project Ownership & Customer Experience: Take ownership of assigned projects from Sales handoff through successful completion and closure, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring a best-in-class customer delivery experience.

Scope Management: Validate project scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, and customer expectations during the transition from Sales to Delivery. Manage scope throughout the project lifecycle and identify, document, and communicate changes or potential scope conflicts.

Schedule Management: Develop and maintain project plans and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), including milestones, dependencies, critical path, resource assignments, and forecast completion dates. Proactively identify and address issues that may impact the project schedule.

Resource Management: Partner with Project Coordinators to coordinate internal and external resources required for successful project delivery, proactively addressing resource constraints, conflicts, or dependencies and escalating when necessary.

Risk & Project Health Management: Continuously evaluate project health and proactively identify, document, mitigate, and escalate risks before they materially impact the customer, schedule, scope, budget, or successful delivery. Support recovery plans for at-risk, stalled, or challenged projects.

Financial Management: Manage project financial performance, including budgets, expenditures, time entries, procurement activity, and invoicing alignment, ensuring projects remain financially aligned with approved scope and expectations.

Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear, timely, and proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders regarding project status, accomplishments, upcoming activities, risks, decisions, and changes. Navigate difficult conversations and de-escalate issues when necessary.

Project Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate and timely project information within Logically’s project management systems, including schedules, forecasts, risks, milestones, financial information, decisions, and communications to support effective project management and leadership reporting.

Project Governance & Escalation: Apply established PMO standards, procedures, and escalation processes while using sound judgment to identify when additional leadership involvement is required to protect the customer experience and successful project delivery.

Mentorship & Team Development: Provide mentorship and guidance to Project Coordinators, helping develop their project management capabilities and promoting consistent application of PMO standards and best practices.

Continuous Improvement: Identify and contribute to opportunities to improve PMO processes, tools, reporting, customer communication, and project delivery practices.

Qualifications:

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience required.
  • 3+ years of project management experience, including experience managing customer-facing projects. Experience within technology, cybersecurity, managed services, or professional services is preferred.
  • Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification preferred but not required.
  • Working knowledge of core project management disciplines, including scope, schedule, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), dependencies, critical path, resource planning, risk management, financial management, and project forecasting.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify project risks and issues, develop practical solutions, and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to establish trust, manage expectations, facilitate meetings, communicate difficult information, and work effectively with technical resources and senior leadership.
  • Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to understand project budgets, customer objectives, and the potential business impact of project decisions, risks, and delays.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, problem-solving, and teamwork skills with the ability to remain effective in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and support the development of team members.
  • Basic knowledge of ConnectWise or similar Professional Services Automation (PSA) and project management platforms preferred.

  • Own outcomes alongside your product and engineering partners: define what success looks like, connect design decisions to measurable customer and business results, and follow the work after launch to see whether it delivered.

  • Set and hold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, and overall product quality, and raise the bar for the wider design team through critique and example.

  • Translate complex financial concepts and flows, such as offers, advances, and repayment timing, into clear, trustworthy experiences.

  • Shape product strategy with your partners: identify the problems that matter most, frame them well, and make tradeoffs explicit.

  • Partner with compliance and legal early, so clarity and trust are built into the experience from the start.

  • Use AI throughout your workflow, from research synthesis and exploration to prototyping and building, and help the team adopt the approaches that work.

  • Help shape the design system and the broader UI patterns that our cash products and the rest of the app rely on.

  • Present work clearly and build alignment among partners and senior leaders with different perspectives and priorities.

  • Mentor other designers and help shape how design operates across product pods.

Why You're a Great Fit

  • Significant experience designing and shipping complex consumer digital products, ideally within fintech, financial services, commerce, transportation, or another multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience as the design owner for a whole product or major product area: you set its design direction and were accountable for the result, beyond designing individual features.

  • A portfolio that shows exceptional visual and UI craft alongside strong UX thinking, at a level that raises the bar for the team around you.

  • A track record of outcomes: examples where your design work measurably moved customer or business results, and how you knew.

  • Comfort setting direction in ambiguous product areas without a fully defined path.

  • Strong interaction-design fundamentals and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Experience working closely with product management and engineering throughout development, and influencing decisions beyond your own team.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior leaders and bringing partners along.

  • Good judgment about when to challenge assumptions, when to seek more context, and when to make a decision.

  • Consistent use of AI tools in your day-to-day design workflow (strongly preferred), with an informed point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing consumer financial products, such as cash advance, banking, payments, or lending

  • Experience prototyping or building in code, including with AI coding tools.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you’ll build a deep understanding of our customers, cash products, and business through shipping; build trusted relationships with your design and cross-functional partners; and form a clear point of view on where the experience should go.

Why Join Us

  • Lead design for the products at the center of Tilt’s business, with meaningful customer and business impact.

  • Set both the experience and the visual direction for a critical financial product.

  • Join a team that values strong design judgment, constructive debate, and thoughtful collaboration.

  • Work directly with product-minded partners who care deeply about customers and shipping useful products.

  • Shape how design operates, including how the team builds with AI, as the product organization evolves.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

About Chainlink Labs

Chainlink Labs is one of the primary contributing developers of Chainlink, the standard for onchain finance enabling high-quality data, secure cross-chain interoperability, and compliant connectivity across global markets. Chainlink powers leading tokenized assets, financial institutions, market infrastructures, and decentralized applications by providing secure access to real-world data, cross-chain messaging, and blockchain connectivity across any network. The Chainlink standard has enabled tens of trillions of dollars in transaction value and is helping unify global markets onchain. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, Aave, Polymarket, Lido, and many others.

Chainlink Labs is a world-class team of developers, researchers, and capital markets experts, and has ranked among Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology, Fortune's Best Medium Workplace, and the Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. Learn more at or.

About the Role
As a dedicated Solutions Architect, you will be pivotal in driving the next stage of growth for Chainlink. You'll work closely with talented sales, product management, and integrations coworkers, acting as a trusted advisor to prospective users by demonstrating how Chainlink’s decentralised oracle network, blockchain oracle infrastructure, and data integration capabilities can securely and reliably connect blockchains to real-world data, off-chain systems, and external APIs.

The Sales team will rely on your technical and product expertise throughout the sales cycle. You will be an integral part of the success of both our users and Account Executives by performing technical discovery qualification, making architectural recommendations for Chainlink solutions, delivering product demonstrations and PoCs, and troubleshooting technical configuration and integration issues.

As a passionate blockchain advocate and user-focused technical advisor, you will connect the dots between technical solutions and business value for users, helping them understand how blockchain oracles, data feeds, cross-chain messaging, and secure off-chain data integrations can power the next generation of DeFi, RWA/tokenised assets, and enterprise blockchain applications.

Requirements

  • Computer science or technical background with at least 5 years of extensive technical account and relationship management experience across large, complex account structures, with the ability to engage stakeholders across all levels and functions of an organisation

  • 2+ years working in RWA/tokenised assets environments and/or experience working with decentralised applications (DApps), smart contracts, blockchain technology, blockchain oracles, or Web3 data infrastructure

  • Hands-on or working experience with blockchain oracle networks, data feeds, off-chain data integrations, API integrations, and/or middleware connecting smart contracts with external systems

  • Strong technical understanding, including the ability to read and comprehend code such as Solidity, Rust, or Move, and navigate large-scale software development projects

  • Experience performing technical discovery qualification with prospective users

  • Ability to make architectural recommendations for Chainlink solutions, including oracle-powered data integrations, smart contract connectivity, and secure blockchain infrastructure

  • Experience troubleshooting technical configuration, integration, and data connectivity issues

  • Pre-sales technology solutions experience, with the ability to deliver Proofs of Concept and confidently run product demos involving blockchain infrastructure, oracle services, or data integration workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Business acumen and experience supporting or driving commercial negotiations

  • Confidence speaking with clients, including technical, product, and business stakeholders

  • Customer success experience with mission-critical software products, infrastructure platforms, or data integration solutions

  • Deep care for user success and helping customers make optimal use of Chainlink products

  • Solid understanding of or experience in the Solana ecosystem

  • Familiarity with decentralised oracle networks, on-chain/off-chain data flows, tokenised asset infrastructure, or enterprise blockchain integrations

Chainlink Labs is a remote-first organization and employment eligibility is contingent upon residing in an approved hiring jurisdiction. Team members may work outside their primary country of legal residence for a maximum of 90 days per calendar year. Please discuss your current location, legal residence, and work authorization with your recruiter during your initial conversation. Unless otherwise stated for a specific role, we require working hours that overlap with Eastern Time (ET).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes.
