About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

This role is the primary driver for ensuring our Scaled customer segment achieves a seamless, high-value experience on Rippling. You are the strategic lead for navigating complex account milestones and specialized technical scenarios. As a Success Operator, you act as a cross-functional project manager to resolve friction points and ensure every account is positioned for a frictionless renewal.

We are not hiring in the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metro.

How you’ll spend your time:

  • 80% Targeted Solutioning & Resolution: You will lead the charge on high-priority cases, acting as a project manager to align internal teams and deliver rapid, comprehensive solutions. You’ll navigate complex scenarios to ensure the customer’s partnership with Rippling remains strong.
  • 20% Proactive Health & Optimization: You will use data-driven insights to identify accounts that need additional guidance before they face hurdles. By identifying these trends, you’ll help refine our internal processes to improve the experience for all Scaled clients.

You’ll monitor key health indicators, such as support ticket patterns and product engagement. When you identify an opportunity to optimize an account, you’ll reach out to the customer to resolve potential frustrations and improve their account health long before it reaches a critical point.

What you will do

  • Account Health & Specialized Resolution (80% of Role)
  • Lead End-to-End Success Workstreams: Serve as the primary project lead for sensitive account milestones. You will drive the resolution of complex, cross-departmental challenges from discovery to completion.
  • Orchestrate Internal Excellence: Act as the central hub between Support, AM, and Product teams. You demonstrate total ownership in high-stakes situations where swift coordination is essential to a healthy partnership.
  • Direct-to-Customer Success Liaison: Act as the polished, authoritative point of contact for Scaled clients navigating complex billing or product configurations. You build trust by serving as the customer’s dedicated champion and technical navigator inside Rippling.
  • Strategic Communication: Translate technical or financial complexities into clear, actionable narratives for both the client and internal leadership.

Proactive Enablement & Insights (20% of Role)

  • Anticipate & Optimize Trends: Conduct strategic account audits to identify early indicators of friction. You will monitor health signals to intervene and improve the customer journey proactively.

Empower & Enable for Long-Term Success: Bridge the gap between "technical resolution" and "platform mastery." You will lead targeted sessions to ensure customers are technically confident and fully utilizing the Rippling ecosystem.

What you will need

  • Experience: 3+ years in a high-intensity, customer-facing role such as Customer Support, Escalations, or Technical Account Management.
  • The Solution Finder Mindset: You have a passion for deconstructing complex problems and seeing a resolution through to the very end, you thrive on finding the "path to yes.
  • Project Management Prowess: Proven ability to act as a project manager, coordinating dozens of moving pieces across multiple departments (Legal, Finance, Product) simultaneously without losing momentum.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Exceptional ability to drive strong, transparent communications. You know how to keep Account Managers and stakeholders "in the loop" while managing the heavy lifting of a resolution.
  • De-escalation Expertise: Exceptional ability to navigate sensitive client conversations with poise, maintaining a firm commercial stance while ensuring the customer feels heard and supported.
  • Technical Savvy: Comfortable navigating complex billing systems and CRM (SFDC) reporting to identify data-driven solutions and trends.

We're looking for a highly analytical Digital Marketing Analytics Executive to help us strengthen our reporting capability, uncover customer behaviour trends and drive smarter business decisions through data.

If you love working with numbers, enjoy solving problems and get satisfaction from transforming complex datasets into meaningful insights, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Working within our Digital team and reporting to the Digital Analytics Lead, you'll play a key role in helping us understand what's driving performance across our digital channels and websites. You'll help move us from manual reporting towards automated, scalable reporting solutions while delivering actionable insight that influences marketing, trading and commercial outcomes across multiple brands. You'll also help shape how analytics, reporting and measurement evolve as we continue to increase our digital maturity.

What will you be doing here as a Digital Marketing Analytics Executive?

  • Own weekly and monthly digital trading and performance reporting across multiple brands, ensuring accuracy, consistency and timely delivery.

  • Build, maintain and continually improve automated dashboards using Looker Studio, Excel and other reporting tools to reduce manual processes and improve efficiency.

  • Maintain and evolve central reporting frameworks that support Digital, Marketing and Performance Reporting teams.

  • Analyse GA4 data to identify customer behaviour trends, performance drivers, conversion opportunities and shifts in user journeys.

  • Deliver clear, actionable insights that support commercial, trading and marketing decision-making.

  • Support funnel analysis, customer journey optimisation and website performance improvements across multiple brands and websites.

  • Identify channel, landing page and customer journey trends that influence lead generation, conversion rates and commercial performance.

  • Support income and sales reporting by connecting digital performance with commercial outcomes and business results.

  • Help maintain accurate tracking and data quality through GA4 and Google Tag Manager, ensuring data integrity and confidence in reporting.

  • Support the housekeeping and governance of tags, pixels and tracking events across multiple digital platforms.

  • Contribute to the development and adoption of future analytics, reporting and measurement capabilities.

  • Work closely with Digital, Product, Optimisation and Marketing teams, as well as external PPC, SEO, affiliate and call-tracking partners.

  • Communicate findings effectively through dashboards, presentations and stakeholder updates, tailoring insight to audiences with varying levels of digital knowledge.

What are we looking for in our next Digital Marketing Analytics Executive?

Essential

  • Experience using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), including events, funnels, explorations and reporting.

  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and data manipulation.

  • Experience building reports and dashboards in Looker Studio or similar visualisation tools.

  • Understanding of digital marketing channels and how they influence business performance.

  • Strong numerical and analytical mindset with a genuine passion for data, trends and problem-solving.

  • Ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into clear, actionable business insight.

  • Ability to work across multiple websites, brands and priorities simultaneously.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work quickly, logically and accurately in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable

  • Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM).

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar tracking platforms.

  • Exposure to call tracking, session recording tools or paid media platforms such as Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

  • Experience with cross-domain tracking.

  • Degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.

What kind of person will succeed in this role?

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious and enjoys asking questions, digging into data and uncovering the reasons behind performance trends. You'll be a logical and structured thinker who enjoys solving problems, improving processes and finding smarter ways of working.

You'll be confident working with stakeholders across multiple functions, comfortable presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, and motivated by turning insight into action. Most importantly, you'll be proactive, adaptable and excited by the opportunity to help build a more data-driven culture across a growing digital function.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a business that is investing heavily in its digital capability and data-driven decision making. You'll have the opportunity to influence reporting processes, shape analytics best practice, improve measurement capability and work across multiple well-established brands while developing your expertise in a growing digital function.

In return you will be welcomed and supported by our Ardonagh family, joining an organisation that cares about you as a person and your wellbeing. Some of the other benefits are:

  • Holiday entitlement of 26 days plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service

  • 35 hour working week

  • Opportunity to progress your career across the entire Ardonagh family

  • Award-winning learning & development offering and support to obtain professional qualifications to enhance your knowledge and career prospects

  • Pension scheme for when you feel it's time to retire

  • 24-hour Employee Assistance support for you and your family's physical and mental wellbeing

  • Corporate perks such as discounted gym memberships, cinema tickets, shopping, eyecare vouchers, cycle to work and much more

  • One day paid volunteering to give back to our communities

  • Ardonagh Community Trust (ACT) raising funds for charity with donation matching in your local community

  • The Spotlight Awards, where we celebrate the best of the Ardonagh Group and all the bright talent across our business.

We offer genuine potential for both personal and professional development. Come and be part of our story and help shape the future of digital analytics and reporting across our business. So, what are you waiting for? Apply today and one of our team will be in touch.

The Principal Leader provides executive oversight and strategic leadership for project governance, commercial compliance, claims management, dispute resolution, lender compliance, and contract administration across major infrastructure and airport development projects. Serves as the Client's principal advisor on contractual, commercial, governance, and risk-related matters, ensuring the protection of the Client's interests throughout the project lifecycle.

Employment is contingent upon the Client's award of the project and successful contract execution.

Key responsibilities:

  • Provide executive leadership and strategic direction for governance, claims management, commercial compliance, and dispute resolution advisory services.
  • Develop and oversee project governance structures, commercial controls, compliance protocols, and management reporting systems.
  • Advise the Client and senior stakeholders on contractual rights, obligations, entitlements, commercial risks, and contractual risk mitigation strategies.
  • Direct the evaluation, substantiation, negotiation, and defense of contractor claims, including Extension of Time (EOT) assessments and associated cost entitlements.
  • Develop and implement dispute avoidance and resolution strategies, including negotiation, mediation, adjudication, and international arbitration.
  • Interface with the Client, project lenders, regulators, contractors, and other senior stakeholders to address contractual, governance, and compliance matters.
  • Provide leadership to multidisciplinary advisory teams and oversee the review of major contractual correspondence, claims submissions, and commercial determinations.
  • Identify and manage contractual and commercial risks, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure appropriate measures are implemented to safeguard the Client's interests. Perform other related responsibilities as required.
  • Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

Qualifications to be successful in the role:

  • Master's degree in Construction Law, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; relevant professional certifications are preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of professional experience in major infrastructure, transportation, or airport development projects.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing claims management, project governance, commercial compliance, and dispute resolution.
  • Extensive experience in construction contract administration, particularly FIDIC-based contracts, including claims assessment, EOT, delay analysis, and contractual entitlement reviews.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing complex contractual disputes and supporting formal dispute resolution proceedings, including international arbitration.
  • Proven ability to provide strategic commercial and contractual advice, manage lender and stakeholder engagements, and lead multidisciplinary advisory teams.

raw.description:
We are looking for a HR Shared Services Lead to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

You’re the one who spots the expiry date before anyone else does, notices when the data doesn’t add up, and quietly keeps the people side of a business running. This role puts that skill at the centre, and gives you the room to redesign how it’s done.

What makes this different

You will lead HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, own UK HR operations, and have a genuine voice in how data and AI change the way HR work gets done. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion, so the work connects to something larger than the queue.

What You'll Do

  • Run a service people trust, and learn from what it tells you. You’ll lead day-to-day delivery in Freshservice, from queue health and SLAs to escalations and quality, and turn ticket and HiBob data into reporting that shows leaders where the friction is and how to remove it.

  • Own UK HR operations from offer to exit. That covers onboarding, right-to-work and sponsorship records, contracts, lifecycle changes, and offboarding for employees, EOR workers and contractors, all audit-ready and protected under UK GDPR.

  • Be the safe pair of hands across payroll and benefits, then make the work lighter. You’ll back up payroll inputs, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, compensation queries and global mobility, and spot where automation and AI can take repetitive admin off people’s plates, with clear SOPs and a knowledge base so nothing lives in one person’s head.

What You'll Need

  • Demonstrable experience leading HR shared services or a comparable service function, with a proven record of managing queues, SLAs, escalations and continuous improvement across several stakeholder groups.

  • Hands-on command of HRIS and service-management platforms (HiBob and Freshservice are ideal, but similar tools transfer well), backed by strong data and analytics skills: reconciling records, building reports and finding the pattern in the noise.

  • Practical UK experience across benefits and payroll administration, pensions, EOR, compensation and right-to-work processes, and real curiosity about what AI can do for HR operations.

A relevant degree is helpful and CIPD progress is a plus. Please don’t talk yourself out of this if you meet most of it. Plenty of strong people hold back from roles unless they tick every box, and we would rather hear from you.

How we work

This is a remote role within a team spread across the UK, Europe and Africa. You’ll report to the Head of HR Shared Services and work closely with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal and IT, plus external partners such as the Home Office, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. You’ll coach colleagues and help shape how the team covers peaks and absences. We care about clear ownership and good outcomes, and we trust you to manage your own time.


The reality check

This role is demanding. You’ll run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with confidential cases and competing priorities arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup, your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. If you’re already the person who closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is based in Malaysia. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Malaysia office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform. Hedera’s public network is governed by industry-leading organizations, spanning 11 sectors and 14 regions who oversee the development and direction of the decentralized platform.

Why this role exists:

We are hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive top-of-funnel pipeline generation for Hashgraph’s enterprise software portfolio, including HashSphere (our private, enterprise-grade distributed ledger platform built on Hedera technology) and Hashgraph’s asset tokenization and cross-ledger settlement solutions. This role exists to identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities, working closely with Sales and Marketing to build a healthy, well-qualified pipeline for our enterprise sales team.

Based on the East Coast, this role will sit close to customers, partners, and market opportunities as we scale commercial adoption in the U.S.

In this role, you will:

This is enterprise sales development for infrastructure that regulated financial institutions will build on, which means the qualification bar and the sophistication of your outreach both need to be higher than at a typical SaaS SDR desk.

  • Research and identify target accounts and key stakeholders across enterprise and financial services segments, including buying committees at Fortune 1000 and regulated financial institutions

  • Generate and qualify new sales opportunities through outbound prospecting (calls, email, social, events), applying sharp judgment on account prioritization rather than volume alone

  • Engage prospective customers to understand business needs and assess fit for Hashgraph's solutions, translating complex technical capability into business value for non-technical stakeholders

  • Partner with Sales Directors to hand off qualified opportunities and support early-stage deal progression

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of prospecting activity and pipeline status in CRM

  • Collaborate with Marketing on campaign follow-up, event outreach, and lead nurturing

  • Continuously refine outbound messaging and prospecting strategy based on market feedback, treating your pipeline as a system to be measured and improved rather than a quota to be hit

What success looks like in 6–12 months:

  • You consistently build a pipeline of well-qualified, sales-ready opportunities each quarter, with opportunity quality holding up under Sales Director scrutiny

  • Your outreach converts at or above target rates for meetings booked and opportunities created

  • Handoffs to Sales are clean, well-documented, and require minimal re-qualification

  • You are recognized as a reliable, high-activity contributor to the sales team's pipeline goals, and increasingly as a credible voice on account strategy

  • You have developed a strong understanding of Hashgraph's products and can speak credibly to prospects, including technically sophisticated buyers in financial services

  • You are positioned for growth into a closing sales role

What you bring:

Core capabilities:

  • Prior experience in an SDR, BDR, or similar outbound sales/prospecting role, with a track record of exceeding activity and pipeline targets (SaaS, enterprise tech, or emerging tech preferred)

  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills; able to engage senior stakeholders, including C-suite and finance/technology leaders, with credibility

  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and comfortable with high-volume outreach without sacrificing precision on targeting

  • Coachable, with a growth mindset and a demonstrated ability to turn feedback into measurably better results

  • Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo)

Functional expertise:

  • Exposure to financial services, enterprise tech, or regulated industries a plus

  • Interest in web3, blockchain, or distributed systems (not required, but valuable)

  • Comfortable learning and articulating technical concepts to a business audience

  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC/MEDPICC)

About Cobalt

At Cobalt, we believe everyone deserves to live and work in a safer, more secure world. Founded in 2013 on the belief that penetration testing could – and should – be better, we set out to challenge the status quo and transform how organizations approach offensive security.

Today, we’re leading the way in transforming the offensive security market, bringing together world-class security expertise, innovative technology and a global community of security professionals to make security testing more seamless, effective and collaborative. Our diverse, fully-remote team partners with organizations of all sizes to help them OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

And we’re just getting started!

AI is fundamentally reshaping the cybersecurity landscape, creating new opportunities, new challenges and entirely new ways of thinking about security. At Cobalt, we’re not waiting to see what happens next; we’re helping define it. We’re challenging conventions, pushing boundaries and reimagining what’s possible in offensive security.

Customers can launch a pentest in as little as 24 hours through our SaaS platform and exclusive Cobalt Core community. With 500+ highly vetted security testers, representing just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core conducts thousands of tests annually, helping organizations identify and remediate risk across their evolving attack surfaces.

This is an exciting time to join Cobalt. We’re looking for ambitious, creative and agile leaders who thrive on change, think beyond traditional playbooks and have the vision to create new categories, shape markets and build what comes next. If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a real impact in a market undergoing significant transformation, we’d love you to be part of our journey.

Description

Cobalt is looking for a Channel Account Manager to develop, manage, and grow our technology and strategic partner ecosystem across the UK. This role will be responsible for building strong relationships with existing partners, identifying and recruiting new strategic partners, and driving joint go-to-market initiatives that generate pipeline and revenue for Cobalt.

You will manage a diverse portfolio of partners, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security and IT consulting firms, and strategic alliance partners. Working closely with partners and internal teams, you will develop joint business plans, strengthen sales and marketing alignment, enable partner teams, and create opportunities to expand Cobalt's market presence.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for someone who can balance strategic relationship management with day-to-day execution. You will own partner engagement and performance across your territory, driving measurable outcomes through partner-sourced pipeline, joint selling initiatives, and revenue growth.

What You Would Do

  • Partner Relationship Management: Own and grow relationships with strategic Cobalt partners across the UK, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security software companies, and IT consulting firms.
  • Partner Recruitment & Development: Identify, engage, and develop new partner relationships while expanding the engagement and contribution of existing partners.
  • Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute partner business plans, go-to-market strategies, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) focused on generating pipeline, increasing partner engagement, and driving shared revenue.
  • Partner Enablement: Train and enable partner sales and technical teams to effectively position Cobalt's Pentest as a Service platform, communicate its value proposition, and identify opportunities within their customer base.
  • Joint Go-to-Market Execution: Build and execute collaborative marketing and sales initiatives, including co-branded content, campaigns, webinars, events, account mapping, lead-sharing programs, and joint customer engagements.
  • Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities through joint prospecting, referrals, co-selling, and reseller activities. Own partner pipeline reporting, forecasting, and progress against revenue targets.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Cobalt's Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to align partner priorities, support joint selling activities, and identify opportunities for deeper solution alignment and market expansion.
  • Partner Operations & Performance: Establish and maintain effective partner engagement processes, including pipeline governance, reporting, lead management, enablement resources, and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Market Development: Identify opportunities to expand Cobalt's presence across EMEA technology and cybersecurity ecosystem through strategic partnerships, industry relationships, and joint market initiatives.

You Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in channel management or partner management within B2B SaaS or cybersecurity (preferrably).
  • Experience managing, developing, or supporting relationships with technology partners, solution integrators, resellers, OEMs, or strategic alliances.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategies, channel sales motions, and partner-led revenue generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, develop joint business plans, and drive measurable business outcomes through partners.
  • Experience developing and executing partner-facing marketing and sales initiatives, including joint campaigns, co-branded content, webinars, events, and account mapping.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Experience managing partner pipelines, tracking performance, and providing accurate reporting and forecasts.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple partner relationships and initiatives while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a quota-carrying role, with direct responsibility for pipeline generation or revenue targets.
  • Existing relationships within the UK and wider Europe cybersecurity, IT services, and technology partner ecosystem.
  • Experience selling or partnering within cybersecurity, penetration testing, or security services.
  • Familiarity with selling into IT and security leadership, including CISOs, CTOs, and other senior technology stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating partner agreements and managing complex partner or alliance relationships.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, PartnerStack, and other CRM or partner management platforms.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a scaling SaaS organization.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Shape the Future of Cybersecurity: Help define the Continuous Offensive Security Market, build Cobalt's global brand and establish category leadership in a rapidly growing industry.
  • Make a Strategic Impact: Work alongside an experienced executive team, influence company strategy and lead a global marketing organization through Cobalt's next phase of growth.
  • Share in Our Success: Enjoy competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan, with the opportunity to share in the long-term value you help create.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Access retirement savings or pension in the EU, healthcare coverage and dedicated stipends for wellness, home office equipment, Wi-Fi and learning and development.
  • Work Flexibly, Live Fully: Benefit from generous flexible paid time off and 6 weeks of paid parental leave, supporting your wellbeing and life beyond work.

was diesen job so besonders macht?

Lead Sales Enablement & Transformation (m/w/d) – Housing & Municipalities
Als Lead Sales Enablement & Transformation übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für ein zentrales Team in unserem Geschäftsbereich Housing & Municipalities, der die Zusammenarbeit von OXG mit der Wohnungswirtschaft und den Kommunen verantwortet. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team entwickelst Du Prozesse, Tools, Capabilities, Steuerungslogiken und die Datenbasis des Bereichs weiter, setzt sie um und gestaltest die Zusammenarbeit mit den angrenzenden Unternehmensbereichen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst ein Team aus Projektmanagerinnen und Projektmanagern und entwickelst es fachlich wie persönlich weiter.
  • Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zu Bereichen wie Customer Operations, Network Deployment, Commercial und Finance.
  • Du legst fest, welche Projekte für den Geschäftsbereich erfolgskritisch sind, und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung.
  • Du identifizierst, bewertest und priorisierst KI-Anwendungsfälle entlang der Strategie des Bereichs.
  • Du erprobst Automatisierungs- und KI-Initiativen in Pilotprojekten, skalierst erfolgreiche Ansätze und verankerst sie dauerhaft in den Fachbereichen.
  • Du vertrittst die Interessen Deines Bereichs aktiv, z.B. wenn unternehmensweit über die Priorität von IT-Projekten entschieden wird.

wann passt du zu uns?

  • Du hast ein Hochschulstudium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst langjährige Vertriebserfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Infrastrukturbranche mit. Den Kabel- und Telekommunikationsmarkt kennst Du fachlich gut.
  • Du hast bereits Führungsverantwortung übernommen, idealerweise fachlich und disziplinarisch.
  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, größere IT- oder KI-Plattformen zu konzipieren und einzuführen, und hast bereits einheitliche Arbeitsweisen, Methoden und Best Practices aufgebaut.
  • Du denkst analytisch und konzeptionell, handelst unternehmerisch und richtest Dich klar an Ergebnissen aus.
  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikation und Moderation, gewinnst Stakeholder auf allen Hierarchieebenen für gemeinsame Ziele und setzt Dich durch, ohne den Teamgedanken aus den Augen zu verlieren.
  • Du bist offen für Veränderungen und treibst Innovationen aktiv voran.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab.

was kannst du von uns erwarten?

  • Flache Hierarchien mit Raum für Deine Ideen und konstruktives Feedback.
  • Übernahme der Kosten für einen leistungsstarken Internetanschluss mit bis zu 50 € netto im Monat.
  • Digitaler Essenszuschuss von bis zu 115,05 € netto im Monat, egal wo Du bist und isst.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Option, jederzeit innerhalb Deutschlands von zu Hause zu arbeiten und sogar bis zu 25 Tage im europäischen Ausland.
  • Monatlicher Rabatt von 40 € auf Deine Mobilfunk- oder Festnetzrechnung durch unseren Partner Vodafone.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr, plus Heiligabend und Silvester und mit Xtra-Plus bis zu 10 Tage unbezahlten Urlaub on top.
  • Zuschuss für Dein Bikeleasing über EURORAD für umweltfreundliches Pendeln und die Unterstützung Deiner Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club und Kooperation mit awo lifebalance.
  • 5 % zusätzlich zu deinem Jahresgrundgehalt für Deine Altersvorsorge, mit der Freiheit, flexibel zu entscheiden, wie Du dieses Extra für Deine Zukunft einsetzen möchtest.
  • 3-monatige Entgeltfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall sowie Absicherung bei Invalidität und im Todesfall.
  • Unsere oben genannten Bandbreiten umfassen Komponenten wie z.B. Grundgehalt, Bonus, Pension Allowance, Lunch- und Internetzuschuss sowie der rechnerische Wert eines möglichen Dienstwagens. Ein Angebot wird dann final immer unter Berücksichtigung der Ausbildung und relevanter Berufserfahrung eines/einer Kandidat*in erstellt.

raw.title: Tech Lead (Investment & Growth)
raw.excerpt: Tangem is a high-tech company in the blockchain sector was founded in 2017, headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with branches in North America, Eastern Europe, and APAC.
raw.description:
Tangem is a high-tech company in the blockchain sector was founded in 2017, headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with branches in North America, Eastern Europe, and APAC.

Tangem started with the idea of bringing digital assets to the masses using a unique combination of a smartcard-based hardware wallet and mobile applications. Company owns and promotes the technology of hardware cold-wallet for digital assets with secure and simple UX in 220 countries today. Our customers enjoy setup time within 1 minute with the ultimate security level for digital assets on their wallet. Tangem solutions offer multi-support of a growing number of thousands of tokens by a single wallet. SBI Crypto Investment Ltd., the digital asset venture investment company wholly owned by SBI Holdings Inc., has invested $15 million into Tangem in 2019 for mass adoption of blockchain technology.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to own the technical direction and architecture of our Investment & Growth stream. You’ll work across mobile, backend, and blockchain, ensuring all components work reliably together. You’ll be involved from the start of each feature, making key technical decisions and identifying potential risks.

The role also includes cross-team technical leadership and delivery ownership for swaps, on-ramps, staking and yield, RWA, prediction markets, and trading venue integrations. The stream consists of around 15–25 engineers across five sub-streams, covering iOS, Android, Backend, Blockchain, and QA, with dedicated functional leads for each engineering discipline.

A strong understanding of self-custody, third-party integrations, and reliable money-moving systems is essential.

Responsibilities:

Architecture and Hands-On Work
  • Own technical architecture across mobile, backend, and blockchain components within the Grow stream;
  • Get involved at the start of each major feature to define architecture, identify technical risks, and ensure smooth integration between systems;
  • Review architecture decisions across teams and make sure mobile, backend, and blockchain components work reliably together;
  • Own the provider layer across swap, on-ramp, staking, and venue integrations;
  • Design transaction lifecycle handling for money-moving flows: idempotency, state machines for long-running operations, retries, partial fills, stalled transactions, and reconciliation with partners;
  • Lead technical evaluation and onboarding of aggregators, on-ramp providers, staking providers, exchanges, and perp venues.
Delivery
  • Own end-to-end delivery for all Grow sub-streams: scope, estimates, dependencies, release plan, and launch;
  • Coordinate technical decisions and dependencies across iOS, Android, backend, and blockchain teams;
  • Run one delivery plan across sub-streams competing for shared engineering capacity and negotiate trade-offs;
  • Manage dependencies on shared platform teams and the Store and Spend streams;
  • Report status, risks, and forecasts to the CTO.
Team and Process
  • Provide technical leadership across the stream, working closely with functional engineering leads;
  • Support engineers through technical guidance, feedback, and hiring;
  • Own on-call and incident response wherever user funds are in motion, with severity levels and MTTR targets;
  • Build deeper domain expertise across teams, particularly around execution, settlement, and custody.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in engineering, with 3+ years of technical leadership experience delivering consumer products in production;
  • Strong hands-on architecture experience across mobile and backend systems. Able to design and review technical solutions across all three areas, identify integration risks, and guide implementation;
  • Experience with Kotlin or Node.js. Strong understanding of backend architecture, APIs, microservices, asynchronous communication, and distributed systems;
  • Mobile engineering & delivery: Experience working with iOS/Android teams, understanding mobile architecture, release processes, and platform constraints. Able to identify technical risks and coordinate cross-platform delivery;
  • Still technical. Able to investigate production issues and debug failed transactions end to end. This is not a purely managerial role.
  • Multi-chain in practice: EVM plus at least one of Solana, TON, Bitcoin/UTXO, or Cosmos. Transaction lifecycle, fee and nonce management, re-orgs, token approvals, address derivation, and signing constraints;
  • DeFi integration: has shipped DEX aggregation and routing, staking (delegation, unbonding, reward accounting), or yield vaults. Treats slippage, MEV, and quote decay as engineering problems;
  • Trading-venue integration: experience with exchange APIs in production — REST and WebSocket, rate limits, order lifecycle, deposits and withdrawals, settlement, and custody boundaries. Can explain how a quote becomes a fill and what breaks in between;
  • Money-movement correctness: idempotency, exactly-once semantics, reconciliation, long-running state machines, and observability. Has been on call for systems where a bug costs users money;
  • Experience coordinating architecture and delivery across multiple teams or workstreams;
  • Has managed technical relationships with third-party providers, including holding them accountable.


  • Nice to have:
    • Strong blockchain fundamentals. Understands how smart contracts work and interact with applications, common blockchain standards (including EVM/EIP/ERC concepts), transaction execution, and basic smart contract security risks;
    • Has built systems where settlement, reconciliation, and order lifecycle carried real consequences: brokerage, CFD, payments, or PSP;
    • Derivatives literacy — margin, funding rates, liquidation mechanics. Directly relevant to the Hyperliquid sub-stream;
    • Prediction markets or event contracts. Directly relevant to the Polymarket sub-stream;
    • Regulated delivery: MiCA and CASP, travel rule, geo-restriction design, KYC and AML flows;
    • Security engineering around signing flows, key material, and third-party risk.

What We Offer:

  • Stability, development, participation in the future unicorn's growth;
  • Remote work from anywhere in the world;
  • Competitive salary in EUR/USDT;
  • Unlimited vacation;
  • Birthday presents;
  • Compensation for the purchase of necessary technical devices for the work;
  • Paid sick leaves.

raw.description:
The Role

We're looking for a commercially driven Account Manager to own customer relationships from onboarding through renewal and expansion. This role combines customer success with revenue ownership, helping customers maximize the value of GovTribe while driving retention, AI adoption, and account growth. Although this is a remote role, preference will be given to candidates living in the D.C., Maryland, or Virginia (DMV) area.

Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of customer accounts, with direct accountability for renewals, retention, expansion, and revenue growth.
  • Lead customer onboarding and implementation, ensuring a smooth transition from the sales process and helping customers realize value quickly.
  • Drive adoption of GovTribe's platform capabilities, subscription features, and AI tools, helping customers identify new use cases and maximize their investment.
  • Proactively engage customers to understand business needs, strengthen relationships, and uncover opportunities for account growth.
  • Manage the renewal process, including pricing discussions, negotiations, and identifying opportunities for subscription upgrades and AI credit purchases.
  • Monitor account health, engagement, and AI usage to identify churn risks and opportunities for increased adoption and expansion.
  • Develop account plans for high-value customers, identifying key stakeholders, growth opportunities, and renewal strategies.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to address customer needs, improve retention, and support long-term account growth.

Qualifications

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in SaaS account management, customer success, or relationship-based sales, with demonstrated responsibility for renewals and account expansion.
  • Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to identify, develop, and close revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Experience onboarding customers, driving product adoption, and building long-term customer relationships.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable owning revenue targets, customer relationships, and account performance.
  • Strong communication, organizing and account planning skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with multiple stakeholders, including senior decision-makers.
  • Data-driven approach to account management, using customer engagement, product usage, and account health metrics to guide decisions.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Knowledge of government contracting (GovCon) and federal procurement
  • Familiarity with AI-powered SaaS products and hands-on experience using large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools.
  • Experience helping customers adopt AI tools, identify new use cases, and expand usage.
  • Familiarity with usage-based pricing, subscription models, and SaaS retention and expansion metrics.
  • Experience managing mid-market or enterprise customer relationships.

About GovExec

GovExec’s data and insights set the standard for depth, accuracy, and impact for government leaders and contractors. As the market-leading information and intent-based marketing platform, for over fifty years GovExec has empowered the government ecosystem to engage and support government leaders as they work to achieve their missions across federal, defense, and state and local agencies. Our strategic sales enablement and intent-based marketing solutions accelerate revenue growth to fuel market success. The platform is powered by the largest and most sophisticated database in the public sector, GovExec’s platform reaches 3.3 million government influencers each month and provides its marketing clients with a significant competitive advantage in driving higher conversion and growth.

Working at GovExec

At GovExec, we believe that a new era of work -- particularly when, where, and how it gets done -- has arrived. We are building a hybrid workplace that allows for greater freedom and flexibility while also fostering a collaborative culture, no matter where you are working. GovExec offers permanent remote work in 20+ states across the US, as well as the option to work out of one of our offices based in Washington DC, New York or Connecticut. GovExec also offers a range of great benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Open time off policy
  • Twelve weeks paid parental leave
  • Supportive, collaborative teams
  • Unique opportunity to help government officials from a private sector company
  • Expansive learning and development opportunities

Commitment to Shared Values

GovExec recruits talent for four salient attributes or qualities:

  • Soul of Entrepreneurship
  • Culture of Inclusion
  • Force of Ideas
  • Spirit of Generosity

The compensation range for this role is $75,000 to $100,000, including commission potential.

Government Executive Media Group, Inc. and its affiliates ("GovExec") are Equal Opportunity Employers. We do not discriminate against our applicants because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law.

raw.excerpt: Senior Director, Client Experience About the Role Market My Market is looking for a Senior Director, Client Experience to own the Client Experience department.
raw.description:
Senior Director, Client Experience

About the Role

Market My Market is looking for a Senior Director, Client Experience to own the Client Experience department. Today that department serves more than 320 clients and is made up of two Directors, Client Experience, roughly 11 Client Experience Managers, and 7 Client Success Assistants. This is the leader our two Directors report to, and the person the whole department looks to for direction, standards, and accountability.

This is a leadership seat first. It is built for someone who has already run a client-facing organization inside a fast-growing digital marketing agency, who knows what it takes to keep clients for years, and who can set the tone for how an entire department communicates, inspects its own work, and gets ahead of problems before clients feel them.

You will also keep your feet wet by managing a small portfolio of approximately five accounts of your own, so you are living the same client conversations, reports, and results your team is accountable for. You will own retention, the client messaging standard, and the department's operating rhythm. You will look at the KPIs every week, ask the questions no one else is asking, and teach your directors and their teams to do the same. When something is off, you will propose the fix, not just flag the issue. The Senior Director, Client Experience reports to the CEO and sits on the leadership team.

What You Will Own

Department Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable Client Experience Managers a team of roughly 11 Client Experience Managers and 7 Client Success Assistants serving 320+ clients. This role will have a handful of direct reports, and will also monitor the success of Client Experience Managers and Client Success Assistants that report to other Directors of Client Experience
  • Set clear expectations and scoreboards for every seat in the department, then inspect against them consistently. Praise in public, correct in private, and never let a miss go unaddressed.
  • Own the department's operating cadence: weekly KPI reviews, portfolio health reviews, one-on-ones, and quarterly rocks that ladder up to company goals.
  • Build the bench. Identify and develop the next generation of CX leaders and make sure every director and manager has a growth plan.
  • Represent Client Experience on the leadership team and partner with the SEO, Content, Paid, Creative, and Business Development leaders so clients experience one company, not five departments.

Client Retention & Portfolio Health

  • Own client retention and lifetime value across every account the department manages. Retention is the number this role is measured on first.
  • Build and run an early-warning system for at-risk clients: know which accounts are drifting before they tell us, and make sure there is a documented save plan and an owner on every one.
  • Personally get involved in the accounts that matter most and the escalations that could cost us a client, then turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook for the team.
  • Drive renewals, upsell, and cross-sell as a natural outcome of well-run accounts, working closely with Business Development.
  • Set the standard for onboarding, the first 90 days, and QBRs so every client understands what we are doing, why, and what it is producing.
  • Manage approximately five client accounts of your own to the same standard you hold the team to, and use that hands-on experience to keep your coaching, playbooks, and expectations grounded in reality.

Messaging & Value Communication

  • Own the messaging standard for the entire department: how we talk about results, how we explain what happened in a month, how we deliver hard news, and how we frame the next recommendation.
  • Build the frameworks, templates, and talk tracks that turn rankings, traffic, calls, and leads into a clear ROI story a practice or business owner cares about.
  • Review client-facing communication, reports, and meeting recaps regularly and coach to the standard. If a client is confused about the value they are getting, that is on us.
  • Make sure every CXM can explain the full MMM offering, including SEO, paid ads, content, web, and Google Business Profile, and position it in a way that fits each client's goals.

KPIs, Inspection & Proactive Operations

  • Define the department's KPIs, including retention, NPS, response time, meeting cadence, upsell, and portfolio health, and report on them to the CEO and leadership team every week.
  • Look at the numbers before anyone asks. Spot the trend, dig into the cause, and show up with a point of view and a recommendation.
  • Teach the team to be proactive, not reactive. Build the habits and checklists that mean clients hear from us with the answer, not the other way around.
  • Audit the work: sit in on client calls, read the reports, review the Asana boards, listen to CallRail calls, and use what you find to raise the bar.
  • Get the most out of the tools we have already invested in, including Zoom Revenue Accelerator, HubSpot, Claude, Replit, and our internal apps, then push them further. Use call intelligence to coach, CRM data to spot risk, and AI to take manual work off the team's plate.
  • Champion automation and AI inside the department so the team spends its time on strategy and relationships instead of manual work, and hold the team to actually adopting what we build.

Solutions & Opportunities

  • Come to the table with solutions. When a process breaks, a client churns, or a report misses the mark, own the root cause and bring a proposed fix with a plan to roll it out.
  • Look for opportunities others miss: new service lines clients are asking for, packaging that would retain better, processes that would free up capacity, and gaps between what we sell and what we deliver.
  • Partner with the SEO Director, Content Director, and PPC Manager on delivery issues that show up in client conversations, and push for fixes that stick.
  • Contribute to case studies, webinars, and thought leadership that show clients and prospects what great looks like.

What Success Looks Like

  • In the first year: Retention is up and churn is predictable, with every at-risk account identified early and worked to a plan.
  • Across the department: Every director and manager knows their numbers, owns their scoreboard, and can explain the story behind it without prompting.
  • With clients: Clients can articulate the value they get from Market My Market because the team has been trained to communicate it clearly and consistently.
  • With leadership: The CEO and leadership team can trust that Client Experience is run, inspected, and improving without needing to step in.

Requirements

  • Rapid-growth agency experience (required): You have been part of a digital marketing agency that grew rapidly, ideally from roughly $15 million to $30 million or more in annual revenue, and you understand what that growth does to a client-facing team and how to lead through it.
  • SEO and digital marketing background (required): You have worked in SEO-led digital marketing and are fluent in paid ads, content, web, and local search as part of an integrated offering. You can hold your own in a strategy conversation with a client or an SEO director.
  • Local professional services clients (required): Your client experience has been with local professional services businesses. Direct experience with legal, dental, medical, or veterinary clients is a strong plus.
  • Proven leadership (required): You have led leaders. You have managed managers or directors, built teams, set KPIs, held people accountable, and developed people into bigger roles. Ten or more years in client-facing roles with at least five in leadership is typical.
  • Retention track record: You have owned retention numbers for a book of business and can talk specifically about how you moved them.
  • Analytical, hands-on with systems, and tech-forward: You live in the data and you are an early adopter. You are comfortable with CRMs (HubSpot preferred), conversation intelligence such as Zoom Revenue Accelerator, AI tools like Claude, low-code platforms like Replit, call tracking, and project management tools, and you use them to inspect and improve rather than just report.
  • Exceptional communicator: You write and speak clearly, coach others to do the same, and can deliver a hard message to a client or a teammate with directness and care.
  • Ownership mindset: You are proactive, solutions-focused, and comfortable owning outcomes. You bring answers, not just questions.

Location

This position is fully remote and we are only hiring candidates located in the following states:

  • Alabama
  • California
  • Colorado
  • Florida
  • Iowa
  • Indiana
  • North Carolina
  • New Jersey
  • Nevada
  • New York
  • Maryland
  • South Carolina
  • Texas
  • Utah
  • Virginia
  • Washington

Our Core Values

  • Do What You Say
  • Be Honest and Transparent
  • Proactive, Not Reactive
  • Be Thought-Leading
  • Instill Trust Through Consistent Accountability
  • Always Do Better, Always Be Better
  • Do the Right Thing for Clients and MMM

About Market My Market

Market My Market specializes in tailored marketing solutions for law firms, medical and dental offices. Our mission is to deliver measurable results while fostering team growth, accountability, and innovation. We prioritize a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

This is a full-time, salaried position with benefits, including PTO, health insurance (Day 1 eligibility), and 401(k) eligibility after one year.

All emails will come from a @marketmymarket.com or @applytojob.com domain only. All other emails are fraudulent. We will never interview candidates via Microsoft Teams.

Job Description:

About Alpine Physician Partners

Alpine Physician Partners collaborates with independent physician groups to deliver coordinated, value-based care that improves outcomes and lowers the total cost of care. Our clinical and coding teams support providers with accurate, compliant documentation and coding practices that make value-based care possible.

Position Summary

The Data Entry Specialist – Coding Support is responsible for aggregating information from multiple source documents and accurately entering coding notes for ICD-10 conditions and Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCCs) into the physician electronic medical record (EMR). This role supports the accuracy and completeness of risk adjustment documentation by ensuring chart entries are entered efficiently, consistently, and in accordance with established quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Aggregate information from various source documents, including medical records, coding worksheets, and provider notes, to prepare accurate chart entries.
  • Enter coding notes for ICD-10 conditions and HCCs into the physician EMR in accordance with established documentation and data entry standards.
  • Complete a minimum of 50–75 chart entries per day while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Verify entered data against source documentation to confirm accuracy and completeness before finalizing chart entries.
  • Identify and escalate discrepancies, missing information, or unclear documentation to the appropriate coding or clinical team member.
  • Maintain organized tracking of daily entry volume and completion status.
  • Follow established data entry workflows and update procedures as processes evolve.
  • Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy and security regulations when handling protected health information.
  • Partner with coding, quality, and compliance teams to support accurate and timely risk adjustment documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior data entry experience required; experience with high-volume data entry strongly preferred.
  • Strong typing accuracy and speed, with demonstrated attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR/EMR) systems and standard office software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet daily production targets in a fully remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage repetitive tasks with consistent accuracy over the course of a workday.
  • Must reside in the United States; reliable internet access and a secure home workspace are required to maintain HIPAA and data security compliance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare or medical terminology background preferred, but not required.
  • Experience working in a healthcare, medical billing, or coding support role.
  • Experience in a value-based care, ACO, or managed care environment.

Salary Range:

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

raw.description:
JOB POSTING

Manager, Business Development

ABOUT THE CANADIAN PARALYMPIC COMMITTEE

The Canadian Paralympic Committee is a non-profit, private organization in collaboration with 28 member sport organizations. We are deeply committed to harnessing the transformative power and impact of Paralympic sport.

With a vision of fostering an inclusive world through Paralympic sport, our mission emphasizes both the excellence in games preparation and the promotion of inclusive communities. By celebrating the stories and successes of high-performance athletes with disabilities, the Canadian Paralympic Committee aims to inspire all Canadians to embrace inclusivity and actively engage in sports.

Job Summary

The Manager, Business Development is responsible for driving new corporate partnership revenue and developing strategic commercial opportunities that support the growth of the Canadian Paralympic Committee (CPC). This is a key role within the organization, helping to identify and cultivate new partnerships, alongside other revenue-generating initiatives aligned with CPC's business objectives.

Working closely with the Director, Partnerships & Commercial Strategy, the Manager, Business Development will manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and relationship development through proposal creation, negotiation, and contract execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong sales acumen with a passion for sport, inclusion, and social impact.

Type: Full-time

Reports To: Director, Partnerships and Commercial Strategy

Compensation: $70,000-$78,000 annually plus benefits

Location: Remote within Canada, with travel for occasional in-person meetings.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

New Business Development

  • Identify and develop prospective corporate partners across priority categories as identified by both the candidate and the larger CPC team.
  • Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outreach, networking, referrals, and industry engagement.
  • Develop tailored partnership strategies that align prospective partner business objectives with CPC assets, programs, athletes, and events.
  • Lead prospect meetings, negotiations, and contract discussions.
  • Achieve annual revenue targets and key performance indicators related to partnership acquisition.

Partnership Sales Process

  • Create compelling partnership proposals and commercial recommendations.
  • Have a thorough understanding of key CPC assets across Canadian Paralympic Teams, Athletes, digital content, experiential activations, hospitality opportunities, impact initiatives and the Paralympic Foundation of Canada.
  • Ability to package the above-mentioned assets and develop integrated programs for prospective partners.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications and Sport teams to develop innovative partnership concepts and integrated campaigns.

Revenue Strategy

  • Maintain accurate sales activity, forecasting, and opportunity tracking.
  • Develop account plans and prospect strategies that support long-term revenue growth across the CPC.
  • Prepare revenue reports, forecasts, and pipeline updates for senior leadership.
  • Contribute to annual business planning and commercial strategy development.
  • Monitor industry trends, company investment priorities, and corporate social impact initiatives.
  • Identify emerging sectors and partnership opportunities that align with CPC's strategic objectives.

Relationship Building

  • Represent CPC at industry events, conferences and networking functions.
  • Build relationships with decision-makers, including marketing leaders, sponsorship managers, CSR executives and agency partners.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless transition from sales to partnership activation following contract execution.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Sport Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in partnership sales, business development, sports marketing, media sales, or related commercial functions.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing complex sales cycles and negotiating partnership agreements.
  • Experience within the Paralympic, Olympic and/or National Sport Organization ecosystem is considered an asset

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong consultative sales and relationship management skills.
  • Elite presentation, proposal writing, and communication abilities.
  • Net new prospecting and business development capabilities, including strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Highly organized with strong project management abilities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms
  • Strong financial literacy and ability to develop partnership valuations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, and Copilot.

Working Conditions

· Remote Environment: working from home most of the time

· Staff based outside of Ottawa will be expected to travel to Ottawa a few times a year or as the job demands.

· Overnight and overseas travel and off-site work required (e.g. Games, Events, Meetings, etc.)

· Will be required to work evenings and weekends during busy periods, including Games and other special events.

Application Process

If you share our passion for sport and are committed to CPC’s values, please submit your cover letter and résumé.

Please apply through BambooHR using the link provided.

Deadline to apply: December 4th, 2026, at 5 PM EST

We will contact only candidates selected for an interview.

Important Information: CPC conducts all recruitment and selection activities in-house and does not utilize external recruitment agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters as part of its hiring process. All communications regarding employment opportunities and hiring decisions will come directly from authorized CPC employees. We encourage candidates to exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of any employment-related communications.

CPC is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, record of offences, age, marital status, family status, or disability. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented or marginalized groups to apply.

CPC welcomes and encourages applications from First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, women, and/or 2SLGBTQ+ individuals. Accommodation is available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

raw.description:
Want to be a bswifter?

At bswift we’ve been transforming benefits administration since 1996, making it simpler, smarter, and more human. Our state-of-the-art, cloud-based technology and services empower employees to understand, manage, and love their benefits. From downtown Chicago, and remotely across the country, we serve thousands of companies and millions of people nationwide, reducing administrative burdens and freeing HR teams to focus on creating thriving, people-first workplaces.

We’re looking for motivated and goal-driven individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence and creating solutions that make a difference. The reward is a fun, flexible and creative environment with ample opportunity for professional and personal growth. If you love the bswift values of pursue excellence, embrace accountability, deliver superior service, and be a great place to work, we want to hear from you!

ABOUT US

bswift is a leading benefits administration company that specializes in providing tailored solutions for our clients. Our mission is to simplify the complex world of employee benefits and deliver exceptional service to our clients. We are looking for a talented and experienced individual to join our team as the Customer Service Representative.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Service Center Customer Service Representative is directly responsible for helping meet and exceed client expectations by supporting our clients and their employees with our best-in-class HR software and services. As a Health Concierge, you will answer incoming calls and chats from customers about their employer's benefits plans, educate and advise callers on their benefits, the system, and related processes, process enrollment-related transactions, take ownership of issues through resolution, research and follow up on customer requests, troubleshoot issues, and document customer interactions and solutions in a client system.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR (Essential Functions):

  • Answer incoming calls and chats from customers regarding their employer's benefits plans.
  • Educate and advise customers on benefit plans, the system, and related processes in a clear and understandable way.
  • Process enrollment-related transactions.
  • Take ownership of customer issues through resolution in accordance with business protocols.
  • Research customer requests and follow up with customers as needed.
  • Troubleshoot customer issues and reduce customer effort by problem-solving on the customer's behalf.
  • Document customer interactions, requests, and solutions in the applicable client system.
  • Consistently provide exceptional customer service in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor and communicate efficiently and effectively with all levels of personnel.
  • Maintain schedule flexibility within Service Center hours of operation, including potential weekend hours.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (Required Education and Experience):

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to use company resources to comprehend health and insurance plan concepts and explain them in a way customers understand.
  • Ability to retain information on fundamental benefit plan concepts.
  • Proficiency using a Windows 10 computer and Microsoft Office applications, primarily Outlook and Word.
  • Ability to use dual monitors.
  • Customer service mindset with a passion to serve and the ability to provide exceptional customer service consistently in a high-volume environment.
  • Advocate mindset with demonstrated problem-solving skills to reduce customer effort and resolve issues per business protocol.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and a positive, professional demeanor in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work any Service Center hours of operation from 7:00 AM CST to 7:00 PM CST; weekend hours may also be required.
  • Ability to maintain a quiet, private work-at-home environment free from distractions, with sufficient space for a computer, additional monitor, keyboard, and mouse. If children are at home, they must have other dedicated supervision.
  • High-speed internet with the ability to connect the company-provided computer to the home router via Ethernet cable. Minimum speeds are 25 MB download and 3 MB upload, as measured by speedtest.org.
  • WiFi, WiMax, satellite, cellular, wireless, hotspot connections, public internet locations, and working outside the home office are not acceptable alternatives to a wired high-speed internet connection.

NICE TO HAVE (Preferred education and experience):

  • Associate degree or equivalent experience preferred.

OTHER DUTIES

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Standard working hours are 8am-5pm Central Time, unless otherwise stated in the job description.

Why Join bswift?

At bswift, we empower our employees to make a meaningful impact, innovate, and grow. Joining our team means stepping into a collaborative and dynamic environment that values creativity, initiative, and a passion for client success. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and values each team member’s unique contributions.

Benefits of Working at bswift:

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Access to health, dental, and vision plans to support your wellness and that of your family.
  • Competitive Compensation: A compensation package that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions, including performance-based incentives for most roles.
  • Remote first, Office friendly environment! No time to commute? No problem!
  • Retirement Savings Plans: Options to help you plan for a secure financial future with employer-sponsored retirement savings programs.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for career growth, including training and access to resources to support your career progression.
  • Supportive Culture: A work environment that encourages collaboration, open communication, and creative problem-solving, where your voice and ideas are valued.
  • Employee Wellbeing Initiatives: Programs focused on mental health, financial planning, and wellness resources to help you thrive inside and outside of work.

Make an Impact: At bswift, your work directly contributes to transforming how organizations approach benefits administration and client engagement. Join us to be part of an organization that is making a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients and their employees.

Specific benefit offerings vary by position and may be subject to change.

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $16.00-$19.00, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at bswift, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition to those factors – we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package!

At bswift, our mission is clear: Become the preeminent benefits administrator through exceptional people, innovative technology, and delighted customers. And our values are at the heart of everything we do to accomplish that mission. We Pursue Excellence, Embrace Accountability, Deliver Superior Service, and strive to Be A Great Place To Work. We take pride in having an engaged, collaborative team that goes the extra mile to get the job done right.

bswift has been regularly named one of Chicago’s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For®, as well as one of the Nation’s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For® year after year. We offer a fun, flexible, and creative environment where you can grow both professionally and personally.

If you have what it takes to join our award-winning culture, we’d love to hear from you!
