Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and provide the most seamless onboarding experience for our customers.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Role

As an Implementation Specialist at Keeper Security, your role will be pivotal in guaranteeing the successful onboarding and adoption of our products by our customers. You will engage in close collaboration with our customers and work closely with our Implementation Manager to comprehend their unique requirements, subsequently configuring our solutions to precisely align with their needs. Your expertise and meticulous attention to detail will serve as the cornerstone for providing our customers with a seamless and exceptional experience.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the delivery of Keeper’s software for all customers including initial deployments of new customers and expansion deployments of existing customers. This includes mastery level understanding of our complex line of technical SaaS products
  • Tailor our solutions to meet the specific needs and objectives of each customer, ensuring a personalized and effective experience
  • Offer continuous technical support to customers, adeptly troubleshooting issues and efficiently resolving any concerns as they arise. Furthermore, proactively recognize and rectify project-related risks and issues, promptly escalating them to engineering only when required
  • Maintain accurate records of customer configurations, customizations, and communication to ensure a comprehensive understanding of each implementation
  • Gather feedback from customers and collaborate with the product development team to improve the functionality and usability of our solutions
  • Effectively oversee multiple implementation projects concurrently, ensuring their timely delivery within predefined scope
  • Maintain consistent and transparent communication of project status and progress to internal stakeholders and customers, promptly addressing any arising issues or concerns

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of progressive experience in SaaS support and/or implementation
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Experience with Google docs and MS-office tools
  • Experience in SaaS deployment with security software experience preferred
  • Proficiency in leading external customer engagements
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively manage customer relationships
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, across global regions and time zones

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with project management tools such as
  • French language skills
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business administration (or a field related to project management) or equivalent work experience

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401k (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

About the Role

As the first marketing hire at an early-stage aerospace company, you will build the marketing function from the ground up. You will shape how sophisticated technology is understood by customers and the market, working closely with technical and commercial teams.

What You'll Do

  • Develop product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans that translate technical capabilities into clear commercial value.

  • Build a distinctive brand and category narrative from the ground up.

  • Write and create marketing materials, presentations, technical content, and launch communications.

  • Partner with engineers, scientists, and commercial colleagues to understand products, customers, and buying processes.

  • Lead marketing projects end to end and coordinate external creative partners as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • 8 to 12 years of marketing experience, including substantial hands-on product marketing work in positioning, messaging, and go-to-market.

  • Experience building a marketing function at an early-stage or high-growth startup, with a track record of taking a product or brand from zero to one.

  • Background marketing technical products at a strong brand-led technology company, ideally in aerospace, space, advanced manufacturing, or industrial technology.

  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex technology accurately and compellingly.

  • Strong commercial instincts and experience working directly with technical and commercial teams.

  • Highly hands-on, execution-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively in a resource-constrained environment.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $200,000 to $275,000 annually.

Location

On-site in Los Angeles, California.

Compensation Range: $200K - $275K

  • Mapeo de mercado y sourcing directo en LinkedIn Recruiter para identificar perfiles de ventas e IT.

  • Realizar primeras llamadas de evaluación ágiles.

  • Gestión del pipeline y actualización constante del ATS (aquí usamos Team Taylor, ¡te encantará lo sencillo que es!).

  • Entrevistas en profundidad y roleplays de ventas.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Contrato: Indefinido (con periodo de prueba de 6 meses).

  • Retribución: Atractivo paquete retributivo compuesto por un salario fijo competitivo + variable sobre la facturación de cada proceso que cierres (¡sin techos!).

  • Modelo de trabajo: 100% Remoto en Madrid

  • Conciliación y Flexibilidad: Horario flexible centrado en objetivos. Los viernes hacemos jornada intensiva.

  • Horario de Verano: Jornada intensiva completa durante los meses de julio y agosto.

  • Vacaciones: 23 días laborables + el día de tu cumpleaños libre + el 24 y 31 de diciembre libres.

Si eres una persona activa, te motiva el área comercial y quieres incorporarte a un equipo donde tu trabajo impacte de verdad, ¡queremos conocerte!

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Coinbase is looking for a Senior SEC Reporting Accountant to join our Financial Reporting organization. You will help prepare accurate, timely financial statements and disclosures that explain Coinbase’s financial results and evolving business. This hands-on role offers exposure to complex accounting and reporting matters, close collaboration with cross-functional partners, and opportunities to improve how we deliver public-company reporting.

What you’ll do:

  • Prepare financial statements, footnotes, and supporting schedules for Forms 10-Q and 10-K, and support financial information included in earnings releases and related Form 8-K filings.
  • Analyze period-over-period financial results, investigate changes with accounting and business partners, and draft clear explanations to support disclosures and MD&A.
  • Maintain accurate reporting schedules, source-data links, and tie-outs in Workiva, ensuring disclosures reconcile to underlying accounting records and approved support.
  • Coordinate inputs and resolve questions with Controllership, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and external auditors.
  • Execute reporting controls and support audit requests, disclosure checklists, and filing activities.
  • Research US GAAP and SEC disclosure requirements, document findings, and escalate questions requiring additional judgment.
  • Improve reporting templates, documentation, and workflows through standardization, automation, and AI.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • CPA or equivalent required.
  • 6+ years of relevant accounting experience, external reporting, or public-company financial reporting, including recent hands-on preparation or audit of 10-Q / 10-K processes.
  • Strong understanding of US GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, financial statement preparation, and internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Ability to prepare accurate supporting schedules, investigate discrepancies, and connect financial disclosures to underlying accounting activity.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with experience using financial reporting tools such as Workiva and ERP systems such as NetSuite.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables under reporting deadlines.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

raw.title: Head of Growth, Tilt Mexico
raw.excerpt: Join the Tilt team At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.
raw.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Head of Growth, Tilt Mexico

Mexico was Tilt's first market outside the US. Since 2022, our mobile-first personal loan has helped over 1 million customers access short-term credit on transparent, affordable terms. We now offer a 3-month installment loan and are rolling out a credit card in beta. As Head of Growth, you'll own how Tilt Mexico finds, activates and keeps customers across all three products, with real budget accountability and the mandate to drive profitable growth.

Acquisition works today but is concentrated in a few paid channels. Lifecycle and cross-sell are early, and the brand is under-measured. This is a chance to build an AI-native growth function in one of Latin America's largest and fastest-moving consumer credit markets.

This is a remote role based in Mexico. Travel for company onsites is expected at least four times a year.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the full growth funnel: Lead acquisition, activation, retention and cross-sell as one strategy, measured on profitable customers rather than installs or approvals. Paid acquisition stays the engine; you'll bring lifecycle and brand up to parity over time.

  • Drive performance marketing sophistication: Allocate the acquisition budget across channels with rigour: proper attribution, event-based optimisation, and payback and CAC (customer acquisition cost) discipline tied to credit outcomes. Push beyond the current channel mix into new paid, partnership, referral and app store channels, backed by steady creative testing.

  • Make growth and credit work together: Use the unit economics model with Credit and Data Science to decide which customers to acquire, at what cost and through which channels. Make sure growth targets account for approval rates and losses, not just volume.

  • Build the brand and its measurement: Define how Tilt shows up in Mexico, in voice, visual identity and awareness strategy, and put in place the measurement it lacks today: brand tracking, organic search and app store visibility, and social listening.

  • Grow customer value through lifecycle and cross-sell: Build triggered campaigns across push, SMS, WhatsApp, email and in-app that move customers from first loan to repeat loans, installment loans and the credit card. Partner with Product and Engineering to define what the lifecycle stack needs, and own the strategy that runs on it.

  • Run a small, leveraged team: Lead a tight, high-output team that uses AI for creative production, budget allocation and analytics rather than defaulting to headcount growth. Share what works with the growth teams in our other markets: the US, Brazil, India and the Philippines.

Why you're a great fit

  • 8+ years in growth or marketing, with hands-on performance marketing experience earlier in your career. You've personally run campaigns, not just overseen them.

  • You've had real budget accountability: your name on spend decisions, not just advisory input.

  • Consumer fintech or digital lending experience in Mexico or Latin America. You understand how acquisition cost, approval rates and credit losses shape what growth is worth.

  • Strong quantitative fluency. CAC, LTV (lifetime value), payback, attribution models and A/B test design (sample size, statistical significance) are second nature.

  • Familiarity with CRM and lifecycle tooling (Iterable or equivalent). You know what good looks like, even if you weren't the one building it.

  • You hold both halves of growth at once, analytical rigour and creative judgment, and you're honest about where your edge sits.

  • An AI-native mindset. You use agentic AI tools to raise your team's speed and quality, and you see AI as a force multiplier, not a threat to headcount.

  • Native or fluent Spanish and professional fluency in English.

  • Bonus: Hands-on experience with AppsFlyer (or a comparable mobile attribution platform) for install and event measurement.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion about your experience.

  3. Skills Panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach.

  4. Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you'll contribute to Tilt's mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.
